title: Assumpta Hymnal
description: Assumpta Hymnal - COMPLETE extraction with placeholders. 581 real hymns + 69 placeholders (224-292) for missing numbers in source. Total 650 entries matching highest hymn number.

hymns.title: ABỤ M ACHỊCHA DỊ NDỤ

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Kristi ekwugo ya wee si: Beereso m'i riri ahu n'obara Nwa nke mmadu, ñukwaa obara ya; Beereso m'i riri ya, nwanne m, M' i riri ahu mu o; Beereso m'i ñuru obara mu o, Obara di oke onu, ! gaghi enwe ndu n' ime gi.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Abu m achicha di ndu Na-enye ndu ebighebi; Kristi bu achicha di ndu Nna nyere anyi. Bianu nara.Kristi, Onye nwuru mnaka anyi; Bianu naranu Kristi, Onye zoputara anyi.3. Abu m achicha di ndu “6 Kristi ekwugo:Naranu m rie, “ Nri si n' igwe, “ (ref.)

hymns.refrain: Onye riri ahu mu o Onye ñuru obara mu o Ga-adi ndu n'ezie D$ okpu. (2nd time)

hymns.title: ACHICHA DỊ NDỤ SI N' ELUIGWE

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Onye riri achicha nke a, Ga-enwe ndu okpu.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Achicha m ga-enye unu bu ahu m Maka ndu nke unu.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Onye riri ahu m, ñuo obara m, Ga-ebi n' ime m.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Onye riri ahu m, ñuo obara m, Aga m ebi n' ime ya.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Ahu m bu ihe oriri ezie, Obara m bu ihe oñuñu ezie Mara onwe ya ikpe onwu.7. Oge unu na-eme ihe ndi a,Unu na-echeta onwu m.

verses.label: VERSE 8
verses.text: Ezigbo Jesu ji ahu ya azu m;Ekele diiri gi.

verses.label: VERSE 9
verses.text: Etosighi m k' i bata n'ime m,Maka njo m mere.

verses.label: VERSE 10
verses.text: Were obara gi di oke onu,Wuchapu njo m mere.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Mgbe oria n' ahuhu di n' uwa,Gi biakwute anyi, ('kwute anyi.)

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Gi na-eche anyi nche mgbe niile Na-akasi anyi obi, ('si anyi obi.)

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Mgbe anyi na-ada ada, gi, Nna Na-ekulite anyi, ('lite anyi.)

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: Na nsogbu niile, gi bu ihe,Na añuri obi anyi, (obi anyi.)

verses.label: VERSE 8
verses.text: Mgbe anyi ga-anwu hapu uwa,Biko nara anyi, (nara anyi).

verses.label: VERSE 9
verses.text: Otito diiri Chukwu Nna,Na Nwa na Mmuo nso,(na Mmuo Nsọ).

verses.label: VERSE 10
verses.text: Otu o di na mbu, di ugbua Ga-adi ruo ebeebe, 74(ruo ebeebe).

hymns.title: AGA M EJI GINI KELEE OLISA

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Aga m eji gini kelee gi o?(kelee gi o)Aga m eji gini kelee gi?Oseburuwa Chukwu, Onye mere ihe niile di n' uwa,choo ha mma, Were ha nye anyi, Si anyi ñuriwa na ha.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Aga m ejidi aku n'uba kelee gio, (Chineke) Aga m ejidi ihe oriri kelee gi o? Aga m ejidi aku n' uba kelee gi o? O budi nke koro gi? O budi nke koro gi? O budi nke koro gi (Chineke)? Chineke, Okaka, Onye ebube.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Keleenu ya, keleenu ya; Afooma ya kariri akari, Afooma ya kariri iguta onu, Kelee ya, Onye oma.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Chineke doo, (Ekele diri Chineke), Chineke doo, (Chineke, Odogwu, Onyenwe m), Aga m eji gini kelee gi o? Chineke, Okaka. N' ihe i meere anyi, (Ref) I zitere Nwa gi, Chineke: (Ref) Ka o gbaputa anyi na njo: (Ref) Megheere anyi uzo nke igwe: (Ref)

hymns.title: AHỤ KRISTI

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Ahụ Kristi mụ o, Bụ nri nke m ga-eri, Ọbara onye nzọpụta, Nye m ndụ ebeebe.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Ahụ Kristi mụ o, Bụkwa ndụ nke mụ o, Ahụ onye nzọpụta mụ o Amen, Amen.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Ahụ Kristi bụ Ihe oriri, Ọbara ya bụkwa Ihe ọñụñụ.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: O Jesu nke mụ o, Biko, nye m ahụ gị. Nyekwa m ọbara gị Ka m rie, ka m ñụọ.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Biko Jesu, doo, Chineke nke mụ o, Were ọsọ zute mụ o, Ezigbo Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Chukwu eze mụ ọ, Onye nwe ndụ mụ ọ, Sọ gị ka m na-akpọku, Ezi Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: O Jesu nke mụ o, si n'igwe bịa, Maka ihi ndị ọme njọ, Ewoo, ewoo.

hymns.refrain: Ahụ, ahụ, ahụ Kristi, Ọbara Kristi, Amen. Amen.

hymns.title: AHỤ KRISTI BỤ SỌ MMA

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Ọ bụ sọ ndị na-ebughị njọ n'obi Bụ ndị nwere ike inata ya N'obi añụrị.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Ndị niile natara Jesu n'obi, Ma ha bukwa njọ ogbugbu n'obi, Dakwara iwu.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Onye natara Jesu n'obi dị mma Ga-enwe añụrị ebighebi N'ụwa ọzọ.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Onye natara Jesu ga-adị umeala, Ọ ga-adị ọcha purụ iche N' ime obi ya.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Ekworo, anya ukwu na ọbọ, Nna wepụ N' obi ndị niile natara Jesu Kristi. K' anyị zere iwu niile Nna tiiri, Na iwu niile nke Nzukọ Na nke obodo. Makana iwu niile si n'eluigwe bịa, Ma nke Nzukọ, ma nke obodo Tiiri anyị.

hymns.refrain: Ahụ Kristi bụ sọ mma, Bịakwute m. Ọbara Kristi k'e ji Gbapụta ụwa.

hymns.title: AHỤ NA ỌBARA KRISTI

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Jesu ọkpara Chineke, Nwa Chineke, Onye nwụrụ ọnwụ n'elu obe maka ihi anyị, O kwesịri ekwesị inye ya nsọpụrụ; Kristi kwesịri nsọpụrụ; Nye ya nsọpụrụ n' ihe ọbụla i na-eme.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Tupu i ga-eje ka i nata ya, Nyochaa onwe gị, nyochaa onwe gị, Nyochaa onwe gị; Onye ọbụla natara m Na-adịghị nkwadebe, Riteere onwe ya amamikpe ebighebi; Kwadoo onwe gị Tupu i jee nara ya.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Bịa nara m rie, Bịa nara m ñụọ. Onye riri ahụ m, ma ñụọ ọbara mụ o, ga-ebi n' ime m. Mụ ebirikwa n' ime ya; Abụ m ụzọ, ndụ, na eziokwu; Onye riri ahụ m, ma ñụọ ọbara m, ga-enwe ndụ ebighebi.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Nna dị ebube, biko, Site n' ahụ n' ọbara nwa gị, Nke i ji azụ anyị nri, Sachapụ ọ mmehie anyị; Kpọghachi anyị azụ n' ebe i nọ, Ka ọ ga-abụ n' ọge ikpeazụ, K' anyị sorọ na ndị ga-añụri ọñụ N'alaeze gị. Nara ekpere anyị n'aha Jesu Kristi, ọkpara gị.

hymns.refrain: Onyenweanyi Jesu Kristi, Onye dị nsọ, onye dị ebube, Kwesi nsọpụrụ; Ọ bụ ahụ n'ọbara ya k'anyị na-anata Na Sakramenti nke Yukarịstịa. Onyenweanyi, Jesu Kristi, Onye dị nsọ, onye dị ebube, kwesị nsọpụrụ, Ọ bụ ahụ n'ọbara ya k'anyị na-anata Na Sakramenti dị nsọ.

hymns.title: AJA DỊ NSỌ

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Anyi ekelee gi maka ogo gi niile Chukwu, biko nara aja, Nara umu gi gozie. Anyi ekelee gi maka afooma gi: Anyi ekelee gi, Nna,

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Anyi enye gi nsopuru Na otito kacha elu: (Ref)Anyi edoo gi ebube, Nna,Onye kacha elu: (Ref)Anyi ebunye gi iko nso,Biko nara ya:

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Anyi ario gi mgbaghara njo anyi: Anyi ario gi ebere n'obodo anyi: Anyi ario gi grasia na ngozi niile:

hymns.refrain: Nara Nna, nara, Nara onyinye umu gi, Nara aja di nso. D.$.

hymns.title: AKỤ NA ỤBA CHINEKE NYERE M

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Ka anyi kelee Chineke,maka ihe oma ya.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Chetakwa na Chineke bu onye di ocha.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Ihe obula i ga-enye ya bukwa ihe di ocha.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Nke ga-esi n' ezigbo obi gi puta.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Chineke ga-enye gi otu o di ya mma.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Ka i were si na ya wee kelee Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: Chineke Nna di ebube choro ihe otito.

verses.label: VERSE 8
verses.text: Nke a ga-eji too ya,too ya mgbe niile .

verses.label: VERSE 9
verses.text: Site taata wee ruo mgbe ebighebi. Amen.

hymns.title: AKỤ NA ỤBA M NIILE

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: I siri n' aja wee kpụọ m, Tinye m ndụ, Ndụ m si n' aka gị, Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: I kere m n' oyiyi gị; I nyere m amamihe gị. Akọ na uche na ọgụgụ isi m Bụ onyinye ọma gị, Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Ike nke m ji arụ ọrụ ụbọchị m; Mmụọ ịgba mbọ nke i nyere m; Gịnị ka m ga-akwụghachi N' ihe niile ị na-emere m, Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Akụ na ụba m niile, Ego na ihe onwunwe, Mmụta m na aka ọrụ m Si n'aka gị, Onye na-eme mma.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: I mere m okorobịa, Okorobịa siri ike, Okorobịa na-aga n'ihu; Okorobịa niile Bụ gị mere ha, onye ebube.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: I mere m agbọghọbịa, Agbọghọbịa bụ sọ mma. Nnenwaanyi na nnammadụ Ihe ọbụla onye ọbụla bụ Si n'aka gị onye dị mma.

hymns.refrain: Akụ na ụba m niile si n'aka Chineke, Chukwu onye na-eme mma; Onye na-eme mma, aga m ekele gị, Aga m ekele gị mgbe dum.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Ndi Mmuooma siri n' eluigwe gbadata n' uwa, Mgbe a muru Dinwenu; Ha na-ekwere ya ukwe, Ha na-ekwere ya ukwe na-asi: Aleluya! Aleluya! Hozana! Hozana! N'ebe kacha elu diiri gi, Jesu Kristi. Aleluya! Aleluya! Hozana! Hozana! N'ebe kacha elu diiri nwa Chukwu: Jesu Kristi.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Uwa niile, soronu ndi Mmuooma,Soronu ndi Mmuooma, Werenu ubo, ubo di uto,Ubo na opi, kwebere ya ukwe na-asi:

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Jesu abiawo,Onye nzoputa anyi, Jesu abjawo; Kristi abjawo,Onye nzoputa anyi, Kristi abiawo. Nwebenu añuri,Nwebenu añuri na Kristi abjawo. O biawo n'onwe ya,Jesu abiawonu n' onwe ya.Kwebere ya ukwe na-asi:

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Otito, Otito,Otito diiri Nna onye zitere gi; Otito, Otito,Otito diiri Nna onye zitere gi, Diiri gi, dikwaara Mmuo Nso ebeebe.

hymns.title: A MỤRỤ NWA KA NWA

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: $1 A muru nwa ka nwa o,Nwa Chineke onye kacha elu;A muru Onyenweanyi o,Nwa Chineke onye kacha elu;Onye nzoputa e kwere anyi na nkwa na mbu,Aleluya! o biawo. D.$.1

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: $2 (Bianu ka anyi jee, Bianu ka anyi jee) Ngwanu ka anyi jee Betlehem,Jee huru nwa ka nwa. (Bianu ka anyi jee, bianu ka anyi jee) Ngwanu ka anyi jee Betlehem,Jee huru Onyenweanyi, Nva Chineke onye kacha elu.Onye nzoputa e kwere anyi na nkwa na mbu, Aaluyal o biawo.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Ndi ncheaturu agaalari jee hu,Mgbe ndi Mmuoozi gwara ha Na a muru nwa ka nwa.Ndi eze ato agaalari jee hu,(Ihe ebube nke mere) .Mgbe kpakpando ziri ha Ebe a muru Onyenweanyi.D.$2 Ndi ncheaturu gara sekpuoro va ka nwa; di eze atogara sekpuoro va ka nwa, Nye ya onyinye, (Onyinye ola edo, Frankinsens na Mea) O' gini k'anyi ga-eme? O' gini k'anyi ga- enye? (Anyi ga-akpo isiala nye ya Kwee ukwe oñu nye ya Kwekwaara ya ukwe otito si) Otito diiri Chineke n' elu kacha elu N' uwa udo diri ndi mmadu ndi obi ocha; (makana,)D.$.1

hymns.refrain: Ngwanu ka anyi jee lee.

hymns.title: A MỤRỤ NWATA NKE CHUKWU
hymns.attribution: Kubata anyi n' ihu nwa gi.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: O tere aka ndi amuma Gwara anyi nwa Chukwu ga-abja; O tere aka ndi amuma Gwara anyi oge nke o ga-abia.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Ulo anu maka ebe obibi, Ahihia maka imebe akwa. Uio anu maka ebe obibi, Bu ihe Jesu nwere n' uwa.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Maria nodebere nwa ya,Kedu añuri o na-añuri? Maria nodebere nwa ya, Ekele, o nne nke Jesu.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: O Vejin Maria di nsọ, Ka nwa gi biri n' obi anyi. O Vejin Maria di nso,

hymns.refrain: A muru nwata nke Chukwu, Kweenu ukwe makana o biara.

hymns.title: ANATAGO M JESU N'OBI M
hymns.attribution: Wee ruo n' ubochi onwu m.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: N'umeala, ka m sekpuoro gi, Onye nzoputa nke m; Eji m obi m niile kwere, Chukwu onye okike m.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Ka m were obi m niile na onu m, Na ike niile nke ahu m, Na-ekele gi ezi ekele, Chukwu nke ihunaanya.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Gee nti, nuru ihe m na-ario gi, Ezigboo Dinwenu Dobe ndu nke di n' ime obi m, Na amara nke Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Yukaristia, site taata, I ga-adi n' ime obi m. Oge niile m ga-ano n' uwa,

hymns.refrain: O si n' eluigwe bia n' uwa, Otito diiri ya.

hymns.title: ANYI ABIAWO, CHINEKE

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Bianu umu Chineke,K' anyi keleenu Nna. Bianu ndi kwere na, Okpara ya, Jesu.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Toonu Chineke, Onye kere uwa niiie, Toonu Chineke, Onye na-echekwaba ya.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Chukwu ebuka, Chukwu ebuka; Ngozi ya kariri akari n' ebe anyi no. Kelee ya, kelee ya,

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Gi bu Nna nwe ekele anyi, Ma ututu, ma ehihie. Gi bu Nna nwe ekele anyi Ma mgbede ma anyasi.

hymns.refrain: Keleenu Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Ndi Chineke, cheta na anyi bu ihe,Obodo nke e wurukwa E, umunna m, anyi bu uto nk' uwa;E, anyi nuru nke a n' onu Jizos. Anyi bu ihe (Anyi bu ihe nke na-enwu n'elu ugwu), Nnu nke na-eme k' ihe oriri di uto. M'o buru na nnu atufuo utoya,A ga-eji gini eme ka o di uto?

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Ndi Chineke, udo k' anyi bu n'uwa, Otu ndi nke na-eme ka ala dikwa mma; Mgbe ekwensu na-amunye oku n' ime uwa, Aha Jizos ga-eme ya k'o nyuo.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: A pughi izo obodo di n' elu ugwu; A pughi imunye oriona mobu ihe oku, Dobakwa ya nk'oma n' okpuru mgbe; E, o baghikwa, o baghi n' ihe.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Ndi Chineke werenu otu obi, E, werenu otu uche, werekwa olu Nye Chineke onye nwe Igwe n' uwa Ekele n' ojija, too ya n' ezi.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Anyi bu umu Chineke Nna, Site n' ubochi nke a muru anyi. (2x) O Chineke Nna, O nara onyinye, O mee ka ezinaulo obula di mma. (2u)

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Anyi bu ndi na-enweghi ike obula, Beere sooso gi bu Chineke Nna (2x)

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Maka ihi mmehie nke anyi mere, Biko Chineke, meere anyi ebere. (2x)

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Site na mmiri nke baptiizim Anyi bu umu nke Chineke

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Anyi bu umu nke Meri Bu nne nọ n' eluigwe,Anyi ji obi niile,Hu nne anyi n' anya.Meri were obioma gi,Were chee umu gi,K' anyi di ndu di nso Na amara nke Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Ezenwanyi bu so mma,O Nne anyi di nso,Chekwaa anyi na ndokwa,Taa na mgbe niile,Uwa juputara n' oria N' ebe umunna anyi no,Biko nyere anyi aka,Ya na ntasi obi.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Maria, nke bu so mma,Onye n' ebughi njo,Dobe obi anyi ocha Wepugara anyi njo Ihe anyi na-acho n' uwa,Bu ihu gi n' anya,K'anyi binyere gi,N' añuri nke eluigwe.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Anyi ga-eje n' ihu Chineke Onye kere uwa niile. Anyi ga-eje gbuoro ya ikpere,Kpoo isiala nye ya.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Anyi ga-eje n' ihu Chineke,Onye kere aku n' uba niile, Ref.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Anyi ga-eje n' ihu Chineke,Onye kere uwa choo ya mma.Ref.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Anyi ga-eje n' ihu Chineke,Onye kere mmadu, nye ya uche, Nye ya ako, nyekwa ya ogugu isi. Ref.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Anyi ga-eje n' ihu Chineke,Onye kere uwa, choo ya mma,Nye ya mmadu. Ref.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Chukwu Nna, onye kere mmadu,Nye ya uche, nye ya ako;Mesiri zitere ya Jesu,Okwu nke na-enye ndu.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: O nwere ihunaanya ka nke a,Na Chineke biara n' uwa,Wee buru mmadu n' ihe niile,Beereso n' ime njo.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Mee k' o si na mmuo anyi puta,K' o kwesi n' i ga-anara ya.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Si n' ihe niile anyi na-enye,Mee k' anyi buru ezigbo umu gi.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Oia ocha m'obu ola edo,Chineke, o dighi nke m ji bia.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: O bu naani n' ebere.gi Ka m tukwasiri ndu m niile.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Lee m anya, meere mn ebere,Ihe m nwere ka m nyere gi.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Otito diri Chukwu Nna,Na Nwa na Mmuo Nso,uwa ebeebe.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Anyi na-ekele gi, Vejin Maria,Nne nke Chukwu,nwaanyi bu so mma,Oge niile, k' anyi na-gbakwute gi,O Nne, leta anya na mkpa umu gi.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Anyi na-akwado maka Misa di nso. Anyi choro obi di ocha;Anyi chokwara okwukwe na ihunaanya.O Nne, leta anya na mkpa umu gi.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Anyi na-ario gi k' i bia nonyere anyi,K'i si kwuru n' akuku Jesu;Nara onyinye anyi,were ya nye Chukwu; O Nne, leta anya na mkpa umu gi.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Ka Dinwenuanyi, n' ime nnukwu ahuhu, Zotara anyi n' ugwu Kalvari, O gwara Nne ya ka o na-ele ya anya; O Nne, leta anya na mkpa

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Anyi ndi njo no n' uwa nke a,Na-eto aha ya, k' o zoputa anyi. Tobe ya mgbe ebighebi, Tobe ya mgbe ebighebi, Tobe, tobe Chineke, Tobenu Chineke, mmadu niile bi n' uwa Mgbe ebighebi. b. Kelee ya mgbe ebighebi...... c. Riowa ya mgbe ebighebi......

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Chineke, biko cheta anyi,N' oge ikpeazu ahapula anyi.

verses.label: VERSE 3

verses.text: Otito diri Nna na Nwa, Na Mmuo Nso, nk' ihunaanya ha; Na ike na otito, na ebube,

verses.text: O mkpuruobi m juo onwe gi.Kedu ihe i ga-enye Chukwu? Lee ka umunne gi bu onyinye ha Na -eje ichu aja ya.

hymns.title: JESU NCHETA GI NA- ATOKA

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Jesu ncheta gi na-atoka, ! bu añuri ndi nọ n' uwa. Ma mgbe Jesu ji biakwute, Ya bu ihe kacha ihe niile.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Bubanu abu na-ada na nti,Nke onye ga-anu wee nwee añuri; O dighi aha nke na-ato uto, Ka aha Jesu Nwa nke Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Jesu bu nchekwube ndi njo, Ya bu ihe anyi niile na-achọ; O na-ato obi ndi na-acho ya, O ga-abu gini ma a chota ya?

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Onu enweghi ike ikwuputa, O gaghi ekwe ide n'akwukwo, N'onwe anyi ka anyi ji mata Ihe bu ihu Jesu n' anya.

hymns.title: JESU KRISTI BU IHE NKE UWA

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: I dibu tupu e kee uwa.Site na gi ka e siri kee ihe niile. N'aka gi ka ndu di. Ndu ahu bu ihe mba niile.

verses.text: Ka a muru Jesu, eze anyi Na Betlehem, n' uloanu, Maria ekpube ya akwa Wee nyibe ya n' ahihia

verses.text: Ndi ncheaturu no n' ime ohia, Ndi biiri nso n' obodo ahu, Ka ha na-eche aturu ha, Ha nuru ukwe nke ndi Mmuoozi

verses.text: Mmuooma si ha: "Unu atula egwu Makana ewetaara m unu Ozioma nke si n' eluigwe, Nke ga-adiri mmadu niile."

verses.text: "Taata, n' obodo nke Devid, A muuru unu eze Kristi, Onye nzoputa nke mmadu. Ma nke a buuru unu akara."

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: "Unu ga-ahu nwa a muru ohuru Nke nne ya kpubere akwa. E nyibere ya n' uloanu. Jee, k' unu sekpuoro Chukwu."

verses.text: Ka Mmuooma kwusiri okwu, lgwe ndi Mmuooma nke eluigwe Kwunyeere ya ozugbo ahu

hymns.refrain: Otito diiri Chineke, Otito diiri Chineke, Otito diiri Chineke, (n'elu) N' elu kacha elu.D.$.

hymns.title: KA ANYI ZUKOO N'ULONSO

verses.text: Dinwenu, etosighị m ibata n'ụlọ nsọ gị; Ma site n'ọnwụ ị nwụrụ n'elu obe, Ị zọpụtala m, mee ka m dị ọcha Ịkwuru n' ihu gị, fee gị ofufe.

verses.text: Maka anyi na imerime mmadu,Ha kwere onwu maka Jesu;Biko Jesu, nye anyi obi Ita ahuhu maka ihi gi.

verses.text: Ndi niile kwenyere n' aha nke Jesu,Ga-enwe nzoputa na añuri ebeebe.

hymns.title: KA UWA NIILE NYE GI OTITO

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Ka uwa niile nye gi ofufe,Onyenweanyi,Ka uwa niile tobe gi, Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: K'anyi bia nye gi ofufe n' ulo gi,K' anyi bia nye gi otito,Chineke, biko nara ha gozie.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Chineke, anyi abja,Ibunye gi nsopuru anyi,Ibunye gi otito anyi;Chineke, biko nara ha n' obi ocha.

hymns.title: KEDU IHE M GA-EMERE CHINEKE? KEDU

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Ya buru uwe na akwa,Ya buru ji na ede. Kedu ihe m ga-emere Chineke? Onyinye buru ibu, na-egosi ihunaanya. (Ref) Onyenwe uwa, biko, isiala, ikpereala. (koros)

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Gi leta nwa ogbenye, nye ya ihe koro ya. Leedu nwaanyi isimkpe, Nye ya ikpe kwuru oto. Ndi nke na-enweghi onye inye aka, Si n' aka gi wee nata onyinye Chukwu. (koros)

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Gi hu mmadu ibe gi n' anya, K' i siri hu onwe gi. (ref) ! ga-ahukwa Chineke n'anya, N' ezi obi gi niile. (koros)

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Obioma Chineke bara uba, Bara uba , bara uba; Obioma onyenwe uwa

hymns.title: KEDU IHE M GA-ENYEGHACHI CHUKWU? KEDU

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Ogaranya nke igwe, Ojija diiri gi, Nna nke umu ogbenye, Anyi biara n' ihu gi, Ka i nyere anyi aka, Oseburuwa; Onye nke mazuru Echiche mmadudum.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Jesu Kristi, Okpara Chineke; Otu nwa Chineke Muru so naani ya, Onye nwuru n' ihi anyi A kpogbuo ya n' obe, Obi di nso Jesu,

hymns.refrain: Chukwu bi n'igwe, N' ihe oma o meere m, Mgbe m no na ahuhu? Maka ihe dum o meere m, Ka m ji enye ya ekele; Otito diiri ya, Eze kacha eze dum.

hymns.title: KELEENU CHUKWU KELEENU CHUKWU, NYENU YA

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Chetanu Chineke Nna, Onyenweanyi, So ya bu Nna nk'anyi, Onye obioma. Bia n' ihu ya, bia n' ihu ya; I nweghi ihe obula, nye ya onwe gi. (koros)

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Gaa nye Chineke Nna ihe i nwere; Gaa nye Chineke Nna onyinye obioma. (ref/koros)

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Gaa'nye Chineke Nna ahuhu gi;Gaa nyekwa ya ma uru gi. (ref/koros)

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Gaa nye Oseburuwa ihe ubi gi,O ga-enyekwa gi nke ubi ya. (ref/koros)

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Gaa nye Chineke Nna onyinye inwere;Gaa nye onyenwe uwa aku ndi oma. (ref/koros)

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: O bu so Chineke Nna nwe ihe niile; O bu so naani ya nwe onyinye oma. (ref/koros)

hymns.refrain: Bia nye Chukwu.

hymns.title: KELEE YA NA O BU EZE

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Bianu k' anyi kelee,Kelee ya n' o bu eze;Unu bia k'anyi fee ya,N' ihina o bu eze anyi.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Kelee eze nke uwa,Keleenu eze obioma;Onye maara isu ude anyi,Aleluya.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Ha na-acho igbu anyi n' efu,Chukwu biko ekwela;Setipu aka udo gi,Ka udo wee diiri anyi.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: O bu Maria no,Adda nke Ana;Onye muputara Oseburuwa.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: O nyiwe ya n' uloanu Na Betlehem,Ebe ehi na anyinya Na-arahu ura.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Josef di nso nodu,lle nwa anya;Nnukwu ihe omimi nke a Turu ya n' anya.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Bianu mmadu niile Na Betlehem,Were too Nna na Nwa,Ya na Mmuo Nso.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Kristi ebilitewo, Toonu Chukwu; K'anyi goribenu, (Ref) K' anyi ñurianu. Toonu Chukwu, Mezaya ebilitewo, Toonu Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 2

verses.label: VERSE 4

verses.label: VERSE 6

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: O Dinwenu, bia n' ime obi m, O Dinwenu, chebe m oge niile.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Nwaturu Chukwu, eze ndi oma,Gi bu Chukwu, bata n' ime obi m

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Onye kere mu, onye kere mu,Onye kere mu, bata n' ime obi m.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Okwu e mere ahu, Chukwu biara,

hymns.refrain: Aga m eje n' olta, Ka Kristi zuo m nri, Ahu n' obara ya ka m ga-eri, Ka m ga-añu.

hymns.title: KRISTI, UKOCHUKWU EBEEBE

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Dinwenu gwara nna m ukwu:"Nodu ala n' aka nri m,Aga.m edote ndj iro gi N' okpuru ukwu gi."

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Onyenweanyi ga-esi na Zayon zite Mkpo eze nke ike gi,

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Eze, site n' ubochi a muru gi N' elu ugwu di nso;Tupu chi efoo,Esiri m n' afo m muta gi.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Onyenweanyi ñuru iyi,O ma echeghari,Ibu ukochukwu ebeebe,Dika Melkisedek, mgbe ochie.

hymns.refrain: Na-ehunye achicha na mmanya, Dika Melkisedek.

hymns.title: KULIENU KA ANYI JEENU RIE KULIENU

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Obara ya bu aku,O nwere ihe uto, ihe uto nil Obara ya bu aku, O nwere ihe uto,O nwere ihe uto niile Aku nwere n' ime ya ihe uto niile.(Ref) Oriri na oñuñu na-enye ndu ebighebi. (Ref) Cheta na oriri anyi na- anata ahu n' obara Kristi.(Ref) Cheta na o bu Sakramenti nke Yukaristia.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Lokenenu k' o si buru uche Chukwu,Iwere onwe ya meere anyi nri,Meere anyi nri, meere anyi nri Nri nke ndu ebeebe.Uche Chukwu. Uche Chukwu, Lokenenu k'o si buru uche Chukwu, Buru uche Chukwu,buru uche Chukwu,Iwere onwe ya meere anyi nri,(Nri mkpuruobi)Meere anyi nri, meere anyi nri,Nri nke ndu ebeebe.

verses.text: (K'anyi sekpuoro Dinwenu Krist K'anyi sekpuoro Dinwenu,(K'anyi sekpuoro Dinwenu Kristi K'anyi sekpuoro Dinwenu,Na sakramenti nke kachasi nso K'envi sekpuoro Dinwenu. (K'anyi kpoo isiala,) K'anyi kpoo isiala, Gbuo ikpere, nye Dinwenu. K' anyi sekpuoro Dinwenu, Onye gosiworo anyi ebere ya. (ebere ya.)

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Ndi otu Kristi, bukotanu ihe egwu di mma, Bukotanu ihe egwu di oke onu;

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Otito na ngozi dijri Chukwu Nna, na Nwa, Otito na ngozi dijri Chukwu Nna, na Nwa, Na Chukwu Mmuo Nso. Nsopuru diiri Chineke, Ato n' ime otu di ngozi: Ugwu n'idi nso dijri ya, (Ugwu n'idi nso diiri ya,) Ugwu n'idi nso diiri ya,ebeebe. Ugwu n' idi nso, (4x) Ugwu n' idi nso diiri ya, ebeebe. Amen. Amen.

hymns.refrain: Chirinu une n' ubo akwara too ya, Wetanu oja (oja di mma), Wetanu ubo (ubo di mma), Wetanu opi, n' une, Werenu egwu otiti too ya, Buoro eze ebube, Chukwu anyi abuoma D.$.

hymns.title: KULIENU KA ANYI NYE CHUKWU EKELE

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Chineke, anyi abia n' ihu ebube gi, Anyi esekpuoro gi, anyi ekelee gi.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Chukwu biara n' uwa ka o gbaputa anyi, A muru anyi ka umu Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Kristi bu eze nke uwa niile, Kristi na -achi eze n' eluigwe.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Ndi oma nke Chukwu, kweenu ukwe oñu, Sekpuonu na-etonu Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Lee anya n' eluigwe ka i hu ebube ya. Debenu iwu ya mgbe niile.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Tobenu Chukwu; kwee Hozana! Kwezuonu, na-etonu Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: Anyanwu na-ekwe ukwe na-ekele gi, Onwa na umnu kpakpando na-ekele.

verses.label: VERSE 8
verses.text: Eluigwe na-ekwe ukwe na-ekele gi, Ndi mmadu niile na-ezuko.

verses.label: VERSE 9
verses.text: Ya nwe mba niile, na ndi eze niile,Chukwu no na nzuzo, anyi ekele.

verses.label: VERSE 10
verses.text: Yanwa kere unu, ya zoro unu,Ya si unu na-efe ya n' uwa.

verses.label: VERSE 11
verses.text: Toonu Nna, too Nwa, ya na Mmuo Nso; Kweenu Amen. Aleluya!

hymns.refrain: Otito na ike n'ochichi diiri ya Otito diiri Chukwu, k'anyi na-eto ya.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Kuonu, mgbirimgba nke Kristmas: Kuo, kuo, kuo; Kuo, kuo, kuo; Kusaa, kuo, kuo n'uwa niile, N'a muru Jesu taa. D.C. A muru ya na Betlehem, Kristi, eze otito; Site n' ugwu na ndida niile, N'a muru Jesu taa. Kuo, kuo, kuo; mgbirimgba Kuo mgbirimgba, Kuo, kuo mgbirimgba nke Kristmas Kuonu taata n'oke añuri,N'a muru Jesu taa.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: $1 Jesu,okpara Chineke,O biakwa n' uwa ozo. A muru ya n' uloanu.Jesu, a muru ya. D.$1. O biara izoputa ndi njo,Kristi eze otuto. Tienu mkpu si: Hozana!N'a muru Jesu taa.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: $2 Meri bu nne Eze Jesu,Ekele diiri gi,N'a muru eze uwa niile.Meri anyi ekelee. D.$2 Otito diiri eze uwa niile,Hozana diiri ya. Site n' ugwu na ndida niile,N'a muru Jesu taa.

hymns.title: KWADOORO ONWE G!AKU N'ELUIGWE KWADOORO ONWE

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Fee Chineke nke oma n' uwa, Were aku gi fee ya, Okwukwe na ezi oru, Fee Chineke nke oma n' uwa, Q ga-enye gi ndu ebighebi.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Ihunaanya bu ya bu Naani iwu Chukwu tiiri anyi K' anyi hu ya n' anya, Hukwa mmadu ibe anyi n' anya n' ihi ya. Were ihunaanya wee fee Chukwu kere anyi, K'uba gi di ukwu n' eluigwe.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Ebe aku gi di, N' ebe ahu ka echiche gi di; Chowa aku nke ga-adigidenu, Nke sitere naani n' ife Chukwu. Chekwube na Chineke, Fee ya nke oma; I na-akpa aku nke ga-adigide.

hymns.refrain: Kwadooro onwe gi aku n'eluigwe, Ebe ndi ohi agaghi etiwa ezu.

hymns.title: KWEBENU UKWE KWEBENU UKWE, NA-ETINU MKPU

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: N' ezie, Chineke bu onye nzoputa m, Enwere m nchekwube, egwu agaghi atu m, N' ihina Dinwenu bu ike m, ukwe m, O bu onye nzoputa m; Unu ga-eji oñu kuru mmiri N' umi nke nzoputa.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Na-enyenu Dinwenu ekele, Na-etonu aha ya; Meenu ka oruaka ya rute mmadu niile nti, Na-akowaputanu ka aha ya si dika mkpa.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Buoronu Dinwenu abuoma, N' ihina o ruru oru oma, Meenu ka a nu ya n' uwa niile. Ndi nke Zayon, kwebenu ukwe, Na-etinu mkpu oñu, N' ihina onye no n' etiti unu Bu onye di nso nke Izrel.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Alaeze nke Izrel, Kwebenu ukwe otito nye Dinwenu; Gosinu na ike na ebube nke Chukwu Di n' ala Izrel niile, N' ihi nke a, werenu opi ike na ubo akwara Buoro Dinwenu abu.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Otito diiri Nna na Nwa na Mmuo Nso. Otu o di na mbido, ugbua, O ga-adigidekwa otu a,

hymns.refrain: nke lzrel.

hymns.title: KRISTI KULITERE N' ONWU

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Sagwe na ne goriwanu, Nurịwanụ n' ihina, Kristi emeriwo onwu.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: K'anyi goriwanu, K'anyi kwewanu, Aleluya! Aleluya!

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Jesu ebilitewo ka o siri kwuo. Kristi ebilitewo ka o siri kwuo. Aleluya!

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Kristi emeriwo, Kristi achịwala, Kristi bụ eze anyị.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Otito dịrị Chineke Otito dịrị Chineke, N'elu kacha elu.

hymns.refrain: Kristi Kulitere n' onwu, Onyenweanyi bilitere n' onwu. Aleluya! Aleluya! Onwu enweghikwa ike n' ebe ọ nọ.

hymns.title: KRISTI WEDARA ONWE YA ALA

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Kristi wedara onwe ya ala nke ukwu; Ọ naara ọnwụ, ọ naara ọnwụ, Ọnwụ nke elu obe.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Akaja niile ha mere ya, Mere ye, Utari niile ha piara ya, Okpu ogwu ha kpuwere ya, Ọ naara ha na-emeghi mkpesa. N' ime ihe ndị a niile, Otu ihe k' o kwuru ọ; O weliri anya ya elu, Sị: “Nna, ka e mee uche gị”.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Ha mara ya ube n' akuku ya. Mmiri na ọbara wee gbapụta, Ha feere uwe ya nza, Onye ọ maara, ọ were. Kristi Dinwenuanyi wee gbara oto N' ime ihe ndị a niile, O weliri anya ya elu, Wee si: “Nna gbaghara ha, N' ihina ha amaghị ihe ha na-eme”.

hymns.refrain: Ma Chineke buliri ya nnukwu elu, Chineke buliri ya nnukwu elu, Wee nye ya aha, wee nye ya aha, Wee nye ya aha, Aha kachasị aha niile.

hymns.title: KULIENU UMUNNE M KULIENU UMUNNE M

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Ya kere gi, ya na-eche gi. Ezi Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Ya na-edu gi n' uzo niile. Ezi Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Ya na-enye di, ya na-enye nwunye. Ezi Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Ya na-enye nwa, ya na-enye ego. Ezi Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Ya na-enye anwu, ya na-enye mmiri. Ezi Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Ya na-enye oru, ya na-enye ike. Ezi Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: Ya na-enye uburu na ima akwukwo. Ezi Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 8
verses.text: Ya na-azo gi n' onya ndjiro. Ezi Chukwu.

hymns.refrain: Were onyinye di mma kelee ya. Were onyinye di mma kelee ya, Kelee Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Otito! Otito! Ndi Mmuoozi na-ekwe; Nso! Nso! Ndi Mmuonche na-eti; Ugwu! Ugwu! Ndi Mmuo ireoku na-akwanye; Isiala! Isiala! Ndi Mmuo ocheeze na-akpo.

verses.text: Ala, igwe na mmadu na-ebi oma; Anyanwu na onwa no n'urukpu na-añurj; Tem, tem, ka kpakpando na-awu, na-arachi; Obi alo uwa; a muputala nwa a na-eche.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Okanya, Okanya N'owuwanwvu ka ha si, Na-aju, na-acho ezenwa is igolo Onyinye nsopuru ka ha bu n'obiuto; Mgbaisioma, olaedo na ude amara.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Añuri, añuri juzuru uwa, Umu ndi ncheaturu gbapuru ya oso, Nne Maria bara n'uche; Lekwa Ezenwa, Ozoputa uwa.

verses.text: Lee ezigbo nwaaturu Achicha nke ndioma, N'eluigwe ka o siri bia Ka anyi sekpuoro ya.

verses.text: O bu nna anyi ezie, Onye ncheaturu Na ya k'anyi chekwubere Chukwu nke ebere.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Anyi bu umu ogbenye, O Dinwenuanyi Meere anyi ebere. N'ihunaanya gi.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Nonyere anyi n'uwa, Ezigbo Jesu.Ka anyi wee nonyere gi

hymns.title: LEE KA AHA GI SI DI

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: (Mgbe m lelesiri eluigwe, Nke bu oru aka gi, Onwa na kpakpando Nke i doziri ofuma, gini ka) Gini ka mmadu bu, Nke i na-etinye ya n'uche? Mmadu na-anwu anwu,nwuo anwuo, Ka i na-akpachara anya, Ka i na-akpachara anya.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: I mere mmadu, Nke na nwantakiri m'o dizie ka Mmuoozi, I mere ya ka o nwee ebube na nsopuru, I nyere ya ike n'ebe ihe niile i kere di, Mekwaa ka ihe niile diri n'okpuru ya.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: I mere ka ihe niile i kere diri n'okpuru ya, (Aturu, ewu, na ehi, Burugodu anu niile na-akpa ike,Nnunu niile nke igwe,) (Ma) azu ndi na-egwughari n'ime mmiri.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Otito diri Nna na Nwa na Mmuo Nso,Otu o diiri na mbu, k'o di ugbua,K'o ga-adigide ruo n'uwa ebighebi, (uwa ebighebi) Amen.

hymns.title: LEE KA O SIRI MAA MMA

verses.text: Onye na-eme ka a nuru okwu nzoputa, Onye na-eme ka a nuru okwu nzoputa; Onye na-asi Zayon, Zayon, Zayon, Zayon, Zayon; Chineke gi bu eze, Chineke gi bu eze.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: I naghi ario aja, Mobu ihe nhunye, Kama nti ghe oghe. |naghi ario aja nsureoku, Na ihe nchuaja. Kama,lee m.

verses.text: N'ime akwukwo e dere Na m tosiri ime iwu gi Chineke mu o; Iwu gi na-ato m uto N'ime ime obi mu o.

verses.text: Ekwuputala m ikpe nkwumoto gi N'ihu nnukwu ogbakoba; O nweghi mgbe m mechiri onu m,

verses.text: Otito dịrị Chukwu Otito dịrị Kristi Otito dịrị Mmụọ Nsọ Atọ n'ime otu dị ngozi.

hymns.refrain: Kubata, kubata, Bịa nara ngozi Chukwu; Kubata, kubata, Nara ngozi Chukwu.

hymns.title: LEENU OSISI NKE OBE

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Obe Jesu bụ obe ọnwụ ihere, Mana ihere ghara ime anyị N'ihu Chineke, n' ihu onye ikpe.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Anyị bụ ndịinu bụ ndị e meriti n' elu osisi. Site n' elu osisi ka ọnwụ siri biara anyị. Mana ugbua, site n'osisi nke obe Nke Dinwenuanyi. Jesu Kristi, K'anyi siri nweta mmeri.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Dinwenuanyi, Jesu Kristi, Anyị na-esokpuru obe gị dị nsọ, I gbapụta anyị, Meere anyị ebere Na mmehie anyị, biko Nna, N' anyị amaghị ihe anyị na-eme.

hymns.refrain: Leenu osisi nke obe Ebe a kpọgburu Jesu. Leenu osisi nke obe Ebe a kpọgburu Jesu Onye nzọpụta ụwa niile.

hymns.title: MACULA NON EST-IN TE MACULA NON

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Ada nke Nna ji ike niile, Maria, nne nke Chukwu. Chukwu n' onwe ya n' ekele gi Macula non est in te.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Ezenwaanyi no n' eluigwe, Marja na-ebughi njo. Ndi Mmuooma na-anorube gi, Macula non est in te.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Nne nke Jesu, bu onyenzoputa Inye aka, ndu, n' uzo anyi, Biko nara ekele nke anyi, Macula non est in te.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: N'uwa, anyi no nochichiri Duba anyi n' ihe eluigwe Ebe ahu k' anyi ga-ahu mma,

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Maria,echekwube m N'inye aka nke gi, Biko luwara m.ogu Chebe ubochi ndu m, Mgbe oge ruwere M ga-eji hapu uwa, Riotara m Jesu amara Inwu onwu di nso.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: O Vejin di otito! Nne kacha ihunaanya! Buru nchedo m oge niile, N' ebe ndi iro m no. Bugara nwa gi Jesu Ekpere nke umu gi, Ekwesiri m ike na O gaghi aju aririo gi.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Onye bu enyi ndi mmehie Maria di ngozi, Biko, bia tasie m obi N' egwu m, na ahuhu m niile. Mgbe oge onwu ga-eru Lee m anya ebere. Mgbe nwa gi ga-ekpe ikpe m

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Maria,ezenwaanyi nke Mee Biko,nara ekele anyi,K-igozie anyi, Nne di mma;Anyi na-ario gi taata.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Maria, anyi na-ario gi,Ezenwaanyi di nso I bu nne anyi nke bu so mma;Gunye anyi n1' umu gi.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Maria, k' i were okwukwe,Nchekwube, na ihunaanya;Dobe ha n' ime obi anyi,K' anyi ghara itufu ha.

hymns.title: MARIA, KA I CHETA ANY! MARIA

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: K' anyi no n' elu uwa nke a,Nke bu uzo nke eluigwe,Anyi na-eje dika n' ugbo.Ka oke ufufe na-efe,Anyi na-ario gi Maria,Onye no n' eluigwe.Echefukwala ndi ije.Chebe ugbo ndi ije.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: K' anyi no n' ime ahuhu Na:mkpa, ya na nsogbu,Ka mmiri na-ebughari ugbo N'oge ebili ji atu;Anyi na-ario gi Maria,Onye no n' eluigwe,K'ugbo gh a ikpu na mmiri Chebe ugbo ndi ije.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: K' anyi wee ruo n'oge onwu,Ka e wee kpee anyi ikpe,K' ugbo nke anyi na-emi n'ala,Biko bia noro nso,Anyi na-ario gi Maria,Onye no n'eluigwe Echefukwala umu gi,Chebe ugbo ndi ije.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Jesu, Odenigbo, Kristi, Odenigbo, Nonyere anyị bụ ụmụ Igbo, K' anyị jiri añụrị na ịhụnanya. Chukwu nyere anyị asụsụ Igbo, Iji fee ya, ma kwusaa oziọma N' ime Kristi na n' aha Kristi, nwa ya, Onye bụ nzọpụta nke mmadụ niile.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Ya bụ ka anyị sụọ, Guọ, ma dee Igbo. Ka Igbo na oziọma debanye n' ime anyị; Na-edepụta ezi mkpụrụ na Kristi; Odenigbo, nzọpụta anyị.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Olu Igbo towe Chukwu Nna. Olu Igbo towe Chukwu Nwa, Olu Igbo towe Mmụọ Nsọ, Chi amamihe, Ugbua na mgbe ebighebi. Amen! Amen! Amen.

hymns.title: MEERE ANYI EBERE MEERE ANYJ EBERE

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: K'anyi jekwurunu Chineke, Chukwu ihunaanya, Chukwu obioma: K'anyi choba ya mgbe o no nso. Choba ya, choba ya Mgbe o ga-ekwe nchota.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Anyi kpafuru ka aturu Na-enweghi onye nche, Chineke, meere anyi ebere.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: K' anyi chegharianu, Jekwuru Chukwu anyi: O ga-emere anyi ebere.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Chineke, Chukwu di ihunaanya Meere anyi ebere; Elela anya na njo anyi,

hymns.refrain: Chukwu (di) ihunaanya.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Ha hee, ehee, ehe, ehe; Meri amụwo onye nzọpụta.

hymns.title: MERI NNE ANY! (MERI) MERI, NNE
hymns.attribution: Rev. Fr. Dr. Izu M. Onyeocha (Cmf.)

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Were afooma bugara Jesu,Ekpere na ukwe nke anyi,Echiche anyi na omume niile,Na ihe mwute mkpuruobi anyi.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: N' aka nke gi k' anyi na-etinye,Ubochi niile nke ndu anyi.Ma ubochi taa ma nke oge onwu, Mgbe anyi ga-ahapu uwa.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Biko chekwvaba idi ocha anyi,Ekwela k'anyi meruo ya,Wepuru anyi ihe ruru inyi,K' anyi wee hu Chukwu anya.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Nara taata ekele anyi,Maka inye aka i nyeere anyi,O ezi Nne, chebe anyi nche,K'anyi wee ruo ndu ebeebe.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Biko nara onyinye anyi;Idi ocha, ida ogbenye, irubeisi Anyi na-enye gi, n' adighi ike anyi, Kwado anyi k' anyi kwusie ike.

hymns.refrain: n'aka.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Kpoonu Pita, kpoonu Mata,Bu ndi nke Jizos; Gwanu Meri, gwanu Jon Bu ndi ma obi ya; Chetakwanu okwu ya, Kpoteekwa okwukwe unu, Ka ujo ghara itu unu; Mezaya ebiliwo. Gwanu ndjiro ya, Mezaya ebiliwo! Ma ndi nke na-eso ya, Mezaya ebiliwo! Oñu di n' ala mmuo, Eluigwe na-akpotu, Ka ekwensu gbalaga, Mezaya ebiliwo!

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Anyi ga-alu ogu,anyi ga-agba mgba, Maogaghi esogbu; Egwu n'uko ga-emegide, Ma o gaghi alugbu tke nille nke uwa, Ma nke di n' eluigwe, Dikwvara anyi n' akuku; Mezaya ebiliwo!

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Anuahu ga-anwu anwu, ma mmuo ga-adi ndu; Alaeze nke uwa ga-ebi, Eluigwe ga-achi; Umu alaeze nke igwe Ga-adi ndu ebighebi; Ha ga-abu umu Chineke; Mezaya ebiliwo!

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Oñu diiri umu Chukwu, Onu apughi iko; Obi unyi umu mmadu Apughi iguko Oñu niile nke umu Nke Chukwu n' usoro; Ma ihe kpatara nke a bu, Mezaya ebiliwo!

hymns.title: MEZIENU UZO ONYENWEANY! ANURU M.OLU.NA-ETI MKPU

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: N'oge ahu, Jon putara na mbara ikpa, Na ekwu si:chegharianu, chegharianu; Biakwuteny Chineke. Alaeze eluigwe adiwo nso Chegharianu."

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Unu ndi ire abuo,Nweenu ezigbo nchegharj; Mezienu agbata unu na Chineke, Ka o dikwa mma; Mitanu mkpuru di mma;Chetakwanu na unu bu nnu Na ihe nk'uwa niile; Onye obula na-amitaghi mkpuru di mma Ga-anwu anwu. Mitanu mkpuru di mma.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Onye ka m ike na-abia n' azu, Etosighi m ibute akpukpo ukwu ya; Mu onwe m ji mmiri amughari unu ozo, Ma ya onwe ya ga-ejikwa mmiri na Mmuo Nso.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Bikonu umunna m, Tugharianu uche n' ozioma ahu, Jon de Baptist na-ezi anyi na mbara ikpa, K' anyi wee nwee ike nabata Kristi Dinwenu, Onye nzoputa anyi. Ezigbo Nwanne m: Jup onwo gl alvju. moloa gl na Chukwu. Site n' oru i na-aru: (Rel) Ya na ihe i na-ekwu n' onu gi:(Rel) Biko mee osjiso, mezie uzo gi na Chukwu.

hymns.refrain: Mezienu uzo, mezienu uzo, Mezienu uzo Onyenweany!, Ka o kwuru oto.

hymns.title: MKPURUOBI M TOBE OSEBURUWA MKPURUOBI M

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Uwa na igwe, tobenu Chukwu; O kwesiri ekwesi na Ihe niile e kere eke Ga-eto ya.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Cheta onyinye na ngozi Chukwu O kwesiri ekwesi na Anyi ga-eji ha too Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Mkpuruobi m, ahu m, Na ihe niile m nwere Aga m eji ha niile tobe ya Na ndu m niile.

hymns.refrain: Tobe onyenwe m; Tobenu onye kere mu na gi.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Mmadu niile ndi bi n' uwa, Tobenu Chineke n' oñu, Werenu egwu febe ya, Unu bia n' ihu ya n' oñu.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Chukwu bu Chineke ezie, O bu naani ya kpuru anyi, Anyi bu ndi nke ya o na-azu, O si na anyi bu aturu ya.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Were otito bia n' ulo ya, Were oñu baa n' obi nke ya, Na-etonu aha ya mgbe dum, O kwesiri ime otu a.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Chukwu bu Chineke di mma, Ebere ya di mgbe niile; Okwu ya na-eguzosi ike, O ga-anorokwa mgbe niile.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Ndi mmadu nakwa ndi Mmuooma, Nyenu Nna na Nwa na Mmuo Nso, Chukwu nke igwe na ala na-efe

hymns.title: MMA MMA JIZOS MMAMMA JIZOS, EKELE;

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Ekele! (Ekele) Ekele o, keleere m Eze Jizos, Nwoke di ike, odogwu, Eze ka eze, nwoke mara mma, (Dike meriri onwunwa merie onwu) Nara ekele mu o, Biko, nara otito nke m na-ebunye gi. (Ana m ekele gi.)

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: A piara gi ihe n' ihi mu o;(A gbara gi oto n' ihi mu o)E kpubere gi okpu ogwu n' ihi mu o; (E bunyere gi obe n' ihi mu o)A mara gi ube (n' ihi mu o);E nyere gi mkpari (n' ihi mu o); A kpogidere gi n' obe (N' ihi mu o); I nwuru onwu, noo abali ato n' ili n' ihi mu o. Ma i bilitere n' onwu: Ekele dirj Eze ka eze, ekele, Merie ekwensu (ref) Sachapu mmehie mu o. (ref)(Ana m ekele gi.)

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: (N'ime ihe oma niile ndi a i meere m, Dinwenu,) Onu m ezughi oke iji wee kelee gi. Ma site n' ihunaanya na ebere I nwere n' ebe m no, Nabata nwa gi o, nabata ekele mu o. (Ana m ekele gi.)

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Ana m ekwe gi nkwa,Site taa, Eze Jizos,Na m ga-edobe iwu Chukwu Nna,Hu mmadu ibe m n' anya.Jukwa ekwensu na oru ya niile.(Na otito ya, na nduhie ya niile.)Nyere m aka, biko, biko, Jizos.(Ana m ekele gi.)

hymns.refrain: Onye nwuru n' obe maka mmehie m Wee zoo mu o; Eze m Jizos, nara ekele mu o, otito mu o, Nara mbuli elu mu o; ! zoro mu n'agbu nke njo.

hymns.title: MMUO NSO ABIAKWASILA M. MMUO NSO
hymns.attribution: Mee ha ka ha zuo oke.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Ihe nke Mmuo Nso gbasara n' ebe niile. Ozi ya gbasara na mba niile.O zigara m ka m kwusaa, Aga m eji añuri Kowaputa oru ebube niile nke Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Onye nuru olu nke nwaaturu ahu,Rubere ya isi gbasaa aka nsogbu ya niile, O ga-enweta nchegha na ogwugwo Si n' ozioma ya di nso.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Ezi olu nke Mmuo Nso di egwu,Dikwa itunaanya O na-etiwa osimiri abuo, Dufee ndi ji nkuzi nke ndu; O na-asi ha: "kwue, egwu atula unu N' oru unu niile, aga m ano n'etiti, Buru onye mgbazi obi unu."

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Nchegha nke obi si n' ike nke Mmuo Nso; Inu okwu kwere si n' aka oru ya; O bu ya na-ejiko oru niile,

hymns.refrain: na nsogbu ozioma; Ka m gwoo ndi njo cheghara echegha.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Mmuo Nso nke si n'igwe Nuru olu anyi. Onye nkasiobi Nuru olu anyi.Bianu nduru nke igwe, Mekwaa ka o buru ebe obibi gi.K'anyi wee ziputa n'ime ndu anyi Onye obioma;O juputakwara n' ihunaanya,

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Mmuo Nso nke si n' igwe Nuru olu anyi.Onye ndu umu Chukwu Nuru olu anyi. Bia, oku nke amara,N' ime obi anyi. Chupu ihe niile, Bu nke na-ekwesighi umu nke Chukwu: Tichie ihe nke gi, Mmuo nke eziokwu, K'anyi dikwa ka umu Chukwu,n'ihina, O bu onye eziokwu, onye dikwa nso, Isi iyi nke ndu; O juputakwara n' ima mma, Na ezi omume ruo mgbe niile.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Mmuo Nso nke si n' igwe,Nuru olu anyi.Olu nke Chineke Nuru olu anyi.Bia, onye nkuzi nke igwe K' obi anyi juputa n' ekele oma,K' ire anyi juputa n' otito,n' ihina,Chukwu juru anya, o di omimi,O gbara gharii. nso.

hymns.title: METU ONU KA | HU

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Metu onu ka i hu na Dinwenu di mma. Onye riri ya aguu agaghi igu ya ozo. Metu onu ka i hu na Dinwenu di mma. (Ref.)

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Achicha si n'igwe abiago n'uwa. (Ref.) Nri nke ndi Mmuooma ka mmadu na-eri. (Ref./Koros)

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Onyenweanyi na-ato uto mai metu ya onu.(Ref.) Ihe oriri naoñuñu diomimi ka anyi na-eri.(Rel/Koros)

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: O si n'igwe wedatara anyi ihe oriri. (Ref)Umu Chineke bianu rie nri di nso. (Ref/Koros)

hymns.refrain: Bianu rie, bianu ñuo.Onye riri ya aguu agaghi igu ya ozo. D.S.

hymns.title: NARANU M RIE UMU CHINEKE NARANU

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Chukwu Nwa si n'eluigwe bia n'uwa, O Jesu Kristi.(Jesu tara ahuhu.) O tara ahuhu, O nwuru onwu N'ihi mu na gi. (O lara n'igwe.) Mana tupu o laa n'igwe, Tupu o lakwuru nna ya, (Dinwenu) Jesu mere onwe ya Achicha nke ndu, Achicha si n'igwe, Nri na-enye añuri (Nva ndu), ebighebi. (Jesu na-akpo anyi.)

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: ("Ahu m bu ihe oriri, Obara m bu ihe oñunu.") Nke a bu okwu nke Dinwenu. (Kristi ekwugonu) Onye obula, (Onyenweanyi kwuru si nu), Onye obula, (Dinwenu kwuru si) Onye obula, nke riri ahu m; (Chukwu Nwa kwuru wee si) Onye obula, (Onye nzoputa enwugonu), Onye obula, (Jesu kwuru si), Onye obula, nke ñuru obara m, Onye ahu ga-enwe ndu n'ezie ebighebi, (Jesu na-akpo anyi.)

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: $ (Jesu, Achicha di nso) D.$. Oge nna nna anyi ha no n'ozara, Chukwu nyere ha achicha si n'igwe n'udi mnana. Mana ugbua, n'oge nke anyi, Chukwu nyere anyi nwa ya, Jesu Kristi, achicha di ndu.Jesu, Onye nzoputa Jesu, Nwaaturu e jiri chuo aja Jesu, Onye kpochapuru

hymns.refrain: Naranu m ñuo, obara Dinwenu Nri na-enye ndu, Ndu ebighebi, Nri ndi Mmuoozi, Nri si n'igwe gbadata. O bu Kristi na-akpo gi, bia, (Naranu m ñuo obara m o). Nwanne m bia, Kristi na-akpo gi. Nwanne m bia, Onyenweanyi na-akpo gi. Naranu m rie, Nke a bu ahu mu o. Naranu m ñuo, Nke a bu obara mu o. Nwanne m bia, Rie nri si n'igwe gbadata, Iko ngozi, obara Dinwenu

hymns.title: NARA, O CHUKWU

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Ekele diri gi, Oseburuwa, Chineke nk'uwa niile.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: N'ihi n'o bu n'uju afooma gi, K'anyi siri nata achicha anyi na-enye gi.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: N'ezie, o bu, ihe aka oru mmadu Si n'ihe ala micara meputa.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Ma anyi i a-prio gi, Ka i mee ka o ghooro anyi

hymns.refrain: Anyi na-enye gi.

hymns.title: NARA ONYINYE ANYI, CHINEKE,MEERE ANYI EBERE,NURU

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Ekene diri gi, Oseburuwa,Chineke nke uwa niile,Onye nzoputa.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: O bu n'uju afooma gi,K'anyi siri nata achicha Anyi na-enye gi.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: N'ezie, o bu ihe aka mmadu Siri n'ihe ala mitara wee meputa

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Mana anyi n'ario gi,Ka i mee ka o ghoro anyi Achicha na-enye ndu,Achicha nzoputa.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Chukwu Nna,nara onyinye nke umu gi: Nara onyinye gozie, Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Nara, Chineke di afooma:

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Chineke Nna doo, nara onyinye anyi:

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Ihe m nwere ka m ji ekele;

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Chukwu Nna nara onyinye nke umu gi:

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: O bu onyinye kachasi mma:

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: Chukwu Nna di ebube, anyi ekele gi:

verses.label: VERSE 8
verses.text: Nara ya ka o ruo n'eluigwe:

verses.label: VERSE 9
verses.text: Zitere anyi ndu nke si n'igwe:

verses.label: VERSE 10
verses.text: So otu Nwa ahu biara ka o gbaputa anyi:

verses.label: VERSE 11
verses.text: Chukwu Nna na Nwa na Mmuo Nso,Anyi enye gi ekele.

hymns.title: NDI BIARA UKA GA-ANATA NGOZI NDI

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: O bu Dinwenu nwe uwa,n'ihe juru n'ime ya,Uwa nke a na ndi bi n'elu ya.Ka ya wukwasiri ya n'elu osimiri,Mee ka o guzosie ike n'elu mmiri.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Onye ga-arigo ugwu nke Onyenweanyi? Onye ga-abata n'ime ulonso ya? Onye omume ya di nso, onye obi ya di ocha, Onye na-etinyeghi uche ya n'umu ihe na-enweghi isi, Onye na-anaghi añuru mmadu ibe ya iyi aghughọ. O ga-anata ngozi n'aka Onyenweanyi, Natakwa ebere n'aka Chineke onye zoro ha. O sorola n'igwe, umu mmadu na-acho ya. Ndi na-acho ihu Chineke Jekob.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Onuuzo ama bulienu isi unu elu.Bulienu elu onuuzo okpu, ka eze di otito bata. (Onyekwa bu eze ebube a?)O bu Dinwenu, dike di ike, Dinwenu nke siri ike n'agha! Onuuzo ama bulienu isi unu elu.Bulienu elu onuuzo okpu, ka eze di ebube bata. (Onye ka o bu, bu eze ebube a?)Dinwenu nke igwe agha; o bu ya bu eze ebube a!

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Ndi nso nke Chukwu,Nyerenu ya aka;Ndi. Mmuoozi nkeChineke,Zutenu ya;Naranu mkpuruobi ya,Duru ya duga n'ihu nke onye kacha elu.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Ka Kristi onye kporo gi nara gi,Ka ndi Mmuoozi duruo gi n'ezeobi Abraham:Naranu mkpuruobi ya,Duru ya duga n'ihu nke onye kacha elu.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Nye ya ezumike ebighebi, Onyenweanyi,Mekwaa k'ihe di ebighebi chakwasi ya,Duru ya duga n'ihu nke onye kacha elu.

hymns.title: NGI, JESU, BU NDU NKE ANY!

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Okwu ikpeazu Jesu bu: "Hunu onwe unu n'anya,Ka m si wee hu unu n'anya, Ka udo wee di n'etiti unu."

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Kpochapu njo anyi mere, K'anyi were obi ocha Nye gi otito na ebube,Chukwu ebere na ihunaanya.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Anyi bu umu Chineke, Agbaputara n'obara Jesu. O kwesiri k'anyi too Jesu,

hymns.title: NNA, BATA NONYERE M NNA, BATA

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Chineke, noro m nso, Nna,Ka obi m na-esi ike.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Gi bu onye ndu m, Gi bu onye nche m, O dighi ihe ozo m ga-acho.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Mee ka m mara uzo gi, Dinwenu,Kuziere m uzo gi.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Mee m ka m gawa n'eziokwu gi,Kuziere m na i bu Chukwu,

hymns.refrain: Chukwu bu ndu m. So gi bu eze m Chukwu, Chukwu. Nna, bata, bata, Chiwa mkpuruobi m, Ekwela ka ajo mmuo bata.

hymns.title: NNA, KA E MEE UCHE G!

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Nna, biko, Mmuo m siri ike, Ma anuahu m adighi ike.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Pita, o bu n'i nweghi ike iso m Chee nche ruo otu awa?

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Leenu nwa nke mmadu Aranyere n'aka ndi njo.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Kelewenu Chineke doo;Onye amara, onye ukwu;Kelewenu Chineke doo,Onye di ebube, onye oma.

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: Tiwerenu Chineke egwu oma;Gbawaranu Chineke egwu oma;Goriwe na Chineke, nwanne m,!hunaanya ya ebuka.

hymns.refrain: Beereso ma m ñuru ya, Ka e mee uche gi.

hymns.title: NNA, KWUBE, NWOHU GI NA-ANU

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Ụmụ Chineke, bianụ; Bianụ k'anyi jee, Ka Chineke nụrụ okwu nsọ ya; Okwu na-enye ndụ n'ezie. Bianụ k'anyi nụrụ ya.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Ndị otu Kristi, bianụ; Bianụ k'anyi were umeala, Gbuo ikpere n'ihu ya, Gwa ya mkpa anyị; Ka ihe wee dirị anyị mma.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Okwu Chineke bụ ike, Okwu Chineke bụ ike, Okwu Chineke bụ ikike Anyị ji emeri ekwensu, Na ndị ọrụ ya n'ike n'ike.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Gị, nwa Chineke Nwekwaa nghọta siri ike N'okwu Chukwu, Ka i wee gbakwaa mgborogwu n'ime ya. Ka ekwensu ghara inweta gị.

hymns.refrain: Nna, kwube, nwohu gị na-anụ; Kwube, nwohu gị na-anụ; Kwube, nwohu gị na-anụ, Nna; Kwube, nwohu gị na-anụ.

hymns.title: NNA ZITERE NWA YA

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Chukwu si n'eluigwe bịa; Ọ bịara n'udi mmadụ; K'anyi keleenu Chukwu Nna, Onye zitere anyị nwa ya.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Chukwu si n'eluigwe bịa Ileta ụmụ ya; K'anyi keleenu Chukwu Nna, Onye zitere anyị nwa ya.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Mkpụrụobi mụ o, Mkpụrụobi mụ o, Nurịwa na Chineke gị, Onye nzọpụta gị abịala.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Ngozi nke Chineke Erutela ụwa niile; Ngozi nke Chineke, Onye zitere anyị nwa ya.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Amara nke Chineke Erutela ụwa nile; Amara ya zuru oke.

hymns.refrain: Nurịwa na Chineke doo; Nurịwa na Chineke gị o; Nurịwa na Chineke Nna, Onye zitere anyị nwa ya.

hymns.title: NNE DINWENUANY! NNE DINWENUANYI, O BU

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: N'aka nke gi ka Dinwenuanyi;N'oge o nwuru n'elu obe,Tupu o kubie; weere anyi tinye,Mgbe o kwuru si: "lee umu gi"

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Were obioma bugara Jesu Aririo na ukwe ndi nke gi;Echiche ha na omume niile Na ihe mwute mkpuruobi ha.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: N'aka nke gi k'anyi na-etinye Ubochi niile nke ndu anyi,Ma nke taa, ma n'oge onwu,Mgbe anyi ga-esi n'uwa liri.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Chedosie ike idi ocha nk'anyi K'anyi ghara imeru ya;Wepu ihe obula nke ruru inyi K'anyi wee hu Chukwu n'anya.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Nara taa, ekele nk'anyi,Maka inye aka i nyeere anyi;Ezigbo Nne, na ndu anyi niile,K'anyi wee ruo ndu ebeebe.

hymns.refrain: ! bu nchekwube ndi otu Kristi niile, N'ime ahuhu na mkpa.

hymns.title: N'ORIRI DI NSO N'ORIRI DI NSO

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Bia naranu m rie,Bia naranu m ñuo, Jesu gwara anyi niile; Onye riri ahu m, ñuo obara m Ga-ebi n'ime m, munwa ebiri n'ime ya.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Abu m uzo, buru ndu na eziokwu; Jesu gwara anyi nille. Onye sobe m ga-enwe ndu okpu; Ngwanu k'anyi sobe ya.

hymns.refrain: Ndi no n'eluigwe na ndi no n'uwa Emekoria, bie oma, Buru otu n'ime mmuo, (oru ebube), Oru itunaanya, ya na ihe omimi, Chineke bu amamihe n'onwe ya. Ihunaanya ya ebukakwa. Umu mmadu keleenu Chukwu, Doo! Nna, ekele diri gi Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: N'oriri ikpeazu, Jesu rioro Nna ya Ka Nzuko ya buru otu n'elu uwa. Anyi na-ario gi n'oriri nke taa, K'anyi niile soro n'irio Chukwu, K'anyi niile buru otu ahu, N'ime Sakramenti di nso.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Maka Nzuko k'anyi niile na-ario gi Ka ndi otu Kristi ju n'!hunaanya; K'obi mmadu niile n'uwa buru otu; Kpokoba mmadu dum n'akuku gi, K'anyi niile buru otu ahu, N'ime Sakramenti di nsọ.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Anyi na-ario maka ndi otu Kristi, K'i kpoghachi ha n'otu igwe aturu, Ka ha wee noro n'okpuru otu onyeisi Na Nzuko nke jikoro mmadu dum. K'anyi niile buru otu ahu, N'ime Sakramenti di nso.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Oge ga-eru mgbe Sakramenti ga-agwu, O Jesu, kpobata anyi n'eluigwe, K'anyi soro ndi Mmuooma Na ndi nsọ niile Hu gi n'anya n'añuri na ndokwa; K'anyi binyere ebeebe,

hymns.title: NURIANU NA KRISTI EBILITEWO ÑURIANU NA

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Jesu, onyeenu a mara ikpe onwu, Onyeenu a piazachara ahu, (A piara ya ihe, kpube ya okpu ogwu.) Onyeenu e kpubere okpu ogwu, O bilitewo; . Ndiiro ya agbasasichawo.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: (Dinwenu gwara Dinwenu;) "Noro n'aka nri m Ruo na m akwatuchaa ndjiro gi, Meere gi ha, Ebe nzodo ukwu gi." Chukwu emezuwo nkwa o kwere; O Nna, anyi ekelee.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: $ (Biko, nyere m aka,) Kwusawa Kristi n'uva niile, N'otito ya, o biliwo n'onwu; O meriwo onwu n'otito, Nyeghachi anyi ndu n'uju, tobenu; Nyeghachi anyi ndu n'uju ya; Ozo, ñuriwanu. D.$.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: (Biko, bia soro m) ñuria, Ñuria, ñuria, ñuria, Ñurianu, uwa niile; Kwewenu ukwe ngori;

hymns.refrain: Onwu, onwu, onwu, onwu, Oleekwanu ike gi? Ana m aju onwu: (Oleekwanu ike gi?) Njo n'onwe ya: (Oleekwanu ike gi?) Jukwaa ekwensu: (Oleekwanu ike gi?) (O mewo k'o siri kwuo na mbu;) Odogwu, Okaa, Omee; Ñuribanu ndi kwere na Jesu, o, (O ñuribanu na ya) O meriwo onwu n'otito ya o, (O ñuribanu na ya) Ndi kwere na nwa Chukwu, Gazi enwe ndu, ndu ebeebe, Diri anwughi anwu, Ora, biko daalu; Otito diri gi.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Ñuriwa, Ezenwaanyi nke eluigwe; Ñuriwa, Maria; Ñuriwa na ahuhu gi agwuwo; Aleluya; Riowara anyi Chukwu, Riowara anyi Chukwu, o Maria.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Dinwenuanyi, nke i kwesiri ibu Nne ya; Nuriwa, Maria; Nwuo n'obe wee si n'onwu puta Aleluya; Riowara anyi Chukwn, Riowara anyi Chukwu, o Maria.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: O si na ndi nwuru anwu bilite; Nuriwa, Maria. Na-achi n'eluigwe, di ndu ebighebi Aleluya. Riowara anyi Chukwu, Riowara anyi Chukwu, o Maria.

hymns.title: NURIWANU, KA ANYI GORIWENU

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Uwa niile tiwenu mkpu oñu,Kwewenu ukwe otito; N'ihina uwa enwewo onye nzoputa.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: N'uloanu, na Betlehem,Ka a muru Jesu, eze uwa niile;Ngozi puru iche adigoro Vejin Maria, Bu nne onye nzoputa.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Ndi eze ato siri n'Owuwa Anyanwu Jee ebe a muru ya;Ha nyere ya onyinye Olaedo,Frankinsens na Mea;Onyinye a na-enye ndi eze.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: K'anyi soronu ndi Mmuooma Nye Chineke ekele; Otito diri Chineke, N'elu kacha elu.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Nwaanyi biara uka nwa K'anyi na-ekele,O ku nwa ya n'aka dika Maria.Nwaanyi mutara nwa na-enwe añuri; O Chukwu, gozie ya,goziekwa nwa ya. O Chukwu, gozie ya,nara ekpere ya; Ka amara Chineke,wuchaa obi ya. Nwaanyi mutara nwa na-enwe añuri; o Chukwu, gozie ya,goziekwa nwa ya.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Lee ya ka o na-abata n'ulonso Chukwu,O ji oku n'aka ya inye ekele.Nwaanyi mutara nwa na-enwe añuri;O Chukwu, gozie ya,goziekwa nwa ya.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Ufu na-afu nwaanyi Mgbe o na-amu nwa ya,Ma ufu ya na-agwucha Mgbe o muchara ya.Nwaanyi mutara nwa na-enwe añuri;O Chukwu, gozie ya,goziekwa nwa ya.

hymns.refrain: Dinwenu, Eze a muru ohuru; Onye nzoputa uwa niile ablawo.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Nwaanyi biara uka nwa K'anyi na-ekele Ọ kụ nwa ya n'aka dika Maria. Nwaanyi mutara nwa na-enwe añụrị; O Chukwu, gozie ya, goziekwa nwa ya.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: O Chukwu, gozie ya, nara ekpere ya; Ka amara Chineke, wụchaa obi ya. Nwaanyi mutara nwa na-enwe añụrị; O Chukwu, gozie ya, goziekwa nwa ya.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Lee ya ka ọ na-abata n'ụlọ nsọ Chukwu, Ọ ji ọkụ n'aka ya inye ekele. Nwaanyi mutara nwa na-enwe añụrị; O Chukwu, gozie ya, goziekwa nwa ya.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Ụfụ na-afụ nwaanyi Mgbe ọ na-amụ nwa ya, Ma ụfụ ya na-agwụcha Mgbe ọ muchara ya. Nwaanyi mutara nwa na-enwe añụrị; O Chukwu, gozie ya, goziekwa nwa ya.

hymns.title: NWA BU ONYINYE CHUKWU

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Kubata n'ulo Chukwu,Nwata a muru ohuru,Ka Chineke onye na-enye nwa Nara ya gozie. (Maka).

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Lee ka ihu siri buru ha ochi, Obi añuri ka ha ji abia,N'ihu Chineke onye na-enye nwa, Ka o nara ya gozie. (Maka)

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Oge Chineke ka mma, nwanne m,Adogbula onwe gi n'oru,Onyinye Chineke na-abia Mgbe o kwadoro ya!(Nwanne m) chere ya,chere ya, chere ya, Oge Chineke kacha mma. (Maka.)

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Chineke onye obioma, Gozie umuaka e kutere n'ihu gi,Gozie ndi muruha,Nye ha amara gi lji zulite ha,Ka ha nwee ike ito n'egwu nke gi Biko, biko nuru aririo anyi. (Maka)

hymns.refrain: Nwa, nwa, nwa bu ihe oma,Nwa bu onyinye Chukwu.(N'ezie) .

hymns.title: NYENU CHINEKE ANY!ONYINYE DI MMA

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Nyenu Chineke anyi onyinye'di mma, N'ihina Chineke bu onye onyinye Keleenu Chukwu nk'igwe maka ogo ya niile (ref)

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Were ihe di mma Bia nye Chineke anyi, (ref.)Keleenu ya,Chi anyi bu Chukwu di mma,(ref.)

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Keleenu ya,Chi anyi na-echekwa anyi n'ezi o, (ref.)Keleenu ya,Chi anyi na-echekwa anyi n'ulo. (ref.)

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Keleenu ya,Onye obula tuoro ya mmamma, (ref.)Keleenu ya,Gbasapu aka nye ya onyinye, (ref.)

hymns.refrain: Onyinye di mma,Onyinye mara mma, Onyinye si n'obi, O bu ya na-aso Chukwu. D.$.

hymns.title: NYE CHINEKE ONYINYE

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Chineke kechara anyi,si anyi yie ya.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Ya kere igwe na ala na-ejighi ihe kee ha.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Ihe oma niile di n'uwa si n'aka Chukwu bia.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Nye ya ihe di mma,O ga-enyekwa gi ozo.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Olu niile nwere ugwo,ma n'uwa, ma n'igwe.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Anyi ebunye gi, Onyenweanyi,iko nke nzoputa.

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: Na-ario gi ka i kwe ka o bata n'alaeze.

verses.label: VERSE 8
verses.text: Site n' ekpere anyi 'aha ndi di nso.

verses.label: VERSE 9
verses.text: Otito diri Nna na Nwa na Mmuo Nso.

verses.label: VERSE 10
verses.text: Otu o diiri na mbido,ugbua na mgbe niile.

verses.label: VERSE 11
verses.text: N'uwa ebighebi,n'uwatuwa niile. NYENU CHUKWU EKELE KACHA ELU

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: . Nyenu Chukwu ekele kacha elu Kedu ihe oma nke N'o bughi Chukwu nyere gi?Nyenu Nna onyinye Chineke;Kedu onyinye nke N'o bughi Chukwu nyere gi? Nyenu Chukwu otito buru ibu;Kedu ihe oma nke N'o bughi Chukwu nyere gi?

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Nyenu Chukwu ekele kacha elu Onyinye obula, O bughi Chukwu na-enye ha?Nyenu Chukwu otito buru ibu Maka ihunaanya ya n'ebe mmadu no.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Doonu Chukwu ebube kacha elu Eze kacha elu, eze kacha obioma. Doonu Chukwu ebube kacha elu, Ihe obula nọ n'uwa na nke no n'eluigwe.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Toonu Nna na Nwa na Mmuo Nso, Ato n'ime otu di ngozi Na-achi ebighebi.Bia, k'i chiwa n'ime obi anyi, K'anyi nwee ike imeri Onwunwa nke ekwensu.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Chukwu Nna, Nwa, Na Chukwu Mmuo Nso, Anyi na-eto, na-eto, Anyi na-ekele gi.Kwe k'anyi soro ndi Mmuoozi gi Na-eto, na-ekele gi,

hymns.refrain: (Maka,) ngozi Chukwu (ebe anyi no,) Ekele buru ibu, kelee ya, Ekele,ekele K'anyi na-enye gi (Chukwu Nna). D.$

hymns.title: NYENU CHUKWU EKELE KACHA ELU

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Nyenu Chukwu ekele kacha elu Kedu ihe ọma nke N'ọ bụghị Chukwu nyere gị?

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Nyenu Chukwu otito buru ibu; Kedu ihe ọma nke N'ọ bụghị Chukwu nyere gị?

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Doonu Chukwu ebube kacha elu Eze kacha elu, eze kacha obioma. Doonu Chukwu ebube kacha elu.

hymns.refrain: Maka, ngozi Chukwu (ebe anyị nọ,) bụ ibu, kelee ya, Ekele, ekele K'anyi na-enye gị (Chukwu Nna).

hymns.title: NYENU CHUKWU OTITO
hymns.attribution: Ka o ji kee anyi niile.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Nyenu Chukwu otito, Gbasaa n'uwa niile, n'o bu Chukwu, Bu Dinwenu na eze nke ihe niile Tobenu Chukwu, Aleluya; Tobenu Chukwu, Aleluya; Aleluya, Aleluya, Aieluya; Toonu Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Ya kere osimiri, Na aja di n'ime ala, Na urukpu na-ezite mmiri, Na ihe di n'elu uwa.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Bia n'ocheeze nke ya, Bia sekpuoronu ya, Makana o bu so okwu onu ya,

hymns.title: NYERE M AKA, OMARIA (EKWERE M NKWA)
hymns.attribution: Ga-abu ihe a na-eji efe Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Ekwere m nkwa n'ubochi baptiizim, Na aga m efe Chukwu n'elu uwa Na aga m ege nti n'okwu nke Nzuko; Na aga m aju otito nke ajo mmu

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Maka onwe ya ka Chukwu ji kee anyi,K'anyi mara ya wee hu ya n'anya;K'anyi were obi fee ya n'elu uwa,lji binyere ya n'uwa ozo.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Onye okike kechara anyi yie ya,Na mkpuruobi anyi yiri Chukwu;Ma site na mmiri nke Baptiizim A muru anyi ka umu nke Chukwu

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Aja nkiti Chukwu ji kee mmadu;Aja nke juputara n'adighi ike;Baptiizim mere anyi umunna Jesu, Ndi ga-eketa añuri nke eluigwe

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Ahuhu anyi na-ata n'elu uwa,Nchekasi n'oru diiri anyi;Echiche na okwu na omume niile

hymns.refrain: Nyere m aka, o Maria,Ka m wee dobe Ihe m kwere na nkwa. D.$.
