hymns.title: ABBA, ABBA, FATHER

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Mould us, mould us and fashion us into the image of Jesus, your Son of Jesus, your Son.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Father, may we be one in you as he is in you and you are in him and you are in him.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Glory, glory and praise to you, glory and praise to you for ever. Amen. For ever. Amen.

hymns.refrain: The work of your hands.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Abide wwith me,fast falIs the eventide; the darkness deepens, Lord, with me abide! When other helpers fail, And comforts flee, Help of the helpless, O abide with me.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Swift to its close ebbs out life's little day;earth's joys grow dim,its glories pass away;change and decay in all around I see;O thou who changest not,abide with me.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: I need thy presence every passing hour;what but thy grace can foil the tempter's power?Who like thyself My guide and stay can be?Through cloud and sunshine, O abide with me.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: I fear no foe with thee at hand to bless; ills have no weight, and tears no bitterness. Where is death's sting? Where,grave, thy victory?I triumph still,

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Hold thou thy Cross before my closing eyes;shine through the gloom, and earth's vain shadows flee:in life, in death, O Lord abide with me!

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Accept Almighty Father, These gifts of wine and bread Now offered at the altar To you through Christ our head. In humble reparation For sins and failings dread; To gain life everlasting For living and for dead.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: O God,by this co-mingling Of water and of wine May he who took our nature Give us his life divine. Come then, and make us holy Receive this sacrifice; Into your favour take us,

hymns.title: ACCEP T O FATHER IN THY LOVE

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Accept, O Father, in thy love,these humble gifts of bread and wine,that with ourselves we offer th returning gifts already thine.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Behold this host and chalice,Lor To thee in heaven the gifts we raise; Through them may we our homage pay, Our adoration and our praise.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: No earthly claim to grace is ours. Save what thy sacrifice has wor Grant then thy grace, fulfill our needs, And may thy will in ou s be done.

hymns.title: ALL CREATURES OFOU GOD AND KING

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: All creatures of our God and K: Lift up your voice and with us s. Alleluia, alleluia! Thou burning sun with gold beam, Thou silver mo with softer glea O pralse himn, O praise him,Allelula,alleluia,allelula.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Thou rushing wind that art so strong,Ye clouds that sail in heaven along,O praise him, alleluia!

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Thou flowing water,pure and clear,make music for thy Lord to hear,alleluia,alleluia!Thou fire so masterful and bright,That givest man both warmth and light:

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Dear mother earth, who day by day Unfoldest blessings on our way, O praise him, alleluia! The flowers and fruits that in thee grow Let them his glory also show:

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: And all ye men of tender heart,Forgiving others, take your part,O sing ye, alleluia! Ye who long pain and sorrow bear,Praise God and on him cast your care:

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: And thou, most kind and gentle death, Waiting to hush our latest breath, O praise him, alleluia! Thou leadest home the child of God, And Christ our Lord the way hath trod: And worship him in humbleness,O praise him, alleluial Praise, praise the Father,praise the Son, Three in And praise the Spirit, One. W.H.DRAPPER(1855-1933)Based on the Cantico di Frate Sole of St. Francis of Assisi(11821226)

hymns.title: ALL HAIL THE POWER OF JESUS' NAME

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: All hail the power of Jesus' name;Let angels prostrate fall;Bring forth the royal diadem To crown him, crown him Crown him,Crown him Lord of all.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Crown him, ye martyrs of your God, Who from his altar call;Praise him whose way of pain ye trod,And crown him Lord of all.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Ye prophets who our freedom won, Ye searchers, great and small,By whom the work of truth is done, Now crown him Lord of all.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Sinners, whose love can ne'er forget The wormwood and the gall, Go spread your trophies at his feet, And crown him Lord of all.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Bless him, each poor oppressed race That Christ did upward call;His hand in each achlevement trace,And crown him Lord of all.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Let every tribe and every tongue To him their hearts enthral:Lift highn the universal song,And crown him Lord of all.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Thou art the King of Israel,Thou David's royal Son,Who in the Lord's name comest,The King and blessed one.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: The company of angels Are praising thee on high,And mortal men and all things Created make reply.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: The people of the Hebrews With palms before thee went:Our praise and prayer and anthems Before thee we present.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: To thee before thy passion They sang their hymns of praise;To thee now high exalted Our melody we raise.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Thou didst accept their praises,Accept the prayers we bring,Who in all good delightest,Thou good and gracious king.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Bless the Lord, O my soul!And never forget his gifts.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Bless the Lord, O my soul!He pardons all our sins.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Bless the Lord, O my soul!He saves us from all harm.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Bless the Lord, O my soul!He fills our life with good.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Bless the Lord, O my soul!He keeps us ever young.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Bless the Lord, O my soul!His mercy never ends.

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: Bless the Lord, O my soul!His kindness never ends.

verses.label: VERSE 8
verses.text: Bless theLord, O my soul!His promises he keeps.

verses.label: VERSE 9
verses.text: Bless the Lord, O my soul!He died to bring us life.

verses.label: VERSE 10
verses.text: Bless the Lord, O my soul!He is the Bread of life.

verses.label: VERSE 11
verses.text: Bless the Lord, O my soul!In him we find all love.

hymns.title: ALL PEOPLE THAT ON EARTH DO DWELL

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: All people that on earth do dwell,Sing to the Lord with cheerful voice;Him serve with fear,his praise forth tell,Come ye before him and rejoice.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: The Lord, ye know, is God indeed,Without our aid he did us make;We are his folk, he doth us feed And for his sheep he doth us take.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: O enter then his gates with praise,Approach with joy his courts unto,Praise, laud, and bless his name always For it is seemly so to do.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: For why? The Lord our CGodisgoo His mercy is for ever sure;His truth at all timesfirmlystood And shall from age toageendure

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: To Father, Son and HolyGhost,The God whom heaven and earth adore, From men and from the angel-host Be praise and glory evermore,

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Heavenly choirs of angels rejoice and give praise,As Mary the Virgin rises on high

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: I see her, lovely as fiery dawn breaking forth,A glow like the sun resplendent above.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: I see her lovely radiantly reigning above As queen of the Heavens,close to her son.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: See her ascend, a vapor of incense and myrrh,A radiant mist, a fragrant perfume.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: O let all ages rise up in praise of your son,Proclaiming his name as Jesus the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: O Virgin Mary, queen of all angels and men,O full of his grace,

hymns.title: ALL THE EARTH PROCLAIM THE LORD

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Serve you theLord, hearts filled With gladness.Come into his presence, singing For joy!

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Know that the Lord is our creator,Yes, he is our Father;we are his sons.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: We are the sheep of his green pasture,For we are his people;he is our God.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Enter his gates bringing thanksgiving,O enter his courts while singing his praise.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Our Lord is good, his love enduring, His word is abiding now with all men.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Honour and praise be to the Father, The Son, and the Spirit, world without end. Lucien Deiss

hymns.title: ALL YE WHO SEEK A COMFORT SURE

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: All ye who seek a comfort sure In trouble and distress,Whatever sorrow vex the mind,Or guilt the soul oppress.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Jesus, who gave himself for you Upon the cross to die,Opens to you his sacred heart;Oh, to that heart draw nigh.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Ye hear how kindly he invites;Ye hear his words so blest:'All ye that labour come to me,And I wil give you rest'.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Jesus, thou joy of saints on high,Thou hope of sinners here,Attracted by those loving words To thee I lift my prayer.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Wash thou my wounds in that dear blood,Which forth from thee doth flow;New grace, new hope inspire, a new And better heart bestow.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Joyfully shout, all you on earth,Give praise to the glory of God;And with a hymn Sing out his glorious praise:Alleluia!.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Lift up your hearts,sing to your God: Tremendous his deeds among men! Vanquished your foes, Struck down by power and might:Alleiuia!

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Let all the earth kneel in his sight,Extolling his marvelous fame;Honour his name,In highest heaven give praise:Alleluia!

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Come forth and see all the great works That God has brought forth by his might;

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Parting the seas with might and power,He rescued his people from shame;Let us give thanks For all his merciful deeds: Alleluia!

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: His eyes keep watch on ail the earth,His strength is forever renewed;And let no man Rebel against his commands:Alleluia!

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: Tested are we by God the Lord,As silver is tested by fire;Burdened with pain,We fall ensnared in our sins:Alleluia!

verses.label: VERSE 8
verses.text: Over our heads wicked men rode,We passed through the fire and the flood;Then, Lord, you brought

verses.label: VERSE 9
verses.text: Glory and thanks be tothe Father;Honour and praise to the Son;And to the Spirit,Source of life and of love:

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Alleluia, sing to Jesus, His the sceptre, his the throne Alleluia, his the triumph, His the victory alone; Hark the songs of peaceful Sion Thunder like a mighty flood: Jesus, out of every nation, Hath redeemed us by his blood. . Alleluia, not as orphans Are we left in sorrow now; Alleluia, he is near us, Faith believes, nor questions how; Though the cloud from sight received him When the forty days were o'er, Shall our hearts forget his promise, 'I am with you evermore'.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Alleluia, Bread of Angels,Thou on earth our food our stay; Alleluia, here the sinful Flee to thee from day to day; Intercessor, friend of sinners, Earth's Redeemer, plead for me, Where the songs of all the sinless Sweep across the crystal sea.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Alleluia, King eternal Thee the Lord of lords we own; Alleluia, born of Mary, Earth thy footstool, heaven thy throne; Thou within the veil hast entered, Robed in flesh, our great High Priest; Thou on earth both priest and victim In the Eucharistic Feast.

hymns.title: AND CAN IT BE

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: And can it be that I should gain An interest in the Saviour's blood, Died he for me who caused his pain For me who him to death pursued Amazing love how can it be that Thou my God shouldst die for me?

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: 'Tis mystery all! The immortal dies!Who can explore his strange design? In vain the first born seraph tries To sound the depth of love divine!'Tis mercy all, let earth adore, Let angel minds inquire no more.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: He left his father's throne above So free, so infinite, his grace;Emptied himself of all his love,And bled for Adam's helpless race;'Tis mercy all, immense and free;For, O my God, it found out me.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Long my imprisoned spirit lay Fast bound in sin and nature's night;Thine eye diffused a quickening ray I woke, the dungeon flamed with light; My chains fell off, my heart was free;I rose, went forth, and followed thee.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: No condemnation now I dread;Jesus, and all in him, is mine!Alive in him, my living Head.And clothed in righteousness divine, Bold I approach the eternal throne, And claim the crown,

hymns.refrain: Amazing love! How can it be That thou my God shouldst die for me? D$.

hymns.title: A NEW COMMANDMENT

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: By this shall mankind know you are my disciples. If you have love one for another. By this shall mankind know you are my disciples. If you have love one for another.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: You are my friends if you do what command you. Without my help you can do nothing. You are my friends if you do whatl command you. Without my help you can do nothing.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: I am the true vine, my father is the gard'ner. Abide in me: I will be with you.Iam the true vine, my father is the gard'ner. Abide in me: I wilI be with you.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: True love is patient,not arrogant nor boastful;Love bears all things, love is eternal. True love is patient, not arrogant nor boastful; Love bears all things,

hymns.refrain: Aslhave loved you.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Angels, from the realms of glory,Wing your flight o'er all the earth;Ye, who sang creation's story,Now proclaim Messiah's birth.Come and worship,come and worship. Worship Christ the new-born King.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Shepherds in the fields abiding,Watching o'er your flocks by night.God in man is now residing;Yonder shines the infant light,Come and worship, come and worship.Worship Christ the new-born King.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Sages, leave your contemplations.Brighter visions gleam afar;Seek the great Desire of nations;Ye have seen his natal star,Come and worship,come and worship.Worship Christ the new-born King.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Saints before the altar bending Watching long in hope and fear.Suddenly the Lord descending,In His temple shall appear,Come and worship,come and worship.Worship Christ the new-born King.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Angel-voices ever singing Round thy throne of light,Angel-harps for ever ringing,Rest not day nor night;Thousands only live to bless thee And confess thee Lord of might.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Thou who are beyond the farthest Mortal eye can scan,Can it be that thou regardest Songs of sinful mman?Can we know that thou art near us, And wilt hear us? Yes, we can.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Yes, we know that thou rejoicest O'er each work of thine;Thou didst ears and hands and voices For thy praise design;Craftsman's art and music's measure for thy pleasure all combine.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: In thy house, great God, we offer of thine own to thee;and for thine acceptance proffer ail unworthily;hearts and minds and hands and voices in our choicest psalmody.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Honour, glory, might and merit thine shall ever be, Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, Blessed Trinity! Of the best that thou has given earth and heaven render thee.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Angel-voices ever singing Round thy throne of light, Angel-harps for ever ringing, Rest not day nor night; Thousands and ten thousands stand With harps and voices in their hands.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Thou who art beyond the farthest Mortal eye can scan, Can it be that thou regardest Songs of sinful man? Can we know that thou art near And wilt hear us? Yes, we can.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Yes, we know that thou rejoicest O'er each work of thine; Thou didst ears and hands and voices For thy praise design; Craftsman's art and music's measure For thy pleasure all combine.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: In thy house, great God, we offer of thine own to thee; and for thine acceptance proffer all unworthily. Hearts and minds and hands and voices In our choicest melody.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Honour, glory, might and merit thine shall ever be, Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, Blessed Trinity! Of the best that thou has given earth and heaven render thee.

hymns.title: ANGELS WE HAVE HEARD IN HEAVEN

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Angels we have heard in heaven sweetly singing o'er our plains, and the mountain-tops in answer echoing their joyous strains. Gloria in excelsis Deo.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Shepherds, why this exultation? Why your rapturous strain prolong? Tell us of the gladsome tidings, which inspire your joyous song.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Come to Bethlehem, and see him o'er whose birth the angels sing, come, adore, devoutly kneeling, Christ the Lord, the new-born king.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: See him ina manger lying whom the choir of angels praise! Mary, Joseph, come to aid us while our hearts in love we raise.

hymns.title: ANGELS WE HAVE HEARD ON HIGH

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Angels we have heard on high sweetly singing o'er our plains, and the mountains in reply echo still their joyous strains. Gloria in excelsis Deo.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Shepherds, why this jubilee? Why your rapturous strain prolong Say, what may your tidings be, which inspire your heavenly song

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Come to Bethlehem and see him whose birth the angels sing: come, adore on bended knee the infant Christ, the new-born King.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: See withina manger laid, Jesus, Lord of heaven and earth! Mary, Joseph, lend your aid to celebrate our Saviour's hirth.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Amazing grace! How sweet the sound that saved a wretch like me.I once was lost but now I'm found,was blind, but now I see.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: 'Twas grace that taught my heart to fear,and grace my fears relieved.How precious did that grace appear the hour I first believed.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Through many dangers,toils and snares I have already come.'Tis grace hath brought me safe thus far,and grace will lead me home.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: The Lord has promised good to me;His word my hope secures.He will my shield and portion be as long as life endures.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Have you been to Jesus for the cleansing power?Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?.Are you fully trusting in his grace this hour?Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb? Are you washed, (are you washed,)In the blood, (in the blood,)In the soul-cleansing blood of the Lamb? (Of the Lamb?)Are your garments spotless?Are they white as snow?Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Are you walking daily by the Saviour's side?Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?Do you rest each moment in the Crucified?Are you washed in the Blood of the Lamb?

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: When the bridegroom cometh will your robes be white?Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?Will your soul be ready for the mansions bright And be washed in the blood of the Lamb?

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Lay aside the garments that are stained with sin,And be washed in the blood of the Lamb;There's a fountain flowing for the soul unclean,O be washed in the blood

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Asleep in Jesus, blessed sleep,From which none ever wakes to weep. A calm and undisturbed repose. Unbroken by the last of foes.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Asleep in Jesuis, oh how sweet,To be for such a slumber meet.With holy confidence to sing.That death hath lost its venomed sting.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Asleep in Jesus, peaceful rest Whose waking is supremely blest.No fear, no woe, shall dim the hour That manifests theSaviour's power.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Asleep in Jesus, oh for me,May such a blissful refuge be,Securely shall my ashes lie,And wait the summons from on high.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Asleep in Jesus, far from thee thy kindreds and their graves may be But thine is still a blessed sleep from which none ever wakes to weep. AS WITH GLADNESS MEN OF OLD

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: As with gladness men of old,did the guiding star behold,as with joy they hailed its light,leading onward, beaming bright,so, most gracious God, may we evermore be led to thee.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: As with joyful steps they sped,to that lowly manger-bed,there to bend the knee before him whom heaven and earth adore,so may we with willing feet ever seek thy mercy-seat.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: As they offered gifts most rare,at that manger rude and bare,so may we with holy joy,pure, and free from sin's alloy,all our costliest treasures bring,Christ, to thee our heavenly King.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Holy Jesu, every day keep us in the narrow way;and, when earthly things are past;bring our ransomed souls at last where they need no star to guide,where no clouds thy glory hide.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: In the heavenly country bright need they no created light,thou its Light,its Joy, its Crown,thou its Sun which goes not down;there for ever may we sing alleluias to our King.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Asleep in Jesus, blessed sleep, From which none ever wakes to weep. A calm and undisturbed repose. Unbroken by the last of foes.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Asleep in Jesus, oh how sweet, To be for such a slumber meet. With holy confidence to sing That death hath lost its venomed sting.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Asleep in Jesus, peaceful rest Whose waking is supremely blest. No fear, no woe, shall dim that hour That manifests the Saviour's power.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Asleep in Jesus, oh for me, May such a blissful refuge be, Securely shall my ashes lie And wait the summons from on high.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: At the name of Jesus every knee shall bow,every tongue confess him King of glory now;'tis the Father's pleasure we should call him Lord,who from the beginning,was the mighty Word.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: At his voice creation sprang at once to sight,all the Angel faces,all the hosts of light,thrones and dominations,stars upon their way,all the heavenly orders,in their great array.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Humbled for a season,to receive a name from the lips of sinners unto whom he came,faithfully he bore it spotless to the last,brought it back victorious when from death he passed:

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Bore it up triumphant with its human light through all ranks of creatures,to the central height,to the throne of Godhead,to the Father's breast,filled it with the glory of that perfect rest.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Name him, brothers, name him,with love as strong as death;but with awe and wonder,and with bated breath. He is God the Saviour, he is Christ the Lord, ever to be worshipped, trusted, and adored.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: In your hearts enthrone him;there let him subdue all that is not holy,all that is not true;crown him as your captain,in temptation's hour let his will enfold you in its light and power.

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: Brothers, this Lord Jesus shall return again,with his Father's glory,with his angel train,for all wreaths of empire meet upon his brow, and our hearts confess him King of glory now.

hymns.title: AVE MARIA, O MAIDEN, O MOTHER

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Away in a manger,no crib for a bed, the little Lord Jesus thine are the graces unclaimed laid down his sweet head,by another, sinless and beautiful Star looked down where he lay,of the sea. Mater amabilis, ora pro nobis, asleep on the hay.pray for thy children who call upon thee; 2. The cattle are lowing, Ave sanctissima, Ave purissima the baby awakes,sinless and beautiful Star of the sea. no crying he makes.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Ave Maria, the night shades I love thee, Lord Jesus!are falling, softly, our voices arise unto thee; and stay by my side,earth's lonely exiles for succour are calling, sinless and beautiful Star of the sea. 3. Be near me, Lord Jesus;I ask thee to stay

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Ave Maria, thy children are close by me for ever,kneeling, words of endearment are and love me, I pray.murmured to thee;softly thy spirit upon us is stealing, of the sea.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Away in a manger, no crib for a bed, the little Lord Jesus laid down his sweet head, the stars in the bright sky looked down where he lay, the little Lord Jesus asleep on the hay.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: The cattle are lowing, the baby awakes, but little Lord Jesus no crying he makes. I love thee, Lord Jesus! Look down from the sky, and stay by my side, until morning is nigh.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Be near me, Lord Jesus; I ask thee to stay close by me for ever, and love me, I pray. Bless all the dear children in thy tender care, and fit us for heaven, to live with thee there.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: A great and mighty wonder, A full and holy cure; The virgin bears the infant, With virgin honour pure. Repeat the hymn again; To God on high be glory, And peace on earth to men.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: The word becomes incarnate,And yet remains on high;And cherubim sing anthems,To shepherds from the sky.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: While thus they sing your monarch,Those bright angelic bands;Rejoice, yet vales and mountains,Ye oceans, clap your hands.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Since all he comes to ransom,By all be he adored; The infant born in Bethle'em,

hymns.title: ALL THINGS BRIGHT AND BEAUTIFUL

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Each little flower that opens, Each little bird that sings, He made their glowing colours, He made their tiny wings.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: The purple-headed mountain, The river running by, The sunset and the morning, That brightens up the sky.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: The cold wind in the winter, The pleasant summer sun, The ripe fruits in the garden, He made them every one.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: The tall trees in the greenwood, The meadows for our play, The rushes by the water, To gather every day.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: He gave us eyes to see them, And lips that we may tell How great is God Almighty, Who has made all things well.

hymns.refrain: All things wise and wonderful, The Lord God made them all.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Almighty Father, take this bread Thy people offer thee;Where sins divide us, take instead One fold and family.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: The wine we offer soon will be Christ's blood, redemption's price;Receive it, Holy Trinity,This holy sacrifice.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: O God, by angels' choirs adored,Thy name be praised on earth,On all men be that peace outpoured Once promised at his birth.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: A mighty stronghold is our God,A sure defence and weapon.He'll help us out of every need Whatever now may happen. The ancient evil fiend Has deadly ill in mind; Great power and craft are his, His armour gruesome is On earth is not his equal.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: With our own strength is nothing done Soon we are lost, dejected; Christ Jesus it is he,The Lord Sabaoth's Son, Our God, and he alone Shall hold the field victorious.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: And though the world were full of fiends All lurking to devour us, We tremble not nor fear their bands, They shall not overpower us. The prince of this world's ill May scowl upon us still, He cannot do us harm, To judgment he has come; One word can swiftly fell him.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: The Word they must allow/ to stand For this they win no merit;Upon the field, so near at hand,He gives to us his Spirit.And though they take our life,Goods, honour, child, and wife.Though we must let all go; They will not profit so: To us remains the Kingdom. Martin Luther (1483-1546

hymns.title: ARISE, SHINE

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: (For behold the darkness shall cover) Behold darkness shall cover the earth, (For behold the darkness shall cover) Behold darkness shall cover the earth, For behold the darkness shall cover the earth.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: (His glory shall be seen upon thee) His glory shall be seen upon thee, (His glory shall be seen upon thee) His glory shall be seen upon thee, And his glory shall be seen upon thee.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: (Gentiles shall come to thy light) Kings to the brightness of thy rising, ·· (Gentiles shall come to thy light) Kings to the brightness of thy rising, For the glory of God is risen upon thee. ASK, AND YOU WILL RECEIVE Ask, and you will receive. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and the door will be opened For the love of the Lord has no end.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Is there any man here, When his son asks for bread, Would turn him away With a stone instead? Is there any man here, When his son asks for meat, Would then give him A poisonous snake to eat?

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: So then how could your Father In heaven above, Who knows so mmuch more Of the ways of love, So then how could your Father Refuse what is good, When you ask in the name Of the Son he loves?

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: So whatever you ask You will always receive, Whatever you seek You wilI always find. For my Father will give To all those who believe in the Spirit of love That will never end.

hymns.refrain: Lord is risen.

hymns.title: ASK, AND YOU WILL RECEIVE

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Is there any man here, When his son asks for bread, Would turn him away With a stone instead? Is there any man here, When his son asks for meat, Would then give him A poisonous snake to eat?

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: So then how could your Father In heaven above, Who knows so much more Of the ways of love, So then how could your Father Refuse what is good, When you ask in the name Of the Son he loves?

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: So whatever you ask You will always receive, Whatever you seek You will always find. For my Father will give To all those who believe in the Spirit of love That will never end.

hymns.refrain: Ask, and you will receive. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and the door will be opened For the love of the Lord has no end.

hymns.title: ACCEPT THE GIFTS WE OFFER

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Father, accept the gifts we offer; Have mercy and hear our prayer The almighty God, bless our offering; (ref.)

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Jesus, we bringour gifts before you; (ref.) Present them to the father, That his will may be done; (ref.)

hymns.refrain: May the HHoly Spirit Descend on the alter, Sanctify the sacrifice; May it be acceptable To the father through the son. D.$.

hymns.title: BEHOLD AMONG MEN

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: People called by God through the word of the prophets; People brought together in the house of the Lord; People who attend to their Lord, The church of Christ the Lord!

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Temple built by saints, by the martyrs and apostles; Holy temple built upon Christ the corner stone; Holy dwelling place of our God, The Church of Christ the Lord!

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: People who are born in the waters of the Spirit; People who are marked by the seal of theSpirit; People in the Spirit made one, The Church of Christ the Lord!

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: People who are grafted on Jesus the vine; Branches bearing fruit in the graceof the Lord; Branches rooted in his great love, The Church of Christ the Lord!

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: People nourished now by the body of the Lord; People who sit down to the new paschal supper; Who shall pass from death into life,The Church of Christ the Lord!

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: People justified by the grace of the Spirit; People who are heirs of an everlasting life; People now enlightened by Christ, The Church of Christ the Lord!

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: People called in faith to be quickened by his life; People called by God from the darkness into light; Holy people called to be royal, The Church of Christ the Lord!

verses.label: VERSE 8
verses.text: People whom the Lord has acquired for his praise; People who put trust in the Lord Jesus Christ; People called by God for his own, The Church of Christ the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 9
verses.text: People who proclaim the great glory of the Father; By the lord, Jesus Christ, his only Son; And in the Spirit give praise, The Church of Christ the Lord! (Fr. Lucien Deiss, C.S.Sp.)

hymns.refrain: And he shall be their Lord and God!

hymns.title: BEHOLD THE SAVIOUR KING

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Earth and heaven men embrace; Sun and moon in cloud rejoice;Twinkle twinkle smile the stars; Now at last the child is born.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Far, far from the East;Seeking searching star-led king Homage treasure gladly bringing;Frankincense and Gold and Myrrh.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Joy, joy, fills the air, Shepherds' children spread the news; Mother Mary ponders deep: Here behold the Saviour King.

hymns.refrain: the Cherubs; Worthy, Worthy, flap the seraphs; Lowly, Lowly, bow the thrones.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Bethlehem! Of noblest cities None can once with thee compare; Thou alone the Lord from heaven Didst for us incarnate bear.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Fairer than the sun at morning Was the star that told his birth Tc the lands their God announcing, Hid beneath a form of earth.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: By its lambent beauty guided, See the eastern kings appear; See them bend, their gifts to offer Gifts of incense, gold and myrrh.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Solemn things of mystic meaning! Incense doth the God disclose; Gold a royal child proclaimeth; Myrrh a future tomb foreshows.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Holy Jesu, in thy brightness To the gentle world display'd With the Father and the Spirit Endless praise to thee be paid. Aurelius Prudentius (348-413),

hymns.title: BIND US TOGETHER, LORD

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: There is only one God, There is only one King, There is only one Body, That is why we sing:

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Fit for the glory of God, Purchased by His precious blood Born with the right to be free, Jesus the victory has won.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: We are the family of God, We are the promise divine, We are God's chosen desire, We are the glorious new wine.

hymns.refrain: Bind us together, Lord, Bind us together, Bind us together with love.

hymns.title: BLESSED ARE THEY (THE BEATITUDES)

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Blest the poor in spirit, For theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Blest the gentle, For they shall inherit the earth.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Blest those who mourn, For they shall be comforted.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Blest those who hunger and thirst for justice, For they shall be satisfied.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Blest the merciful, For they shall have mercy shown them.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Blest the pure in heart, For they shall see God.

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: Blest the peacemakers, For they shall be called sons of God.

verses.label: VERSE 8
verses.text: Blest those who suffer for righteousness, For theirs is the kingdom of Heaven.

hymns.refrain: Blessed are they who follow God's law And walk in his way: The Kingdom is theirs.

hymns.title: BLESSED ASSURANCE

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Blessed assurance, Jesus is mine, Oh what a foretaste of glory divine. Heir of salvation, purchase of God, Born of his spirit, washed in his blood.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Perfect submission, perfect delight, Visions of rapture now burst on my sight. Angels descending, bring from above Echoes of mercy, whispers of love.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Perfect submission, all is at rest. I in my saviour am happy and blest. Watching and waiting, looking above, Filled with his goodness, lost in his love.

hymns.refrain: This is my story, this is my song. Praising my saviour, all the day long. This is my story, this is my song.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Blessed Lamb! On calvary's mountain. Slain to take our sins away, Let the drops of that rich fountain, Our tremendous ransom pay: Sacred Saviour! Sacred Saviour! Lowly at thy feet we pray!

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Blessed Lamb! Vouchsafe us pardon, In thy love our souls confide: By thy groans within the garden, By the death which thou hast died. Let thy passion, let thy Passion Evermore with us abide!

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: So shall peace, sweet peace be given. Purchase of thy precious pain; So shall earth but lead to heaven, Since for us the Lamb was slain: Dear Redeemer! Dear Redeemer! Thou canst not have died in vain.

hymns.title: BLEST ARE THE PURE IN HEART

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Blest are the pure in heart, For they shall see our God; The secret of the Lord is theirs; Their soul is Christ's abode.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: The Lord who left the heavens Our life and peace to bring, To dwell in lowliness with men, Their pattern and their king.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Still to the lowly soul He doth himself impart, And for his dwelling and his throne Chooseth the pure in heart.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Lord, we thy presence seek; May ours this blessing be: Give us a pure and lowly heart, A temple meet for thee.

hymns.title: BREATHE ON ME, BREATH OF GOD

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Breathe on me, Breath of God, Fill me with life anew, That I may love what thou dost love, And do what thou wouldst do.

hymns.title: BREATHING THE WORDS OF HUMBLE OBEDIENCE (MAGNIFICAT)

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: My soul magnifies the Lord And my spirit rejoices in God my king Henceforth all men will call me blessed Because God has done great things for me.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: His mercy spans each generation On those who fear him, holy is his name, He has shown the might of his arm, The proud he scattered with all their plans.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Mighty kings have been tumbled from their thrones, And exalted have been the lowly. He has filled the hungry with good things, The rich sent empty-handed away.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: He has helped his servant Israel, To keep the promise made in time long past: His mercy shown to Abraham, And to all his descendants for ever. Liz Powell and Jean Henriot

hymns.refrain: humble obedience true, Let it be so, and let it be done for you I am the handmaid of the Lord.

hymns.title: BRING TO THE LORD YOUR OFFERINGS

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: O give the Lord you sons of God, Give the Lord glory and power: Give the Lord glory of his name: Adore the Lord in his holy court.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: The Lord's voice resounding on the waters, The Lord on the immensity of waters; The voice of the Lord, full of power, The voice of the Lord, full of splendour.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: The Lord's voice shattering the cedars, The Lord shatters the cedars of Lebanon; He makes Lebanon leap like a calf And Sirion like a young wild-ox.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: The Lord's voice shaking the wilderness, The Lord shakes the wilderness of Kadesh; The Lord's voice rending the oak tree And stripping the forest bare.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: The God of glory thunders. In his temple, they all cry: "Glory!” The Lord sat enthroned over the flood; The Lord sits as king for ever.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Give glory to the Father Almighty, To his Son, Jesus Christ, the Lord, To the Spirit who dwells in our hearts,

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Battle is o'ver, Hell's armies flee: Raise we the cry of victory With abounding joy resounding,Alleluia.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Christ who endured The shameful tree, O'er death triumphant welcome we, Our adoring praise outpouring,Alleluia.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: On the third morn From death rose he, Clothed with what light in heaven shall be, Our unswerving faith deserving, Alleluia.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Hell's gloomy gates, Yield up their key, Paradise door thrown wide we se Never-tiring be our choiring Alleluia.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Lord, by the stripes, Men laid on thee, Grant us to live from death set fre This our greeting still repeating, Alieluia.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: In the Holy Bible, it is written:Therefore, a man should leave His father and his mother,He shall choose a maiden Cleave together Become one flesh in the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Standing before the Lord,is the couple, Who are joined together To share the blessings of God; We come together to share with them May the good Lord, bless their home.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: They will stay together in love and peace;They will pray together and practise Christianity;May the Holy Spirit show them the way,Till the coming of our Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: We remind you brother to love your wife, And we ask you sister be humble and obedient; In sorrow and joy, share together,Keep your promise, fear the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Go and be prayerful, You have to be prayerful; Go home and be prayerful; Leam howw to pray; You must remember to be prayerful.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: A good Christian must be prayerful, When you are tempted; should be prayerful, For a happy home; be prayerful. For good children; be prayerful. For endurance; be prayerful. For peace and love; be prayerful. For understanding; should be prayerful,

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Let us all bless the Lord, Let all his works give praise to him; Let us exalt him forever! Antiphon I: Let us bless the Lord!

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Let us all bless the Lord,All you his angels full of might,All you heavens above in the firmament! Antiphon Il: Let us bless the Lord!

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Bless the Lord, O you hosts,Messengers of the Lord,Let the waters in heaven give praise to him on high! Antiphon IlI:Let us praise the Lord,Praise him!Blessed his name for all ages!

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Bless the Lord, O you sun,And let the moon give praise to him;Starry skies praise and adore him!Antiphon I

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Bless the Lord all you rains,Shower on men his love and joy;All you Winds of the heavens, give praise to him.Antiphon Il

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Bless the Lord, O you fire,Let the heat give him praise,Let the cold worship him and give praise to him on high!Antiphon lll

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: Let the dawn bless the Lord,And let the ice and hoar-frost give.Praise to him; worship, extol him!Antiphon I

verses.label: VERSE 8
verses.text: Bless the Lord mist and snows,And let the night and day give praise; May they worship, exalt him forever more!Antiphon Il

verses.label: VERSE 9
verses.text: Let the light bless the Lord;Darkness, give praise to him;All you lightnings and storm-clou Exalt hisname on high!Antiphon Ill

verses.label: VERSE 10
verses.text: Let the earth bless the Lord,And let the land give praise to hin Worship, exalt him forever!Antiphon I

verses.label: VERSE 11
verses.text: All you mountains and hills,Worship the Lord, adore his nam All you harvests and fruits of the earth give praise!Antiphon Il

verses.label: VERSE 12
verses.text: All you rivers and seas,Worship theLord on high;Let the waters on earth bless th Lord and praise his name!Antiphon Ill

verses.label: VERSE 13
verses.text: All you fish in the sea,Birds of the air, give praise to him Worship, exalt him forever!Antiphon l

verses.label: VERSE 14
verses.text: Israel, bless the Lord;Sons of men,bless and praise his name;All you peoples,extol him forever more!Antiphon Il

verses.label: VERSE 15
verses.text: BlesstheLord,all you flocks;Beastsof the ffields, give praise; Antiphon IlI

verses.label: VERSE 16
verses.text: BlesstheLord all you priests,Let all his servants bless him And worship, exalt him forever! Antiphon /

verses.label: VERSE 17
verses.text: Let us sing to the Lord; Praise to his name, the Father, One with the Son and the Spirit forever more! Antiphon ll

verses.label: VERSE 18
verses.text: Let us all bless the Lord Now and for endless time; And give praise to the Lord Who is throned in majesty! Antiphon IlI

hymns.title: CHILDREN OF THE LORD CHILDREN

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Christians we are now here to worship God. Sing and glorify him with all your heart; Bring all that you have to offer him. Alleluia Amen.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Fathers

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Mothers

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Brothers

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Sisters

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Brethren

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: Pilgrims.

hymns.refrain: Alleluia, Amen Sing alleluia eh! Sing alleluia Alleluia Amen.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Low in the grave he lay, Jesus my Saviour! Waiting the coming day Jesus my Lord! Up from the grave he arose, With a mighty triumph o'er his foes; He arose a victor from the dark domain, And he lives for ever with his saints to reign. He arose. He arose! Alleluia Christ arose.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Vainly they watch his bed, Jesus my Saviour! Vainly/ they seal the dead. Jesus my Lord!

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Death cannot keep his prey,Jesus my Saviour! He torethe bars away Jesus my Lordl

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Christ be beside me, Christ be before me, Christ be behind me, King of my heart. Christ be within me, Christ be below me, Christ be above me, Never to part.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Christ on my right hand, Christ on my left hand, Christ all around me, Shield in the strife. Christ in my sleeping, Christ in my sitting, Christ in my rising, Light of my life.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Christ be in all hearts Thinking about me, Christ be in all tongues Telling of me. Christ be the vision In eyes that see me, In ears that hear me, Christ ever be. Adapted from 'St. Patrick's Breastplate'

hymns.title: CHRIST IS MY ROCK CHRIST
hymns.attribution: And nothing was left to remember his name.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: I know a man who loved to live free, He pitched his tent by the side of the sea. It stood near the surf and was washed by the spray Till one day a wave came and washed it away.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: I know a man who loved to live high. He bullt his castle near up to the sky, Through summer and spring it stood pretty well, When winter winds whistled it toppled and fell.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: I know a man, a cool one to know.He built his house out of ice and of snow. In chill isolation his night work was done, But it melted away with the warm morning sun.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: I know a man who built out of straw. The flimsiest fellow that I ever saw. One day a spark set it to flame,

hymns.refrain: He who has falth bullds without worry. Not like the man who bullds upon sand; I set my house on a solld foundation: Christ is my rock, the root of my soul's recreation.

hymns.title: CHRIST THE LORD IS RISEN TODAY!
hymns.attribution: Wipo 11th c., tr. Jane Elizabeth Leeson.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Christ the Lord is risen today!Christians, haste your vows to pay,Offer ye your praises meet At the paschal victim's feet;For the sheep the Lamb hath bled,Sinless in the sinner's stead.Christ the Lord is ris'n on high;Now he lives, no more to die.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Christ, the victim undefiled,Man to God hath reconciled When in strange and awful strife Met together death and life;Christians, on this happy day,Haste with joy your vows to pay.Christ the Lord is risen on high,Now he lives, no more to die.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Say, O wond'ring Mary, say,What thou sawest on thy way,"I beheld, where Christ had lain,Empty tomb and angels twain,I beheld the glory bright Of the rising Lord of light,Christ my hope is ris'n again;Now he lives, and lives to reign".

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Christ, who once for sinners bled,Now the first-born from the dead,Throned in endless might and power, Lives and reigns for evermore,Hail, eternal hope on high!Hail, thou king of victory!Hail, thou Prince of life adored!Help and save us, gracious Lord.

hymns.title: CHRISTMAS COMES TO BLESS THE EARTH

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Christmas comes to bless the earth,With its wondrous heavenly birth.Bright and high the dawning light,Burning through the gloom of night.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: God hath corne with men to dwell,In this message hard to tell God the Son, the one Divine,Sent below from heaven thine.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Glory to the Father be,Sing the angels all to thee.Father, Son and Holy Ghost,All in one our praises most.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Let us now go up To the mounting of the Lord;The city of the living God,And to the heavenly Jerusalem.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Let us join our praise With the myriads of angels,In a solemn song of glory With the assembly of God's sons,Whose names are written in heaven.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Let us now approach Our God who judges all men,And the spirits of the just now made perfect,And Jesus mediator of the new covenant (Fr. Lucien Deiss, C.S.Sp.)(Based on Eph. 2:18-19&Hebrews 12:22-24)

hymns.title: COME,COME,COME TO THE MANGER COME

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: He lies' mid the beasts of the stal Who is Maker and Lord of us all The wintry wind blows cold and dreary.See, he weeps, the world is weary;Lord, have pity and mercy on me!

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: He leaves all his glory behind,To be born and to die for mankind,With grateful beasts his cradle chooses, Thankless man his love refuses.Lord, have pity and mercy on me!

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: To the manger of Bethlehem come,To the Saviour Emmanuel's home;The heav'nly hosts above are singing,Set the Christmas bells a-ringing;Lord, have pity and mercy on me!

hymns.refrain: Children, come To the children's King; Sing, sing, chorus of Angels Stars of morning o'er Bethlehem sing.

hymns.title: COME DOWN, O LOVE COME
hymns.attribution: Bianco da Siena d. 1434,tr. Richard Frederick Littledate.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: O let it freely burn, Till earthly passions turn To dust and ashes in its Heat consuming; And let thy glorious light Shine ever on my sight, And clothe me round, the while my Path illuming.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Let holy charity Mine outward vesture be, And lowliness become mine Inner clothing; True lowliness of heart, Which takes the humbler part,And o'er its own shortcomings

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: And so the yearning strong,With which the soul will long, For none can guess its grace,Till he become the place

hymns.refrain: Flame bestowing.

hymns.title: COME, HOLY GHOST, CREATOR, COME
hymns.attribution: Ascribed to Rabanus Maurus (776-856) tr. Anonymous

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Come, Holy Ghost, Creator, come From thy bright heavenly throne,Come, take possession of our souls, And make them all thine own.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Thou who art called the Paraclete,Best gift of God above,The living spring, the living fire, Sweet unction and true love.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Thou who art sev'nfold in thy grace Finger of God's right hand,His promise, teaching little ones To speak and understand.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: O guide our minds with thy blest light, With love our hearts inflame; And with thy strength, which ne'er decays, Confirm our mortal frame.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Far from us drive our deadly foe; True peace unto us bring; And through all perils lead us safe Beneath thy sacred wing.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Through thee may we the Father know, Through thee th'eternal Son, And thee the Spirit of them both, Thrice-blessed Three in One.

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: All glory to the Father be,With his co-equal Son:The same to thee, great Paraclete,While endless ages run.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Come, sound his praise abroad And hymns of glory sing;Jesus is the sovereign Lord,The universal king. Praise ye the Lord, Alleluia!Praise ye the Lord, Alleluia!Alleluia. Alleluia. Alleluia!Praise ye the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: He formed the deeps unknown;He gave the seas their bounds.The watery worlds are all his own,And all the solid ground.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Come, worship at his throne,Come bow before the Lord:We are his work, and not our own.He formed us by his word.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Today attend his voice,Nor dare provoke his rod:Come, like the people of his choice And own your gracious God.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Come, thou almighty king,Help us your name to sing,Help us to praise; Father all glorious,Wholly Victorious Come and rule over us,Ancient of Days.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: . Come, thou Incarnate word, And make your message heard Our prayer attend.Come and your peoplebless,And give your word success;And let your holiness, ·To us descend.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Come, holy comforter,Your sacred witness bear,In this glad hour.You who almighty art,Enlighten every heart;From us do not depart,Spirit of pow'r.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: To you, great one in Three,Eternal praises be.Hence evermore.Your sovereign majesty.May we in glory see.And to eternity,Love and adore.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Come,thou long-expected Jesus,Born to set thy people free,From our fears and sins release us,Let us find our rest in thee.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Israel's strength and consolation,Hope of all the earth thou art;Dear desire of every nation,Joy of every longing heart.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Born thy people to deliver,.Born a child and yet a king,Born to reign in us for ever,Now thy gracious kingdom bring.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: By thine own eternal Spirit,Rule in all our hearts alone;By thine all-sufficient merit,Raise us to the glorious throne.

hymns.title: COME TOGETHER IN JESUS' NAME
hymns.attribution: Spread the newvs to every nation,Let your light shine.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Jesus' people come together,Let your light shine. Share your love with one another,Let your light shine. Let no difference grow between you, Let your light shine. Let the spirit flow within you, Let your light shine.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Jesus' people come together, Let your light shine(Alleluia) Come and worship your redeemer Let your light shine. (Come together) Sing for joy and shout with gladness, Let your light shine (Alleluia!) Come and praise him for his goodness, Let your light shine.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Jesus' people come together Let your light shine (Alleluia!)Tell the world about your saviour,Let your light shine.(Come together) Preach the gospel of salvation, Let your light shine. (Alleluia!)

hymns.refrain: O, let it shine, shine, shine. Come on and let your light shine D.$.

hymns.title: YOUR COUNT BLESSINGS
hymns.attribution: Help and comfort give you to your journey's end.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: When upon life's billows you are tempest tossed;when you are discouraged thinking all is lost, what the Lord hath done. Count your blessings, name them one by one. Count your blessings see what God hath done.Count your blessings,name them one byone And it will surprise you what the Lord hath done.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Are you ever burdened with a load of care? Does the cross seem heavy you are called to bear? Count your many blessings every doubt will fly, And you will be singing as the days go by.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: When you look at others with their lands and gold, Think that Christ has promised you his wealth untold. Count your many blessings money cannot buy, Your reward in heaven, nor your home on high.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: So amid the conflict whether great or small, Do not be discouraged God is over all, Count your many blessings,angels will attend,

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Crown him with many crowns, The Lamb upon his throne; Hark,how the heavenly anthem drowns. All music-but itsown: Awake, my soul, and sing Of him who died for thee, And hail him as thy matchless King Through all eternity.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Crown him the Virgin's Son, The God incarnate born, Whose arm those crimson trophies won Which now his brow adorn; Fruit of the mystic rose, As of that rose the stem, The root, whence mercy ever flows, The babe of Bethlehem.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Crown him the Lord of love; Behold his hands and side, Rich wounds, yet visible above, In beauty glorified: No angel in the sky Can fully bear that sight, But downward bends his burning eye At mysteries so bright.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Crown him the Lord of peace, Whose power a sceptre sways, From pole to pole, that wars may cease, Absorbed in prayer and praise: His reign shall know no end, And round his pierced feet Fair flowers of Paradise extend Their fragrance ever sweet.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Crown him the Lord of heaven, One with the Father known, And the blest Spirit through him given From yonder triune throne All hail, Redeemer, hail, For thou hast died for me; Thy praise shall never, never fail Throughout eternity.

hymns.title: CRY OUT WITH JOY TO

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Cry out with joy to the Lord alI the earth, Serve the Lord with gladness, Come before him singing for joy.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Know that he the Lord is God. He made us, we belong to him; We are his people, the sheep of his flock.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Go within his gates giving thanks, Enter his courts with songs of praise, Give thanks to him and bless his name.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Indeed how good is the Lord, Eternal his merciful love; He is faithful from age to age.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Give glory to the Father Almighty, To his Son, Jesus Christ, the Lord, To the Spirit who dwells

hymns.refrain: Ant.2: Glory to you, O God! Ant.3: Alleluia, alleluia, alleluia.

hymns.title: CHRIST IS KING OF EARTH AND HEAVEN!

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Christ is King of earth and heaven!Let his subjects all proclaim In the splendour of his temple: Honour to his holy name.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Christ is King! No soul created Can refuse to bend the knee To the God made man who reigneth As 'twas promised, from the tree.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Christ is King! Let humble sorrow For our past neglect atone, For the lack of faithful service To the Master whom we own.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Christ is King! Let joy and gladness Greet him; let his courts resound With the praise of faithful subjects To his love in honour bound.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Christ is King! In health and sickness, Till we breathe our latest breath, Till we greet in highest heaven, Christ the victor over death.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: O hear my cry, be gracious unto m Come, great deliverer, come, My soul bowed down, is longing for thee now; Come, great deliverer, come. I have wandered far away From the mountain top, I have wandered far away From home. Oh take me now, And bring me to thy side, Come great deliverer come.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: I have no place, no shelter for the night, Come, great deliverer, come. One look from thee, will give me life and light, Come, great deliverer, come.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: My path is lonely, and weary are my feet; Come, great deliverer, come. My eyes look up the loving smile to meet Come, great deliverer, come.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Thou will not spurn contrition broken sight, Come, great deliverer, come Regard my prayers, and hear my humble cry

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Come, praise the Lord, the almighty, The King of all nations! Tell forth his fame, o ye peoples,With loud acclamations! His love is sure; Faithful, his word shall endure, Steadfast through all generations!

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Praise to the Father most gracious, The Lord of creation! Praise to his Son, the Redeemer, Who wrought our salvation! O heav'nly Dove, Praise to thee, fruit of their love. Giver of all consolation! Psalm 116,

hymns.title: COME TO HIS AID,O SAINTS OF GOD

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Come to his aid, O saints of God; Come, meet him, Angels of the Lord; Receive his soul, O holy ones, Present him now to God most high

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: May Christ who called you take you home; And Angels lead you to Abraham; Receive his soul, O holy ones, Present him now to God most high.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Give him eternal rest, O Lord; May light unending shine on him; Receive his soul, O holy ones, Present him now to God most high.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: I know that my Redeemer lives; The last day I shall rise again, Receive his souls, O holy ones, Present him now

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Daily, Daily, sing to Mary, Sing my soul, her praise due; All her feasts, her actions worship, With the heart's devotion true. Lost in wond'ring contemplation Be her majesty confessed: Call her Mother, call her Virgin, Happy Mother, Virgin blest.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: She is mighty to deliver;Call her, trust her lovingly, Gifts of heaven she has given,Noble Lady! To our race: She, the Queen,who decks her subjects,

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Sing, my tongue, the Virgin's trophies,who for us her Maker bore; for the curse of old inflicted, Peace and blessings to restore.Sing in songs of praise unending, sing the world's majestic Queen;weary not nor faint in telling all the gifts she gives to men.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: All my senses, heart, affections, strive to sound her glory forth; spread abroad the sweet memorials, of the Virgin's priceless worth, where the voice of music thrilling, where the tongues of eloquence, that can utter hymns beseeming all her matchless excellence?

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: All our joys do flow from Mary, all then join her praise to sing; trembling sing the Virgin Mother, Mother of our Lord and King, while we sing her awful glory, far above our fancy's reach, let our hearts be quick to offer love the heart alone can teach. Ascribed to St. Bernard of Cluny

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Dear Lord and Father of mankind, forgive our foolish ways! Re-cloth us in our rightful mind, in purer lives thy service find, in deeper reverence praise, in deeper reverence praise.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: In simple trust like theirs who heard beside the Syrian sea, the gracious calling of the Lord, let us, like them, without a word, rise up and follow thee, rise up and follow thee.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: O Sabbath rest by Galilee! O calmn of hills above, where Jesus knelt to share with thee the silence of eternity, interpreted by love! Interpreted by love!

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Drop thy still dews of quietness, till all our strivings cease; take from our souls the strain and stress, and let our ordered lives confess The beauty of thy peace The beauty of thy peace.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Breathe through the heats of our desire thy coolness and thy balm;let sense be dumb, let flesh retire;speak through the earthquake,wind and fire, O still small voice of calm! O still small voice of calm!

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Ding dong! Merrily on high in heav'n the bells are ringing,Ding dong! Verily the sky is riv'n with angels singing. Gloria, hosanna in excelsis!

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: E'en so here below, below,let steeple bells be swungen,and io, io, io,by priest and people sungen.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Pray you, dutifully prime your matin chime, ye ringers;may you beautifully rime your evetime song, ye singers.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Dear Lady of Fatima we come on bended knee.To beg your intercession,For peace and unity Dear Mary won't you show us,The right and shining way.We pledge our love and offer you a rosary each day.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Oo. ........ Dear Lady of Fatima...You promised at Fatima each time that you appeared,To help us if we pray to you To banish war and fear.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Dear Lady on first Saturday we ask your guiding hand,For grace and guidance here on earth and protection for our land.Dear Lady on first Saturday We ask your guiding hand,For grace and guidance here on earth,And protection for our land.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Depth of mercy can there be Mercy still reserved for me? Can my God, his wrath forbear? Me, the chief of sinners, spare?

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: I have long withstood his grace, Long provoked him to his face, Would not hearken to his calls, Grieved him by a thousand falls.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Whence to me this waste of love Ask my advocate above! See the cause in Jesus face, Now before the throne of grace.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: There for me the Saviour stands, Shows his wounds and spreads his hands, God is love; I know, I feel, Jesus lives, and loves me still.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Jesus, answer from above; Is not all thy nature love? Wilt thou not the wrong forget? Suffer me to kiss thy feet.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Pity from thine eye let fall; By a look my soul reveal; Now the stone to flesh convert; Cast a look, and break my heart.

hymns.title: EVERY TIME I FEEL THE SPIRIT

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Upon the mountain, When my Lord spoke, Out of his mouth came Fire and smoke. Looked all around me, It looked so fine, I asked my Lord If all were mine.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: There is but one road Upon the track; It runs to Heaven and runs right back; Oh my Lord done Just what he said; He healed the sick And raised the dead.

hymns.refrain: Every time I feel the spirit Moving in my heart, I will pray.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Fade, fade, each earthly joy, Jesus is mine! Break every tender tie; Jesus is mine! Dark is the wilderness, Earth has no resting place, Jesus alone can bless. Jesus is mine!

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Tempt not my soul away Jesus is mine! Here would I ever stay; Jesus is mine! Perishing things of clay, Born but for one brief day Pass from my heart away! Jesus is mine!

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Farewell, ye dreams of night; Jesus is mine! Lost in this dawning light; Jesus is mine! All that my soul has tried, Left but a dismal void. Jesus has satisfied; Jesus is mine!

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Farewell, mortality; Jesus is mine! Welcome, eternity, Jesus is mine! Welcome, O loved and blest; Welcome, sweet scenes of rest; Welcome, my Saviour blest; Jesus is mine!

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Father is already here, I can feel his presence. He is already here. All I have to do, Is to open up my heart. For He is already here.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Jesus is already here. I can feel his presence. He is already here. All I have to do Is to open up my heart For He is already here.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Holy Ghost is already here. I can feel his presence. He is already here. All I have to do Is to open up my heart, For he is already here.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Fight the good fight with all thy might, Christ is thy strength, and Christ thy right; Lay hold on life and it shall be thy joy and crown eternally.

hymns.title: FILLED WITH THE HOLY SPIRIT

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Then Gabriel filled with the Holy Spirit, Brought down the joyful mnessage. Filled with the Holy Spirit, Hail Mary full of Grace.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Then Mary filled with the Holy Spir Conceived the Son of God,Filled with the Holy Spirit,Gave birth to our Saviour.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Child Jesus filled with the Holy Spirit.Grew up with God's favour.Filled with the Holy Spirit,Dwelt with Mary and Joseph.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Young Jesus filled with the Holy Spirit,Went up to Jerusalem.Filled with the Holy Spirit.Answered and taught the doctors.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Grown Jesus filled with the Holy Spirit,Went forth to the desert Filled with the Holy Spirit, Vanquished the temmptations.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Lord Jesus filled with the Holy Spirit,Went out to preach the Good News.Filled with the Holy Spirit,Proclaimed the reign of God.

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: Then Peter filled with the Holy Spirit Confessed that Jesus is Lord Filled with the Holy Spirit,Followed Our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.label: VERSE 8
verses.text: Then Stephen filled with the Holy Spirit,Preached bold the Lord Jesus.Filled with the Holy Spirit,Died soon a martyr's death.

verses.label: VERSE 9
verses.text: Brave Paul then filled with the Holy Spirit.Preached on to the Gentiles. Filled with the Holy Spirit, Built up the Christian Churches.

verses.label: VERSE 10
verses.text: Then Tansi filled with the Holy Spirit,Answered the call of God.Filled with the Holy Spirit Lives now a Blessed man.

verses.label: VERSE 11
verses.text: Let us now filled with the Holy Spirit,Go out to preach the Good News.Filled with the Holy Spirit.Spread forth the Love of God.

hymns.refrain: Oh fill us Holy Spirit.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Firmly I believe and truly God is three, and God is one,and I next acknowledge duly manhood taken by the Son.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: And I trust and hope most fully in that manhood crucified;and each thought and deed unruly do to death, as he has died.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Simply to his grace and wholly light and life and strength belong;and I love supremely, solely,Him the holy, him the strong.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: And I hold in veneration for the love of him alone.Holy Church, as his creation,and her teachings, as his own.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Adoration aye be given,with and through the angelic host,to the God of earth and heaven,Father, Son and Holy Ghost.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: For all the saints Who from their labours rest,Who thee by faith Before the world confest,Thy name, O Jesus Be for ever blest. Alleluia, alleluia!

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Thou wast their rock,Their fortress, and their might;Thou,Lord, their captain In the well-fought fight;Thou in the darkness drear Their one true light.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: O may thy soldiers,Faithful, true, and bold,Fight as the saints who Nobly fought of old,And win, with them,The victor's crown of gold.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: O blest communion! Fellowship divine! We feebly struggle, They in glory shine; Yet all are one in thee, For all are thine.5. And when the strife is fierce,The warfare long, Steals on the ear the Distant triumph song, And hearts are brave again, And arms are strong.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: The golden evening Brightens in the west; Soon, soon to faithful Warriors cometh rest; Sweet is the calm of Paradise theblest.

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: But lo! There breaks a Yet more glorious day; The saints triumphant Rise in bright array: The king of glory Passes on his way.

verses.label: VERSE 8
verses.text: From earth's wide bounds, From ocean's farthest coast, Through gates of pearl streams In the countless host, Singing to Father,

hymns.title: FORTH IN THY NAME O LORD, I GO

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Forth in thy name, O Lord, I go My daily labour to pursue,

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: The task thy wisdom hath assigned O let me cheerfully fulfil; In all my works thy presence find, And prove thy good and perfect will.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Thee may I set at my right hand, Whose eyes my inmost substance see, And labour on at thy command, And offer all my works to thee.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Give me to bear thy easy yoke, And every moment watch and pray, And still to things eternal look, And hasten to thy glorious day.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: For thee delightfully employ Whate'er thy bounteous grace hath given, And run my course with even joy. And closely walk with thee to heaven.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Forty days and forty nights Thou wast fasting in the wild; Forty days and forty nights Tempted still, yet unbeguiled:

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Sunbeams scorching all the day; Chilly dew-drops nightly shed Prowling beasts about thy way, Stones thy pillow, earth thy bed.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Let us thy endurance share And from earthly greed abstain WWith thee watching unto prayer, With thee strong to suffer pain.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Then if evil on us press, Flesh or spirit to assail, Victor in the wilderness, Help us not to swerve or fail!

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: So shall peace divine be ours; Holier gladness ours shall be, Come to us angelic powers, Such as ministered to thee.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Keep, O keep us, Saviour dear, Ever constant by the side, That with thee we may appear At the eternal Eastertide. George Hunt Smythan (1822-70)

hymns.title: FULL IN THE PANTING HEART OF ROME

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Full in the panting heart of Rome, Beneath the apostle's crowning dome, From pilgrims' lips that kiss the ground, Breaths in all tongues one only sound: "God bless our Pope, the great, the good".

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: The golden roof, the marble walls, The Vatican's majestic halls, The note redouble, till it fills With echoes sweet the seven hills:

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Then surging through each hallowed gate, When martyrs glory, in peace, await; It sweeps beyond the solemn plain, Peals over Alps, across the main:

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: From torrid south to frozen north, That wave harmonious stretches forth, Yet strikes no chord More true to Rome's, Than rings within our hearts and

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Saviour 'tis a full surrender All I leave to follow thee Thou my leader and defender,From this hour shalt ever be. I surrender all I surrender all All I have I bring to Jesus I surrender all

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: As I come in deep contrition,At this consecrated hour Hear O Christ my heart's petition Let me feel the spirit's power.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: No withholding full confession,Pleasure riches, all must flee Holy Spirit take possession,I no more but Christ in me.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Be this theme my song and story,Now and until life is o'er This my rapture this my glory Till I reach the shinning shore.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Oh the joy of full salvation!Oh, the peace of love divine!Oh the bliss of consecration!I am his and he is mine.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Give me joy in my heart,keep me praising give me joy in my heart I pray Give me joy in my heart keep me praising. Keep me praising till the end day. Sing hosanna! Sing hosanna!Sing hosanna to the King of King Sing hosanna! Sing hosanna!Sing hosanna to the King!
