verses.text: Give me peace in my heart,keep me resting,give me peace in my heart l pra Give me peace in my heart,keep me resting,Keep me resting till the end of de

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Give me love in my heart,keep me serving,give me love in my heart, I pray.Give me love in my heart,keep me serving,keep me serving till the end of de

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: If you really know God has blessed you,Come and bless him now,that he may (more) bless you.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: If you are one of those blessed with riches If you are one of those blessed with treasure.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: If you know that God has favoured you,Go and thank him for more blessing to come.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: If you know that you have rich harvest, If you know that God has favoured you.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: The lord loves a cheerful giver,Shout with joy for his loving kindness.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: The Lord is kind bountiful in mercy,From him comes all sources of goodness.

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: Ye saints of God, shout Alleluia,For God's favours,go and be thankful.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: We; the daughters and sons of him who built the valleys and plains,praise the wonders our God has done in ev'ry heart that sings.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: In his wisdom he strengthens us,like gold that's tested in fire,though the power of sin prevails,our God is there to save.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Ev'ry moment of ev'ry day our God is waiting to save,always ready to seek the lost,to answer those who pray.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: God has watered our barren land and spent his merciful rain.Now the rivers of life run full for anyone to drink.

hymns.title: GLORY TO THEE MY GOD THIS NIGHT

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Glory to thee my God, this night for all the blessings of the light,keep me, O keep me, King of kings beneath thy own almighty wings.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Forgive me, lord, for thy dear Son,the ill that I this day have done,that with the world,myself and thee. I, ere I sleep, at peace may be.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Teach me to live, that I may dread the grave as little as my bed;teach me to die, that so I may rise glorious at the awful day.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: O may my soul on thee repose,and with sweet sleep mine eyelids close,sleep that may me more vigorous make to serve my God when I awake.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Praise God, from whom all blessings flow,praise him, all creatures here below,praise himn above,ye heavenly host; praise Father, Son, and Holy Ghost.

hymns.title: GLORY TO YOU O CHRIST

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Praise to you! O Christ theLord,You offer pardon,you ask for justice: The year of grace opens the doors,In you alone, peace and unity!Amen! Alleluia!

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Praise to you! O Heart of God,with your blood you wash away every sin; Restore hope to dying man,In you alone, peace and unity!Amen! Alleluia!

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Praise to you! O Life of the world,Humble Servant even unto death,Give history a new future.In you alone, peace and unity!Amen! Alleluia!

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Praise to you! O Word of the father,Son of Man, born in Bethlehem,The magi and the shepherds'acclaim you. In you alone, peace and unity!Amen! Alleluia!

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Praise to you! O Cornerstone,Hidden Seed, Light in Darkness;In no other than you is the world saved.In you alone, peace and unity!Amen! Alleluia!

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Praise to youl O Mighty Shepherd,you lead your flock to the springs And revive them with living water.In you alone, peace and unity!Amen! Alleluia!

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: Praise to you! O True Master,Whoever follows you takes up the Cross,And moves according to your gospel In you alone, peace and unity!Amen! Alleluia!

verses.label: VERSE 8
verses.text: Praise to you! O Bread of Life,Everlasting Food that came down from heaven,You satisfy the hunger of every faithful In you alone, peace and unity!Amen! Alleluia!

verses.label: VERSE 9
verses.text: Praise to you! O Beloved Son,Sweet presence in your Church;You love everyorte as your brother In you alone, peace and unity!Amen! Alleluia!

verses.label: VERSE 10
verses.text: Praise to you! O God Crucified,Stretch out your arms, open your heart Those who weep are blessed In you alone, peace and unity!Amen! Alleluia!

verses.label: VERSE 11
verses.text: Praise to you! O Easter Sun,Through your rays history is adorned; From your Light the millennium is born In you alone, peace and unity!Amen! Alleluia!

hymns.refrain: Come soon: you are our only hope!

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: God be in my head, and in my understanding. God be in mine eyes,and in my looking; God be in my mouth,and in my speaking. God be in my heart,and in my thinking,God be at mine end,and at my departing

hymns.title: GOD BE WITH YOU TILL WE MEET AGAIN
hymns.attribution: God be with you till we meet again!

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: God be with you till we meet again!By his counsels guide, uphold you,With his sheep securely fold you;God be with you till we meet again! Till we meet! Till we meet! Till we meet at Jesus feet; Till we meet! Till we meet! God be with you tillwe meet again!

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: God be with you till we meet again! 'Neath his wings securely hide you, Daily manna still provide you; God be with you till we meet again!

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: God be with you till we meet again! When life's perils thick confound you. Put his loving arms around you; God be with you till we meet again!

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: God be with you till we meet again! Keep love's banner floating o'er you, Smite death's threatening wave before you;

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: God gives his people strength, If we believe in his way. He's swift to repay, All those who bear the burden of the day, God gives his people strength.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: God gives his people hope, If we but trust in his word,Our prayers are always heard, God gives his people hope.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: God gives his people love, If we but open wide our heart,He's sure to do his part. He's always the first to make a start. God gives his people love.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: God gives his people peace,When sorrow fills us to the brir, And courage grows dim, He lays to rest our restlessness in him.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: God is love and the one who lives in love lives in God and God lives in him. And we have come to know and have believed the love which God has for us God is love and the one who lives in love lives in God, and God lives in him.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: God is hope...

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: God is peace...

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: God is joy...

hymns.title: GOD OF MERCY AND COMPASSION

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: God of mercy and compassion, look with pity upon me; Father, let me call thee Father, 'tis thy child returns to thee.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: By my sins I have deserved death and endless misery, hell with all its pain and torments, and for all eternity.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: By my sins I have abandoned right and claim to heaven above, where the saints rejoice for ever, in a boundless sea of love.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: See our Saviour, bleeding, dying, on the cross of Calvary, to that cross my sins have nail'd him. Yet he bleeds and dies for me.

hymns.refrain: Jesus Lord, I ask for mercy; let me not implore in vain: all my sins I now detest them, never will I sin again.

hymns.title: GOD REST YOU MERRY, GENTLEMEN

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: God rest you merry, gentlemen, let nothing you dismay, remember Christ our Saviour was born on Christmas Day, to save us all from Satan's pow'r when we were gone astray;

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: In Bethlehem, in Jewry, this blessed babe was born, and laid within a manger, upon this blessed morn; and which his Mother Mary did nothing take in scorn.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: From God our heavenly Father a blessed Angel came; and unto certain Shepherds brought tidings of the same; how that in Bethlehem was born the Son of God by Name.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Fear not then, said the Angel, Let nothing you affright, this day is born a Saviour of a pure Virgin bright, to free all those who trust in Him from Satan's power and might.

hymns.refrain: O tidings of comfort and joy, comfort and joy, O tidings of comfort and joy.

hymns.title: GOOD CHRISTIAN MEI REJOICE AND SING

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Good Christian men,rejoice and sing!Now is the triumph of our King To all the world glad news we bring: Alleluia!

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: The Lord of Life is risen for ay:Bring flowers of song to strew his way let all mankind rejoice and say Alleluia!

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Praise we in songs of victory that Love, that Life, which cannot die, and sing with hearts uplifted high.Alleluia!

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Thy name we bless, o risen Lord,and sing today with one accord the life laid down, the life retored Alleluia!

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Go, the Mass is ended,children of the Lord.Take his word to others as you've heard it spoken to you.Go,the Mass is ended,go and tell the world the Lord is good, the lord is kind and he loves ev'ryone.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Go, the Mass is ended,take his love to all.Gladden all who meet you,fill their hearts with hope and courage.Go, the mass is ended,fill the world with love,and give to all what you've received -the peace and joy of Christ.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Go, the mass is ended,strengthened in the Lord,lighten ev'ry burden,spread the joy of Christ around you.Go, the Mass is ended.take his peace to all,This day is yours to change the world to make God known and loved.

hymns.title: GUIDE ME, O THOU GREAT REDEEMER

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Guide me, O thou great redeemer,pilgrim through this barren land;I am weak, but thou are mighty,hold me with thy powerful hand.Bread of heaven, (2x)feed me till I want no more. (2x)

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Open now the crystal fountain,whence the healing stream doth flow, let the fire and cloudy pillar lead me all my journey through;strong Deliverer,(2x)be thou still my strength and shield.(2x)

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: When I tread the verge of Jordan,bid my anxious fears subside,death of death, and hell's destruction,land me safe on Canaan's side;songs of praises, (2x)I will ever give to thee. (2x)

hymns.title: GRANT TO US, O LORD

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Behold, the days are coming,Says the Lord our God,When I will make a new covenant,With the house of Israel.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Deep within their being, I will implant my law. I will write it in their hearts

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: I will be their God,And they shall be my people.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: And for all their faults I will grant forgiveness,Never more will I remember their sins.

hymns.title: GO,TELL IT ON THE MOUNTAIN

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: While shepherds kept their watching o'er wand'ring flocks by night, there shone a holy light.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: And lo, when they had seen it,they all bowed down and prayed, they travelled on together to where the babe was laid.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: When I was a seeker, I sought both night and day; I asked my Lord to help me and he showed me the way.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: He made me a watchman upon the city wall. And if I am a Christian I am the least of all.

hymns.refrain: Go, tell it on the mountain that Jesus Christ is born.

hymns.title: GOD LOVES A CHEERFUL GIVER

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Peter always made a fuss;Peter was impetous, He knew,had time, When he denied his Lord; But hardly had he fallen When he got right up, began again, Christ named him suocessor, As his reward.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Jonah was a gloomy sort; He always had a sad report. He ran from god, He ran and he set sail; His journey's end was quite abrupt, A fish came by, swallowed him up; He spent three dark and dreamy days Inside the whale.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Holy Job was richly blessed, He lost it all but stood to test, For Job was steadfast In his misery; *God gave to me, he took away; Blessed be the name of God", he said; And he was doubly blessed For his fidelity.

hymns.refrain: He loves to hear you laughing, When you are in an awkward spot; When the odds add up against you, Its time to stop and sing, Praise God; To praise him is a joyous thing.

verses.text: Godhead here in hiding,whom I do adore, masked by these bare shady shape and nothing more, see,lord, at thy service low lies here a heart lost, all lost in wonder at the God thou art,

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Glory to God on high, And on earth Peace to men of goodwill.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: We adore you, oh Lord. We glorify you. We give thanks, oh Lord, For your great glory.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Lord, God, our heavenly king, God, the almighty Father.

hymns.title: GOD HAS BEEN SO GOOD

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: God has been so good; He has been so good to us. God has been so good.

hymns.refrain: God is so good, God is so good, God is so good, He's so good to me.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Hail, glorious Saint Patrick,dear saint of our isle,on us thy poor children bestow a sweet smile;and now thou art high in the mansions above,on Erin's green valleys look down in thy love.On Erin's green valleys,on Erin's green valleys,on Erin's green valleys look down in thy love.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Hail, glorious Saint Patrićk!Thy words were once strong Against Satan's wiles and An infidel throng;Not less is thy might Where in heaven thou art;O, come to our aid,In our battle take part.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: In the war against sin,In the fight for the faith,Dear saint, may thy children Resist unto death,May their strength be in meekne In penance, in prayer.Their banner the Cross Which they glory to bear.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Thy people, now exiles On many a shore, Shall love and revere thee Till time be no more; And the fire thou hast kindled Shall ever burn bright. Its warmth undiminished, Undying its light.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Ever bless and defend the sweet Land of our birth, Where the shamrock still blooms As when thou wert on earth, And our hearts shall yet burn, Wheresoever we roam, For God and Saint Patrick, And our native home.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Hail, holy Joseph hail! Husband of Mary, hail! Chaste as the lily flower In Eden's peaceful vale.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Hail, holy Joseph, hail! Father of Christ's esteemed, Father be thou to those Thy foster Son redeemed.!

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Hail, holy Joseph, hail! Prince of the house of God, May his blest graces be By thy pure hands bestowed.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Hail, holy Joseph, hail!Comrade of angels, hail, faint,And guide the steps that fail.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Hail, holy Joseph, hail!God's choice wert thou alone; To thee the Word made flesh Was subject as a Son.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Mother of Jesus,bless, And bless, ye saints on high, All meek and simple souls That to Saint Joseph cry. Frederick William Faber (1814-

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Hail, Queen of heav'n, the ocean star, Guide of the wand'rer here below; Thrown on life's surge, we claim thy care; Save us from peril and from woe. Mother of Christ, star of the sea, Pray for the wanderer, pray for me.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: O gentle, chaste and spotless maid, We sinners make our prayers through thee; Remind thy son that he has paid The price of our iniquity. Virgin most pure, star of the sea, Pray for the sinner, prayfor me.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Sojourners in this vale of tears,To thee, blest advocate, we cry;Pity our sorrows, calm our fears And soothe with hope our misery.Refuge in grief, star of thesea,Pray for the mourner, pray for me.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: And while to him who reigns above,In Godhead One, in Persons Three,The source of life, of grace, of love,Homage we pay on bended knee,Do thou, bright Queen, star of the sea, Pray for the children, pray for me.

hymns.title: HAIL THE DAY THAT SEES HIM RISE

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Hail the day that sees him rise, alleluia! To his throne above the skies; alleluia! Christ, the Lamb for sinners given, alleluia! Enters now the highest heaven, alleluia!

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: There for him high triumph waits;Lift your heads, eternal gates!He hath conquered death and sin;Take the king of glory in!

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Circled round with angel poweTheir triumphant Lord and our Wide unfold the radiant scene Take the king of glory in!

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Lo, the heaven its Lord receive Yet he loves the earth he leave Though returning to his throne Still he calls mankind his own.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: See! He lifts his hands above,See! He shows the prints of low Hark! His gracious lips bestow,Blessings on his Church below

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Still for us he intercedes,His prevailing death he pleads;Near himself prepares our place He the first-fruits of our race.

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: Lord, though parted from our sig Far above the starry height,Grant our hearts many thither ris Seeking thee above the skies.

verses.label: VERSE 8
verses.text: Ever upward let us move,Wafted on the wings of love;Looking when our Lord shall come,Longing, sighing after home. Charles Wesley(1707-88,Thonl Cotterill (1779-1823) and othe

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Rest comes at length;Though life be long and dreary, The day must dawn and darksome night be past; All journeys end in welcomes to the weary, And Heaven, the heart's true home. Will come at last.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Angels sing on, your faithful watches keeping, Sing us sweet fragments of the songs above: While we toil on, And sooth ourselves with weeping, TiIl life's long night shall break

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Hail, thou star of ocean, Portal of the sky, Ever virgin Mother Of the Lord most high. Oh! By Gabriel's Ave, Uttered long ago, Eva's name reversing, 'Stablish peace below.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Break the captive's fetters, Light on blindness pour, All our ills expelling, Every bliss implore. Show thyself a mother; Offer him our sighs Who for us incarnate Did not thee despise.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Virgin of all virgins, To thy shelter take us; Gentlest of the gentle, Chaste and gentle make us. Still, as on we journey, Help our weak endeavour; Till with thee and Jesus We rejoice for ever.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Through the highest heaven, To the almighty Three, Father, Son and Spirit, One same glory be.

hymns.title: HARK! HARK, MY SOUL!

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Hark! Hark, my soul! Angelic songs are swelling, O'er earth's green fields, And ocean's wave beat shore; How sweet the truth those blessed strains are telling. Of that new life when sin shall be no more.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Onward we go, for still we hear them singing, Come, weary souls for Jesus bids you come; And through the dark, its echoes sweetly ringing, The music of the gospel leads us home.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Far, far away, like bells at evening pealing, The voice of Jesus sounds o'er land and sea. And laden souls by thousands meekly stealing Kind shepherd, turn their weary steps to thee.

hymns.refrain: Angels of Jesus, angels of light! Singing to welcome the pilgrims of the night.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Hark, the herald angels sing, Glory to the new born King, Peace on earth and mercy mild, God and sinners reconciled; Joyful all ye nations rise, Join the triumph of the skies, With the angelic host proclaim, Christ is born in Bethlehem. Hark,the herald Angels sing, Glory to the new born King.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Christ, by highest heaven adored. Christ, the everlasting lord,Late in time beholdhimcome Pleased as man with man to dwe Jesus, our Emmanuel.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Hail the heaven-bornPrince peace! Hail the Son of Righteousness!Light and life to all he brings Born that man no more may die Born to raise the sons of earth, Born to give them second birth, Charles Wesley(174) George Whitefield (1753), Mart

hymns.title: HE LEADETH ME
hymns.attribution: Since thou thro' Jordan leadeth me.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: He leadeth me, oh blessed thought, Oh words with heav'nly comfort fraught. Whate'er I do, where'er I be, Still 'tis God's hand that leadeth m He leadeth me, he leadeth me By his own hand he leadeth m His faithful follower I would b For by his hand he leadeth n

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Sometimes 'mid scenes of deepst gloom, Sometimes where Eden's bowers bloom; By water calm, o'er troubled sea,Still 'tis God's hand that leadeth me.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Lord, I could clasp thy hand in mine,Nor ever murmur nor repine;Content whatever lot I see,Since 'tis my God that leadeth me.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: And when my task on earth is done,When by thy grace the victory's won; E'en death's cold wave I will not flee,

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Help, Lord, the souls that thou has made, The souls to thee so dear,In prison for the debt unpaid Of sin committed here.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: These holy souls, they suffer on,Resigned in heart and will,Until thy high behest is done,And justice has its fill.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: For daily falls, for pardoned crime They joy to undergo The shadow of thy cross sublime,The remnant of thy woe.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Oh, by their patience of delay,Their hope amid their pain,Their sacred zeal to burn away Disfigurement and stain;

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Oh, by their fire of love, not less In keenness than the flame;Oh,by their very helplessness,Oh, by they own great name;

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Good Jesus, help sweet Jesus aid The souls to thee most dear,In prison for the debt unpaid Of sins committed here.

hymns.title: HOLY, HOLY, HOLY, LORD GOD ALMIGHTY

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Holy, holy, holy!Lord God almighty!Early in the morning Our songs shall rise to thee;Holy,holy,holy!Merciful and mighty!God in three persons,Blessed Trinity!

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Holy, holy, holy!All the saints adore thee.Casting down their golden crowns Around the glassy sea;Cherubim and seraphim Falling down before thee,Which wert, and art,And evermore shall be.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Holy, holy, holy!Though the darkness hide thee, Though the eye of sinful man Thy glory may not see, Only thou art holy, There is none beside thee, Perfect in power, In love, and purity.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Holy, holy,holy! Lord God almighty! All thy works shall praise thy name, In earth, and sky, and sea; Holy,holy,holy! Merciful and mighty! God in three persons, Blessed Trinity!

hymns.title: HOLY QUEEN WE BEND BEFORE THEE

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Holy Queen! We bend before thee, Queen of purity divine! Make us love thee, we implore thee; Make us truly to be thine. Teach, oh, teach us Holy Mother, How to conquer ev'ry sin; How to love and help each other, How the prize of life to win.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Thou to whom a child was give Greater than thessonsof men Coming down from highest heaven To create the world again.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Oh by that Almighty Maker, Whom thyself a Virgin bore! Oh by the supreme Creator, Link'd with Thee for evermore!

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: By the hope thy name inspires Be our doom reversed through the Help us, Queen of Angel-Choirs

hymns.title: HOLY SPIRIT,LORD OF LIGHT
hymns.attribution: Ascribed to Stephens Langton (d.1228) Tr. Ecward Caswall

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Holy Spirit, Lord of light, From the clear celestial height Thy pure beaming radiance give Come, thou Father of the poor, Come with treasures that endu Come thou light ofall that live!

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Thou, of all consolers best, Thou, the soul's delightfuI gues Dost refreshing peace bestow, Thou in toil art comfort sweet; Pleasant coolness in the heat, Solace in the midst of woe.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Light imnmortal, light divine,Visit thou these hearts of thine.And our inmost being fill;If thou take thy grace away,Nothing pure in man will stay;And his good is turned to ill.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Heal our wounds,our strength renew;On our dryness pour thy dew;Wash the stains of guilt away:Bend the stubborn heart and will;Melt the frozen, warm the chill;Guide the steps that go astray.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Thou, on us who evermore Thee confess and thee adore,With thy sevenfold gifts descend:Give them comfort when they die;Give them life with thee on high;Give them joys that never end.

hymns.title: HOSANNA

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Hosanna! Hosanna! Hosanna!Blessed is He that cometh;Blessed is He that cometh;Blessed is He that cometh In the name of the Lord.

hymns.refrain: Blessed be the king of Israel;Blessed by the king of Israel;Blessed, (blessed) blessed,Blessed,blessed, blessed, blessed, Blessed is He that cometh In the name of the lord, In the name of the Lord. (D.$.) Hosanna! Hosanna! Hosanna!

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: O Lord, my God, When I in awesome wonder,Consider all the worlds Thy hand has made,I see the stars,I hear the rolling thunder,Thy pow'r throughout The universe displayed. Then sings my soul My Saviour God to thee; How great thou art, How great thou art. Then sings my soul, My saviour God to thee; How great thou art, How great thou art.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: And when I think That God, his Son not sparing,Sent him to die,I scarce can take it in That on the cross,My burden gladly bearing,He bled and died To take away my sin.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: When Christ shall come With shout of acclamation And take me home,What joy shall fill mny heart;When I shall bow In humble adoration,And there proclaim,My God, how great thou art.

hymns.title: HAIL HOLY QUEEN ENTHRONED ABOVE*
hymns.attribution: Show us thy Son our Jesus swee O Maria!

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Hail holy Queen enthroned above,O Maria!Hail Mother of mercy and of love,O Marial. Triumph all ye Cherubim!Sing with us ye Seraphim!Heaven and earth resound the hymn: Salve, salve, salve Regina!

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Our life, our sweetness, here belo O Maria!Our hope in sorrow and iin woe,O Marial.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Tum then most gracious advocal O Marial Tow'rd us thine compassionate,eye O Marial

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: When this our exile is complete,O Maria!

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Have mercy on me, God,in your kindness.In your compassion blot out my offence. O wash me more and more from my guilt And cleanse me from my sin.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: My offences truly I know them My sin is always before me.Against you,you alone,have I sinned; What is evil in your sight I hav done.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: That you may be justified when You give sentence And be without reproach when you judge, O see, in guilt I was born,A sinner was I conceived.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Indeed you love truth in the heart;Then in the secret of my heart Teach me wisdom. O purify me, then I shall be clean;O wash me, I shall be whiter than snow.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Make me hear rejoicing and gladness That the bones you have crushed may thrill From my sins turn away your face And blot out all my guilt.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: A pure heart create for me, O God,Put a steadfast spirit within me,Do not cast me away from your present,Nor deprive me of your holy spirit.

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: Give me again the joy of your help With a spirit of fervour sustain me,That I may teach transgressors Your ways,And sinners may return to you.

verses.label: VERSE 8
verses.text: O rescue me, O God, my helper,And my tongues shall ring out your goodness. O Lord, open my lips,And my mouth shall declare your praise.

verses.label: VERSE 9
verses.text: For in sacrifice you take no delight, Burnt offering from me you would refuse My sacrifice,a contrite spirit A humbled, contrite heart you will not spurn.

verses.label: VERSE 10
verses.text: (Give glory to the Father almighty to his son, Jesus Christ, the Lord,to the Spirit who dwells in our hearts, both now and for ever. Amen)

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: He's got the whole world in his hand.He's got the whole world in his hand He's got the whole wide world in his hand He's got the whole world in his hand.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: He's got you and me, brother...

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: He's got you and me, sister...

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: He's got everybody here...

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: He's got the whole world...

hymns.title: HE WHOM SHEPHERDS APPREHENDED
hymns.attribution: Honour Lord to thee we sing.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: He whom shepherds apprehended; He whose angels bright descended;Singing now your foes are ended; He is born our glorious king.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: To his crib the magi kneeling; Brought their gifts of spice and healing; Sacrifice of love the sealing Perceived the new-born king.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Christ In Glory, Godhead given; Born of Mary, Son of heaven; Praise to thee and love be given;

hymns.title: HOW EXCELLENT

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Therefore, the children of men Put their trust under the shadow Of thy wings.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: They shall be abundantly satisfied And thou shall make them drink Of the river of thy pleasures.

hymns.refrain: How excellent, how excellent Is thy loving kindness, Is thy loving kindness, O God.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: How firm this Easter tide, The faith in which we stand, A faith for the nation! For Christ, the Lord who died Now lives at God's right hand, To ransom creation. oh hear what God has done,Who loved and gave his only son, Is risen, is risen,For Christ the Lord is risen.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: How great this Easter tide,The joy in hearts set free From sin and its sadness! The Lord the crucified, Has won for us the key To share in his gladness.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: How strong this Easter tide,The loved that God shall give To those who obey him, Who drop the chains of pride Who lose their fear and live No more to gain-say him.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: How welcome was the call, And sweet the festal lay, When Jesus designed in Canaan's hall, To bless the marriage day.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: And happy was the bride,And glad the bridegroom's heart, For he who turned at their side, Bade grief and ill depart.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: His gracious power divine,The water vessels knew, wine

hymns.title: HOLY, HOLY, HOLY

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Holy, Holy, Holy is the Lord. God of pow'r; God of might; Holy is the Lord. Heav'n and earth Are full of your glory.

hymns.refrain: Holy, Holy, Holy is the Lord.

hymns.title: I AM THE BREAD OF LIFE

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: I am the Bread of life, He who comes to me shall not hunger; He who believes in me shall not thirst. No one can come to me, Unless the Father draws him. And I will raise him up, And I will raise him up, And I will raise him up, On the last day.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: The bread that I will give Is my flesh for the life of the world And he who eats of this bread, He shall live for ever, He shall live for ever.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Unless you eat Of the flesh of the Son of Man, And drink of his blood, And drink of his blood, You shall not have life within you.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: For my flesh is food indeed, And my blood is drink indeed. He who eats of my flesh, And drinks of my blood Abides in me.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: I am the resurrection I am the life. He who believes in me, Even if he dies, He shall live for ever.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Yes, Lord, I believe That you are the Christ, The Son of God, Who have come Into the world.

hymns.title: I AM THINE O LORD
hymns.attribution: Till I rest in peace with thee.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: I am thine, O Lord; I have heard thy voice, And it told thy love to me; But I long to rise in the arms of fait And be closer drawn to thee. Draw me nearer, nearer blessed Lord, To the cross where thou hast died Draw me nearer, nearer, nearer blessed Lord, To thy precious, bleeding side.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Consecrate me now to thy service, Lord, By the power of grace divine; Let my soul look up with a steadfast hope And my will be lost in thine.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: O the pure delight of a single hour That before thy throne I spend,When I kneel in prayer, and with thee,my God,I commune as friend with friend.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: There are depths of love that I cannot know Till I cross the narrow sea; There are heights of joy that I may not reach

hymns.title: I COME TO THEE ONCE MORE MY GOD
hymns.attribution: To make it more thine own.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: I come to thee once more my God,No longer will I roam,For I have sought thee wide world through,And never found a home.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Though bright and many are the spots,Where I have built a nest,Yet in the brightest still I pined For more abiding rest.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Riches could bring me joy and power And they were fair to see; Yet gold was but a sorry god To serve instead of thee

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Then honour and the world's good word Appear a nobler faith; Yet could I rest on bliss that hung And trembled on a breath.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: For thou hast made this wondrous soul All for thyself alone; Ah! send thy sweet transforming word

hymns.title: I'LL SING A HYMN TO MARY

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: I'll sing a hymn to Mary,The Mother of my God, The Virgin of all virgins, Of David's royal blood. O teach me, holy Mary, A loving song to frame, When wicked men blaspheme thee, To love and bless thy name.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: O noble Tower of David, Of gold and ivory, The ark of God's own promise, The gate of heav'n to me, To live and not to love thee, Would fill my soul with shame; When wicked men blaspheme thee, I'll love and bless thy name.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: The Saints are high in glory,With golden crowns so bright; Upon her throne of light.O that which God did give them Let mortal ne'er disclaim; When wicked men blaspheme thee, I'll love and bless thy name.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: But in the crown of Mary, There lies a wondrous gem, As Queen of all the Angels, Which Mary shares with them No sin hath e'er defiled thee, So doth our faith proclaim; When wicked men blaspheme thee, I'll love and bless thy name.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Immaculate Mary! Our hearts are on fire, That titles so wondrous Fills all our desire. Ave,ave, ave Maria! Ave, ave, ave Maria!

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: We pray for God's glory, May his kingdom come! We pray for his vicar, Our father, and Rome.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: We pray for our mother The church upon earth, And bless, sweetest Lady The land of our birth.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: O Mary! O mother! Reign o'er us once more, Be England thy 'dowry' As in days of yore.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: We pray for all sinners, And souls that now stray From Jesus and Mary, In heresy's way.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: For poor, sick, afflicted Thy mercy we crave; And comfort the dying Thou light of the grave.

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: There is no need, Mary, Nor ever has been, Which thou canst not succour, Immaculate Queen.

verses.label: VERSE 8
verses.text: In grief and temptation, In joy or in pain, We'll ask thee, our mother, Nor seek thee in vain.

verses.label: VERSE 9
verses.text: O bless us, dear Lady, With blessings from heaven, And to our petitions Let answer be given.

verses.label: VERSE 10
verses.text: In death's solemn moment, Our mother, be nigh; As children of Mary, O teach us to die.

verses.label: VERSE 11
verses.text: And crown thy sweet mercy With this special grace. To behold soon in heaven God's ravishing face.

verses.label: VERSE 12
verses.text: Now to God be all glory And worship for aye, And to God's virgin mother An endless Ave.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Immortal, invisible, God only wise, In light inaccessible Hid from our eyes, Most blessed, most glorious, The Ancient of Days, Almighty, victorious, Thy great name we praise.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Unresting, unhasting, And silent as light; Nor wanting, nor wasting, Thou rulest in might Thy justice like mountains High-soaring above Thy clouds which are fountains Of goodness and love.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: To all life thou givest, To both great and small; In all life thou livest, The true life of all; We blossom and flourish As leaves on the tree, And wither and perish; But naught changeth thee.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Great Father of glory, Pure Father of light, Thine angels adore thee, All veiling their sight; All laud we would render; O help us to see 'Tis only the splendour Of light hideth thee. W.Chalmers Smith (1825-1908)

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: I need thee every hour, most precious Lord; No tender voice like thine, can peace afford. I need thee, oh I need thee, Every hour I need thee; Oh, bless me now, my saviour, I come to thee.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: I need thee every hour, stay thou nearby; Temptations lose their power, when thou art nigh.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: I need thee every hour,in joy or poain;Come quickly and abide,or life is vain.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: I need thee every hour,teach me thy will;And thy rich promises,in me fulfil.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: I need thee every hour,most holy one;Oh, make me thine indeed,thou blessed son.

hymns.title: INSTRUMENTS OF YOUR PEACE LORD

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Where there is hatred,We will sow his love;Where there is injury,We will never judge, Where there is striving,We will speak his peace;To the people crying for relea We will be his instruments of peace.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Where there is blindness,We will pray for sight,Where there is darkness,We will shine his light;Where there is sadness,We will bear their grief;To the millions crying for releas We will be his instruments of peace.

hymns.refrain: Lord, make us instruments of your peace; Walls of pride and prejudice shall cease, When we are your instruments of peace.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: All to Jesus I surrender,All to him I freely give.All to Jesus I surrender, Humbly at his feet I bow. I surrender all,I surrender all,All to thee my blessed saviour,I surrender all.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: I will ever love and trust him,In his presence, daily live.Worldly pleasures all forsaken Take me Jesus, take me now.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: All to Jesus I surrender,Lord, I give my self to thee;Fill me with thy love and power,Let thy blessing fall on me.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: All to Jesus I surrender,Now I feel the sacred flame;O the joy of full salvation!Glory, glory to his name!

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: For lo, the days are hastening on,By prophets seen of old,When with the ever-circling years Shall come the time foretold,When the new heaven and earth shall own The prince of peace their king,And all the world send back the song Which now the angels sing.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: It came upon the midnight clear,That glorious song of old,From angels bending near the earth To touch their harps of gold;'Peace on the earth,good will to men,From heaven's all-gracious King!'The world in solemn stillness lay To hear the angels sing.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Yet with the woes of sin and strife The world has suffered long;Beneath the angel-strain have rolled Two thousand years of wrong; And man, at war with man,hears not The love-song which they bring: O hush the noise, ye men of strife,And hear the angels sing.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: I, the Lord of sea and sky,I have heard my people cry.All who dwell in dark and sin,My hand will save. I, who made the stars of night,I will make their darkness bright.Who will bear my light to them?Whom shall I send? Here I am,Lord. Is it I, Lord?I have heard You calling in the night I will go, Lord, if you lead me.I will hold your people in my heart.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: I, the Lord of snow and rain,I have borne my people's pain.I have wept for love of them They turn away.I will break their hearts of stone Give them hearts for love alone.I will speak my word to them Whom shall I send?

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: I, the Lord of wind and flame, I will send the poor and lame. I will set a feast for them My hand will save. Finest bread I will provide Till their hearts be satisfied I will give my life to them. Whom shall I send?

hymns.title: IT CAME UPON THE MIDNIGHT CLEAR

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: It came upon the midnight clear, That glorious song of old, From angels bending near the earth To touch their harps of gold; Peace on the earth, good will to men, From heaven's all-gracious King! The world in solemn stillness lay To hear the angels sing.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Yet with the woes of sin and strife The world has suffered long; Beneath the angel-strain have rolled Two thousand years of wrong; And man, at war with man, hears not The love-song which they bring: O hush the noise, ye men of strife, And hear the angels sing.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: For lo, the days are hastening on, By prophets seen of old, When with the ever-circling years Shall come the time foretold When the new heaven and earth shall own The prince of peace their king, And all the world send back the song Which now the angels sing.

verses.text: Loving shepherd, thou didst give thine own life that I might live;may I love thee day by day,gladly thy sweet will obey.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Loving shepherd, ever near,teach me still thyvoice to hear;suffer not my steps to stray from the straight and narrow way.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Where thou leadest may I go,walking in thy steps below;then before thy Father's throne,Jesus, claim me for thine own.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Lead us, heav'nly Father, lead us o'er the world's tempestuous sea;guard us, guide us, keep us, feed us, for we have no help but thee;yet possessing ev'ry blessing if our God our Father be.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Saviour, breathe forgiveness o'er us,all our weakness thou dost know,thou didst tread this earth before us, thou didst feel its keenest woe;lone and dreary, faint and weary,through the desert thou didst go.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Spirit of our God, descending,fill cur hearts with heavenly joy,love with every passion blending,pleasure that can never cloy;thus provided, pardoned, guided,nothing can our peace destroy.

hymns.title: 469 LET ALL THE WORLD IN EVERY CORNER

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Let all the world in every corner sing,my God and King!the heav'ns are not too high,his praise may thither fly;the earth is not too low,his praises there may grow Let all the world in every corner sing,my God and King!

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Let all the world in every corner sing,my God and King!The church with psalms must shout,no door can keep them out;but, above all, the heart must bear the longest part.Let all the world in every corner sing,my God and King! George Herbert (1593-1633) LET US,WITH A GLADSOME MIND

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Let us, with a gladsome mind,praise the Lord, for he is kind; For his mercies aye endure,ever faithful, ever sure.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Let us blaze his name abroad,for of gods he is the God;

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: He, with all-commanding might,Filled the new-made world with Light;

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: He the golden-tressed sun caused all day his course to run;

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: And the horned moon at night,mid her spangled sisters bright;

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: All things living he doth feed,his full hand supplies their need:

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: Let us, with a gladsome mind,praise the Lord, for he is kind. John Milton (1608-75)Based on Ps.136

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Lord, have mercy, Lord, have mercy, Lord, have mercy on us. Have mercy on us, Have mercy on us, Lord, Lord, have mercy on us.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Christ, have mercy, Oh Christ, have mercy, Christ, Christ, have mercy on us. Have mercy on us, Have mercy on us, Christ, Christ, have mercy on us.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Oh Lord, have mercy, Lord, Lord, have mercy on us. Have mercy on us, Have mercy on us, Lord, Lord, have mercy on us.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Love divine, all loves excelling, joy of heaven, to earth come down, fix in us thy humble dwelling, all thy faithful mercies crown.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Jesus, thou art all compassion, pure unbounded love thou art, visit us with thy salvation, enter every trembling heart.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Come, almighty to deliver, let us all thy life receive, suddenly return, and never, never more thy temples leave.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Thee we would be always blessing, serve thee as thy hosts above; pray, and praise thee without ceasing, Glory in thy perfect love.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Finish then thy new creation, pure and spotless let us be; let us see thy great salvation, perfectly restored in thee.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Lovely Lady dressed in blue, Teach me how to pray. God was just your little boy, Tell me what to say. Did you lift Him up sometimes gently on your knees? Did you sing to Him the way Mother does to me?

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Did you hold Him close and tell Him of the things, just little things that happen? And do angels whisper secrets to Him in the night? Can He understand me now? Tell me for you know.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Lovely Lady dressed in blue, Teach me how to pray, teach me how to pray. God was just your little boy, and you know the way.

hymns.title: LORD, I WANT TO BE A CHRISTIAN

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Lord, I want to be a Christian in my heart, in my heart. Lord, I want to be a Christian in my heart.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Lamb of God, Who take away the sins of the world, Have mercy on us, Have mercy on us, oh Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Lamb of God, Who take away the sins of the world, Have mercy, have mercy, Have mercy on us, oh Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Lamb of God, Who take away the sins of the world, Grant us your peace, Grant us your peace, Grant us your peace.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Mary had a baby, yes, my Lord, Mary had a baby, Lord. Mary had a baby, yes, my Lord: And the angels in the heavens are singing.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: What did she name him,yes,my Lord, What did she name him, Lord? What did she name him, Yes, my Lord; and the angels In the heavens are singing.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Named him King Jesus, yes,my Lord, Named him King Jesus, Lord. Named him King Jesus, Yes, my Lord; and the angels In the heavens are singing.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Where was he born, yes, my Lord, Where was he born, Lord? Where was he born, Yes, my Lord; and the angels In the heavens are singing.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Born in a manger, yes, my Lord. Born in a manger, Lord. Born in a manger, Yes,my Lord; and the angels

hymns.title: MAY LOVE BE OURS OH
hymns.attribution: Love shall reign in every heart.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Not for tongues of heavens angels, Not for Wisdom to discern,Not for faith that masters mountains, For this better gift we yearn.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Love is humble. Love is gentle Love is tender, true, and kind.Love is gracious, ever patient, Generous of heart and mind.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Never jealous never selfish. Love will not rejoice in wrong, Never boastful nor resentful. Love believe and suffers long.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: In for day this world is fading, Faith and hope willplay theirpa But when Christ is seen in glory

hymns.refrain: May love be ours oh Lord!

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Most ancient of all mysteries Before thy throne we lie; Have mercy now, most mercifu Most Holy Trinity.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: When heaven and earth were yet unmade, When time was yet unknown, Thou, in thy bliss and majesty,

hymns.title: MY GOD ACCEPT MY HEART THIS DAY

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: My God accept my heart this day, And make it wholly thine, That I from thee no more may stray, No more from thee decline.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Before the cross of him who died, Behold, I prostrate fall; Let every sin be crucified And Christ be all in all.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Anoint me with thy heavenly grace, And seal me for thine own,That I may see thy glorious face, And worship at thy throne.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Let every thought, and work and word To thee be ever given, Then life shall be thy service, Lord, And Death the gate of heaven.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: All glory to the Father be, All glory to the Son, All glory, Holy Ghost, to thee, While endless ages run.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: My God, how wonderful thou art, Thy majesty how bright! How beautiful thy mercy-seat In depths of burning light!

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: How dread are thine eternal years O everlasting Lord! By prostrate spirits day and night Incessantly adored!

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: How beautiful, how beautiful, The sight of thee must be, Thine endless wisdom, boundless power and awful purity!

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Oh, how I fear thee, living God!With deepest, tenderest fears,And worship thee h trembling hope And penitential tears.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Yet I may love thee too, O Lord,Almighty as thou art,For thou hast stooped to ask of me The love of my poor heart.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: No earthly father loves like thee,No mother e'er so mild,Bears and forbears as thou hast done With me thy sinful child.

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: Father of Jesus, love's reward,What rapture will it be,Prostrate before thy throne to lie,And gaze and gaze on thee!.

hymns.title: MY HOPE IS BUILT ON NOTHING LESS

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: My hope is built on nothing less Than Jesus' blood and rignteousness I dare not trust the sweetest frame But wholly kneel on Jesus' name. All other ground is sinking sandsinkingsand All other ground Is 2. When darkness seems to hide his face,I rest on his unchanging grace.In every high and stormy gale,My anchor holds within the veil

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: His oath is covenant and blood Support me in the whelming flood When all around my soul gives way,He then is all my hope and stay

hymns.title: MY LORD HE DIED FOR A KINGDOM

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: My Lord, he died for a Kingdom,To redeem the hearts of men,Now my people don't you weep He has risen from his sleep.He lives again, alleluia!

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: My Lord cameforth liketn morning, With the splendour of the sun;Came triumphant from the wort From the darkness of the tomb The victory won, Alleluia!

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: My Lord united our mountains,With the everlasting hills,Now the seasons and the sea,Sing his song of victory,The rocks and hills, Alleluia!

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: My Lord renewed all creation,That had waited late and long.Now we all with one accord,Live and love the risen Lord.This is our song, Alleluia!

hymns.refrain: Sing alleluia, the Lord is risen He is risen indeed Alleluial

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: The Lord is my shepherd,There is nothing I shall want.Fresh and green are the pastures Where he gives me repose.Near restful waters he leads me, To revive my drooping spirit.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: He guides me alonu theright path: He is true to his name. If I should walk in the valley of darkness No evil would I fear. You are there with your crook And your staff, With these you give me comfort.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: You have prepared a banquet for me In the sight of my foes. My head you have anointed with oil; My cup is overflowing.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Surely goodness and kindness shall Follow me All the days of my life.In the Lord's own house shall I dwell For ever and ever.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: To the Father and Son Give glory, Give glory to the Spirit To God who is, who was, And who will be For ever and ever.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: My song is love unknown,My Saviour's love to me, Love to the loveless shown, That they might lovely be. O whom am I, That for my sake, My Lord should take Frail flesh and die?

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: He came from his blest throne, Salvation to bestow; But men made strange, and none The longed-for Christ would know, But o, my friend, My friend indeed. Who at my need His life did spend!

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Sometimes they strew his way, And his sweet praises sing; Resounding all the day Hosannas to their King; Then 'Crucify!' Is all their breath, And for his death They thirst and cry.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Why, what hath my Lord done? What makes this rage and spite? He made the lanrun, He gave the bli Jir sight. Sweet injuries! Yet they at these Themselves displease, And 'gainst him rise.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: They rise, and needs will have My dear Lord made away, A murderer they save, The Prince of Life they slay. Yet cheerful he To suffering goes, That he his foes From thence might free.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: In life, no house, no home My Lord on earth might have: In death no friendly tomb But what a stranger gave. What may I say? Heaven was his home; But mine the tomb Wherein he lay.

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: Here might I stay and sing, No story so divine, Never was love, dear King, Never was grief like thine, This is my Friend, In whose sweep praise I all my days Could gladly spend.

hymns.title: MY SOUL IS LONGING FOR

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Lord,you know That my heart is not proud,And my eyes are not Lifted from the earth.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Lofty thoughts Have never filled my mind,Far beyond my sight All ambitious deeds.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: In your peace I have maintained my soul,I have kept my heart In your quite peace.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: As a child Rests on his mother's knee,So I place my soul In your loving care.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Israel,Put all your hope in God,Place your trust in him,Now and evermore.

hymns.refrain: near to you, my God.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Like the deer that yearns For running streams,So my soul is yearning For you, my God.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: My soul is thirsting for God,The God of my life;When can I enter and see The face of God?

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: My tears have become my bread,By night, by day;As I hear it said all day long:'Where is your God?'

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: These things will I remember As i pour out my soul:How I would lead the rejoicing crowd Into the house of God.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Why are you cast down, my soul,Why groan within me?Hope in God, I will praise him still,My Saviour and my God.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: (Praise the Father, the Son and Holy Spirit, both nowv and for ever, the God who is, who was and who will be world without er

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: My soul now glorify The Lord who is my Saviour.Rejoice for who am I That God has shown me favour?

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: The world shall call me blessed And ponder on my story.In me is manifest God's greatness and his glory.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: For those who are his friends And keep his law as holy,His mercy never ends And he exalts the lowly.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: But by his power the great,The proud, the self-conceited,The kings who sit in state Are humbled and defeated.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: He fills the starving poor.He guards his holy nation,Fulfilling what he swore Long since in revelation.

hymns.title: MAKE ME A CHANNEL OF YOUR PEACE

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Make me a channel of your peace Where there is hatred,Let me bring your love.Where there is injury,Your pardon,Lord. And where there's doubt, True faith in you.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Make me a channel of your peace Where there's despair in life,Let me bring hope.Where there is darkness Only light,And where there's sadness Ever joy.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Oh, Master,Grant that I may never seek So mush to be consoled As to console,To be understood as to understand,To be loved, as to love,With all my soul.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Make me a channel of your pead It is in pardoning That we are pardoned,In giving to all men That we receive,And in dying that we're Born to eternal life.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Man of sorrows, wrapt in grief.Bow thine ear to our relief; Thou for us the path hast trod Of the dreadful wrath of God; Lamb of love! we look to thee: Hear our mournful litany.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: By the garden fraught with woe,Whither thou full oft wouldst go; In the desolation there By the dire and deep distress Of that mystery fathomless Lord, our tears in mercy see Harken to our litany.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: By the chalice brimming o'er With disgrace and torment sore, By those lips which fain would pray That it might but pass away; By the heart which drank it dry, Lest a rebel race should die, Be thy pity, Lord our plea: Hear our solemn litany.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Man of sorrows let thy grief Purchase for us our relief. Lord of mercy bow thine ear Slow to anger swift to hear, By the cross's royal road Lead us to the throne of God, There for aye to sing to thee Heaven's triumphant litany.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Mary, O Mary, God's chosen one. Mother and guardian of holy vocations. Pray with us, pray for us, And for all those called by God.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Pray with us, pray for us And for all those called by God.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Pray with us, pray for us And for all those called by God Pray for us...called by God.

hymns.title: MARY HOW SWEETLY FALLS THAT WORD

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Mary how sweetly falls that word On my enraptured ear! Oft do I breathe in accents low, That sound when none are near. Sing o my lips and loudly proclaim O Mary, O Mary, how sweet is thy name. Sing o my lips and loudly proclaim O Mary, O Mary, how sweet is thy name.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: See how the wiles of the serpent assail us,see how we waver andd flinch in the fight;let thine immaculate merit avail us,make of our weakness a proof of thy might.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Bend from thy throne at the voice of our crying;bend to this earth which thy footsteps have trod;stretch out thine arms to us living and dying,Mary Immaculate,mother of God

hymns.title: MARY IMMACULATE, STAR OF THE MORNING

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Mary Immaculate, star of the morning, Chosen before the creation began, Chosen to bring, for thy bridal adorning, Woe to the serpent and rescue to man.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Here in an orbit of shadow and sadness Veiling thy splendour, thy course thou hast run; Now thou art throned in all glory and gladness, Crowned by the hand of thy Saviour and Son.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Mary is our queen, the star that shines so brightly, She's the star that shines guiding us to Jesus our true light.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Mary is the creature of our race Whom the Holy Spirit filled with grace.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Mary is our Queen, O sing to her,Mary is our Mother, trust in her,Mary is the star that shines at night guiding us to Jesus our true light.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Mary is the creature of our race Whom the Holy Spirit filled with crace,To become the Mother of our Lord,the God Whom she adored. Ave, Ave, Ave Maria! Ave, Ave, Ave Maria!

hymns.title: MINE EYES HAVE SEEN THE GLORY

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Mine eyes have seen the glory of the coming of the Lord.He is trampling out the vintage where the grapes of wrath are stored.He has loosed the fateful lightning of his terrible swift sword. His truth is marching on. Glory, glory halleluia! Glory, glory halleluia!Glory, glory halleluia! His truth is marching on.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: I have seen him in the watchfires of a hundred circling camps,They have gilded him an altar in the evening dews and damps.I can read his righteous sentence by the dim and flaring lamps His day is marching on.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: He has sounded forth the trumpet that shall never sound retreat.He is sifting out the hearts of men before his judgement seat. O, be swift my soul to answer him, be jubilant my feet! Our God is marching on.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: In the beauty of the lilies Christ was born across the sea with a glory in his bosom that transfigures you and me.As he died to make men holy,let us die to make men free,Whilst God is marching on.

hymns.title: MY FAITH LOOKS UP TO THEE

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: My faith looks up to thee, Thou Lamb of Calvary, Saviour divine; Now hear me while I pray; Take all my guilt away; O let me from this day Be wholly thine.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: May thy rich grace impart Strength to my fainting heart,My zeal inspire,As thou hast died for me.O may my love to thee Pure, warm, and changeless be,

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: My God loves me,His love will never end,He rests within my heart for my God loves me.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: His gentle hand he stretches over me.Though storm-clouds threaten the day He will set me free.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: He comes to me in sharing bread and wine,He brings me life that wvill rea past the end of time.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: My God loves me,his faithful love endures.And I will live like a child held in love secure.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: The joys of love as offerings now we bring.The pains of love will be lost in the praise we sing.Verse 1 Anonym

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Nearer, my God to thee;Nearer to thee! Even though it be a cross That raiseth me;Still all my song shall be,Nearer, my God to thee, Nearer to thee!

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Though, like the wanderer, the sun gone down,Darkness be over me,my rest a stone,Yet in my dreams I'd be Nearer, my God to thee, Nearer to thee!

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: There let the way appear steps unto heaven; All that thou send'st to me in mercy given;Angels to beckon on me Nearer, my God to thee,Nearer to thee!

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Then, with my waking thoughts bright with thy praise,Out of my stony griefs Bethel I'll raise; So by my woes to be Nearer, my God to thee, Nearer to thee!

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Or if on joyful wing cleaving the sky,Sun,moon, and stars forgot,upwards I fly,Still all mysong shall be,Nearer, my God to thee,Nearer to thee!

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Deep in thy Sacred Heart Let me abide, Thou that hast bled for me Sorrowed and died Grief surely leading me Nearer, my God to thee, Nearer to thee!.

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: Friends may depart from me,Night may come down. Clouds of adversity Darken and frown Hope gently leading me Nearer, my God to thee, Nearer to thee!

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: New praises be given To Christ newly crowned,Who, back to his heaven A new way hath found;God's blessedness sharing Before us he goes,What mansions preparing,What endless reposel.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: His glory still praising On thrice holy ground The apostles stood gazing, His mother around; With hearts that beat faster, With eyes full of love, They watched while their master Ascended above.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: "No star can disclose him", The bright angels said; "Eternity knows him, Your conquering head; Those high habitations, He leaves not again, Till, judging all nations, On earth he shall reign".

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Thus spoke they and straightway, Where legions defend Heaven's glittering gateway, Their Lord they attend, And cry, looking thither, "Your portals let down For him who rides hither In peace and renown”.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: They asked, who keep sentry In that blessed town, "Who thus claimeth entry,A king of renown?" "The Lord of all valiance”,That herald replied, “Who Satan's battalions Laid low in their pride".

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Grant, Lord, that our longing May follow thee there,On earth who are thronging Redeemer, thine own Where thou with thy Father Dost sit on the throne. St.Bede the Venerable(673.7

hymns.title: NOW THANK WE ALL OUR GOD

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Now thank we all our God With heart and hands and voice Who wondrous things hath don In whom this world rejoices; Who from our mother's arms Hath blessed us on our way With countless gifts of love, And still is ours today.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: O may this bounteous God Through all our life be near us With ever joyful hearts And blessed peace to cheer u And keep us in his grace, And guide us when perplexed And free us from all ills In this world and the next.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: All praise and thanks to God The Father now be given The Son and him who reigns With them in highest heaven. The one Eternal God,Whom earth and heaven adore; And shall be evermore.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: O blessed saint Joseph, how great was thy worth. The one chosen shadow of God up on earth. Called Father of Jesus ah, then wilt thou be. Sweet Spouse of our Lady a father to me.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Far thou to the pilgrim art father and guide. And Jesus and Mary felt safe by thy side; Ah blessed saint Joseph, how safe should I be. Sweet Spouse of Our Lady if thou were with me.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: When the treasures of God were unsheltered on earth, Safe keeping was found for them both in thy worth; O Father of Jesus, be father to me, Sweet Spouse of Our lady and

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: O come, all ye faithful, joyful and triumphant, O come ye, O come ye to Bethlehem; Come and behold him, Born the king of angels: O come, let us adore him, O come let us adore him, O come, let us adore him, Christ the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: God of God, Light of light, Lo! he abhors not the virgin's womb; Very God, Begotten not created:

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: See how the shepherds Summoned to his cradle, Leaving their flocks, draw nigh to gaze; Wee too will thither Bend our joyful foot-steps:

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Lo, star-led chieftains, Magi, Christ adoring, Offer him inc ise, gold, and myrrh: We to the Christ-child Bring our hearts' oblations:

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Child, for us sinners Poor and in the manger,Fain we embrace thee with love and awe;Who would not love thee, Loving us so dearly?

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Sing, chcirs of angels,Sing in exultation,Sing all ye citizens of heaven above:Glory to God In the highest:

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: Yea! Lord, we greet thee,Born this happy morning,Jesu, to thee be glory given,Word of the Father,now in flesh appearing.

hymns.title: O COME AND MOURN WITH ME AWHILE

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: O come and mourn with me awhile; See, Mary calls us to her side; O come and let us mourn with her; Jesus our love, is crucified.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Have we no tears to shed for him,While soldiers scoff and men deride?Ah! Look how patiently he hangs;

verses.label: VERSE 3

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: O break, o break,hard heart of mine;Thy weak self-love and guilty pri His Pilate and his Judas were;

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: A broken heart, a fount of tears,Ask, and they will not be denier A broken heart, love's cradle is

verses.text: O love of God! O sin of man!In this dread act your strength is tried;And victory remains with love;
