verses.text: O come, O come, Emmanuel And ransom captive Israel,That mourns in lonely exile he Until the Son of God appear, Rejoice, rejoice! Emmanuel Shall come to thee, o lsrael.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: O come, thou rod of Jesse; free Thine own from Satan's tyranny;From depths of hell thy people save, And give them vict'ry o'er the grave;

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: O come, thou dayspring, come and cheer Our spirits by thine advent here; Disperse the gloomy clouds of night, And death's dark shadows put to flight.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: O come, thou key of David; come And open wide our heavenly home; Make safe the way that leads on high, And close the path to misery.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: O come, o come, thou Lord of might, Who to thy tribes on Sinai's height In ancient times didst give the law In cloud and majesty and awe. From the 'Great O Antiphons'

hymns.title: O COME TO THE THRONE OF GRACE
hymns.attribution: Mother of grace, pray for us.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: O come to the throne of grace. O come to the heart most pure. To Mary, our hope of life, In whom salvation is sure. O Queen of the Rosary hail! Immaculate Mother of grace; O pray for us, help us today; Thou hope of the human race.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Immaculate heart we kneel, To consecrate all to thee; The present, its pain and joy, The future all it may be.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: The Rosary white and gold, We take from thy Virgin hand; A pledge of the pow'r of God. To heal and strengthen our land.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Coda; O pray for us, help us today; Thou hope of the human race.

hymns.title: O GIVE THANKS TO THE LORD
hymns.attribution: To the God of heaven give tha

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: O give thanks to the lord for he is good, Great is his love; love without end Give thanks to the God of gods, Great is his love; love without end, Give thanks to the Lord of lord.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Who alone has wrought marvelous works, Great is his love; love without eri, Whose wisdom it was made the skies, Great is his love; love without end, Who spread the earth on the seas.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: It was he who made the great lights, Great is his love; love without end, The sun to rule in the day, Great is his love; love without end. The moon and stars in the night.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: The first-born of the Egyptians he smote, Great is his love; love without end. Brought Israel out from their midst, Great is his love; love without end. Arm outstretched, with power in his hand.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: e divided the Red Sea in two.Great is his love; love without en Made Israel passthrough midst,Great is his love; love without en Flung Pharaoh and his force in the sea.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Through the desert his people he led, Great is his love; love without en Nations in their greatness he struck, Great is his love; love withouter Kings in their splendour he sle

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: He let Israel inherit their land, Great is his love; love withoute On his servant their land bestowed Great is his love; love withoute He remembered us in our distre

verses.label: VERSE 8
verses.text: And he snatched us away from our foes, Great is his love; love withoute He gives food to all living thing Great is his love; love withoute

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: O God, our help in ages past,Our hope for years io come,Our shelter from the stormy blast,And our eternal home;

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Beneath the shadow of thy throne,Thy saints have dwelt secure;Sufficient is thine arm alone,And our defence is sure.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Before the hills in order stood Or earth received her frame,From everlasting thou art God,To endless years the same.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: A thousand ages in thy sight,Are like an evening gone;Short as the watch that ends the night.Before the rising sun.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Time, like an ever-rolling stream,Bears all its sons away;They fly forgotten, as a dream Dies at the opening day.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: O God, our help in ages past Our hope for years to come,Be thou our guard while troubles last And our eternal home.

hymns.title: O FATHER, TAKE IN SIGN OF LOVE

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: O Father, take in sign of love these gifts of bread and wine! With them we give our very selves, to be for ever thine!

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: These gifts another gift will be, thy Son in very deed, for us a willing victim made, the Lamb on whom we feed!

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: These are the gifts thy Son did bless the night before he died. By which he showed himself a priest and victim crucified!

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: He now has given us as our own his offering made to thee: his body broken, Blood outpoured, for us on Calvary!

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: O holy night, the stars are brightly shining It is the night of the dear Saviour's birth. Long lay the world in sin and error pining Till he appeared and the soul felt his worth. A thrill of hope the weary world rejoices For yonder breaks a new and cloudless morn Fall on your knees. O hear the angel voices O night divine. O night when Christ was born. O night divine. O night O night divine.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Led by the light of faith serenely beaming, With glowing hearts by his cradle to stand, Led by the light of the star so brightly gleaming, Here came the wise men

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: O Jesus Christ,remember When thou shalt come again Upon the clouds of heaven,With all thy shining train; When every eyeshallsee the In deity revealed, Who now upon this altar In silence art concealed.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Remember then, O Saviour,I supplicate of thee, That here I bowed before thee Upon my bended knee; That here I owned thy preseng And did not thee deny, And glorified thygreatness Though hid from human eye.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Accept, divine Redeemer,The homage of my praise;Be thou the light and honour And glory of my days. Be thou my consolation When death is drawing nigh; Be thou my only treasure Through all eternity.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: O Jesus! Jesus! dearest Lord Forgive me if I say,For very love thy sacred Name A thousand times a day.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: I love thee so, I know not how;My transports to control Thy love is like a burning fire Within my very soul.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: O wonderful that thou should'st let So vile a heart as mine;Love Thee with such a love as this And make so free with thine.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: For thou to me art all in all My honour and my wealth.My heart's desire,my body's strength My soul's eternal health.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: What limit is there to thy love?Thy flight where wilt thou stay?On on! Lord is sweeter far,Today than yesterday.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: O Love of Jesus; blessed love,so will it ever be time cannot hold thy wondrous growth no, nor eternity.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: O Jesus, we adore thee,Who in thy love divine.Conceal thy mighty God-head,In forms of bread and wine. O Sacrament most holy O Sacrament divine, All praise and all thanksgiving Be evi'ry moment thine!

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: O Jesus, we adore thee Our victim and our Priest,Whose precious blood and body.Become our sacred feast.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: O Jesus, we adore thee,Our Saviour and our King.And with the saints and angels,A humble homage bring.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: O Jesus, we adore thee,Come, live in us, we pray,That all our thoughts and actions,Be thine alone today.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: O come all you who labour in sorrow and in pain;come, eat this bread from heaven,your peace and strength regain.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: O little town of Bethlehem, How still we see thee lie! Above thy deep and dreamless sleep The silent stars go by.Yet, in thy dark streets shineth The everlasting light; The hopes and fears of all the years Are met in thee tonight!

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: O morning stars, together Proclaim the holy birth, And praises sing to god the King, And peace to men on earth, For Christ is born of Mary; And gathered all above, While mortals sleep, the angels keep Their watch of wondering love.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: How silently, how silently, The wondrous gift is given So God imparts to human hearts The blessings of his heaven. No ear may hear his coming; But in this world of sin, Where meek souls will receive him, still The dear Christ enters in.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Where children pure and happy Pray to the blessed Child, Where misery cries out to thee Son of the mother mild; The dark night wakes, the glory breaks,And Christmascomesonce more

hymns.title: O LORD, I AM NOT WORTHY

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: O Lord, I am not worthy, That thou shouldst come to me, But speak the word of comfort My spirit shall be healed.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: I am longing to receive thee, The bridegroom of my soul, No more by sin to grieve thee, Or flee thy sweet control.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: O Lord, thou art all holy The angels thee adore; How,then ought I sincerely My wrongs and sins deplore!

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: But wwhen thou soon wilt enter, My heart, my sinful heart, Then heal me, be my shelter, For thou my Saviour art.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: O Lord, how can I thank thee,For such a gift as this?A gift which truly filleth My soul with heavenly bliss.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: I praise thee, I extol thee,I love thee, O my Sire,Till once in joy and glory In heav'n I'll Thee admire.

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: O Sacrament Most Holy,O Sacrament Divine,All praise and all thanksgiving Be every moment thine.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: O Paradisel O Paradise!Tis weary waiting here;I long to be where Jesus is,To feel, to see Him near.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: O Paradise! O Paradise!I want to sin no more;I want to be as pure on earth.As on the spotless shore.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: O Paradise! O Paradise!I feel 'twill not be long Patience; I almost think I hear Faint fragments of thy song

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: O Paradise! O Paradise!Who doth not crave for rest?Who would not seek the happy land. Where they that loved are blest? When loyal hearts and true,Stand ever in the light,All rapture through and through.In God's most.holy sight.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: O Paradisel O Paradise!Wherefore doth death delay?Bright death that is the welcome dawn Of our eternal day. O PERFECT LOVE

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: O perfect love,All human thought transcending,Lowly we kneel In prayer before thy throne.That theirs may be The love which knows no ending Whom thou for evermore Dost join in one.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: O perfect life,Be thou their full assurance Of tender charity And steadfast faith,Of patient hope,And quiet, brave endurance,With childlike trust That fears no pain nor death.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Grant them the joy Which brightens earthly sorrow, Grant them the peace Which calms all earthly strife; And to life's day The glorious unknown morrow, That dawns upon Eternal love and life.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: O Paradise! O Paradise! Who doth not crave for rest? Who would not seek the happy land Where they that loved are blest? Where loyal hearts and true Stand ever in the light, All rapture through and through, In God's most holy sight.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: O Paradise! O Paradise! The world is growing old; Who would not be at rest and free Where love is never cold?

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: O Paradise! O Paradise! 'Tis weary waiting here; I long to be where Jesus is, To feel, to see Him near.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: O Paradise! O Paradise! I want to sin no more; I want to be as pure on earth As on the spotless shore.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: O Paradise! O Paradise! I feel 'twill not be long; Patience; I almost think I hear Faint fragments of thy song.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: O Sacrament most holy, O Sacrament divine! All praise and all thanksgiving Be every moment thine.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: NowN come, all you who labour In sorrow and in pain, Come, eat this bread from heaven; Thy peace and strength regain.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Lord Jesus, we adore thee Our victim and our priest, Whose precious blood and body Become our sacred feast.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: O Sacrament Most Holy, O Sacrament divine! All praise and all thanksgiving

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: O Sacred Heart,Our home lies deep in thee; O Sacred heart.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: O Sacred heart, Thou fount of contrite tears,Where'er those living waters tlon

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: O Sacred Heart, Bless our dear native land; May Nigeria's sons in truth e'er stand, With faith's bright banner still in hand, O Sacred Heart.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: O Sacred Heart, Our trust is all in thee, For though earth's night be dark and drear, Thou breathest rest where thou art near, O Sacred Heart.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: O Sacred Heart, When shades of death shall fa Receive us 'neath thy gentle c And save us from the tempter's snare. O Sacred Heart.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: o Sacred Heart,Lead exiled children home, Where we may ever rest near thee, In peace and joy eternally,o Sacred Heart.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Oh when the saints go marching in,Oh when the saints go marching in,I want to be in that number,When the saints go marching in.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Oh when the drums begin to bang,Oh when the drums begin to bang,I want to be in that number,When the drums begin to bang.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Oh when the stars fall from the sky,Oh when the stars fall from the sky,I want to be in that number,When the stars fall from the sky.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Oh when the moon turns into blood,Oh when the moon turns into blood,I want to be in that number,When the moon turns into blood.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Oh when the sun turns into fire,Oh when the sun turns into fire,I want to be in that number,When the sun turns into fire.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Oh when the fires begin to blaze Oh when the fires begin to blaze,I want to be in that number,When the fires begin to blaze.

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: Oh when the lord calls out the names, Oh when the lord calls out the names,I want to be in that number,When the Lord calls out the names.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: O worship the King All glorious above; O gratefully sing His power and his love; Our shield and defender, The ancient of days, Pavilioned in splendour, And girded with praise.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: O tell all his might, O sing of his grace, Whose robe is the light, Whose canopy space, His chariots of wrath, The deep thunder-clouds form, And dark is his path On the wings of the storm.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: This earth, with its store Of wonders untold,Almighty, thy power Hath founded ofold;Hath stabished it fast By a changeless decree,And round it hath cast,Like a mantle, the sea.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Thy bountiful care What tongue can recite?It breathes in the air,It shines in the light It streams from the hills,It descends to the plain,And sweetly distils In the dew and the rain.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Frail, children of dust,And feeble as frail,In thee do we trust,Nor find thee to fail;Thy mercies how tender!How firm to the end!Our maker, defender,Redeemer, and friend.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: O measureless might,Ineffable love,While angels delight To hymn thee above,Thy humbler creation,Though feeble their lays,With true adoration Shall sing to thy praise.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Low at his feet lay th/burden of carefulness;High on his heart he will bear it for thee,Comfort thy sorrows, and answ thy prayerfulnesS, Guiding thy steps as may best for thee be.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Fear not to enter his courts in the slenderness Of the poor wealth thou wouldst reckon as thine:Truth in its beauty,and love in its tenderness,These are the offerings to lay on his shrine.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: These,though we bring themin trembling and fearfulness,He will accept for the name that is dear;Mornings of joy give for evening of tearfulness,Trust for our trembling and ho for our fear.The first verse may be repeatad al end.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: By his word was all created,He commanded, it was done,Heaven and earth and depth of ocean,Universe of three in one,All that grows berieath the shining.Of the light of moon and sun:Evermore and evermore.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Blessed was the day for ever When the virgin, full of grace By the Holy Ghost conceiving Bore the Saviour of our race,And the child, the world's redeemer,First revealed his sacred face.Evermore and Evermore.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: O, ye heights of heaven, adore him Angels and archangels sing!Every creature bow before him Singing praise to God our King:Let no earthly tongue be silent,All the world with homage ring:Evermore and Evermore. for a crown.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: He, by prophets sung, is here now Promised since the world began Now on earth in flesh descended To atone for sins of man All creation praise its Master,See fulfillment of his plan.Evermore and Evermore.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Glory be to god the Father,Glory be to God the Son,Glory be to the Holy Spirit,Persons three, yet Godhead one.Glory be from all creation While eternal ages run:Evermore and Evermore. Aurelius C. Prudentius (348-c413)tr.J.M.Neale(1818-66)H.W.Baker(1821-77) and others.

hymns.title: OLD RUGGED CROSS (ON A HILL FOR AWAY)

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: On a hill far away Stood an old rugged cross,The emblem of suff'ring and shame;And I loved that old cross Where the dearest and best,For a world of lost sinners was slain. So I'll cherish the old rugged cross Till my trophies at last I lay down,I will cling to the old rugged cross And exchange it someday

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Oh that old rugged cross So despised by the world,Has a wondrous attraction for me;For the dear lamb of God Left his glory above to bear it to dark Calvary.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: In the old rugged cross,Stained with blood so divine,A wondrous beauty I see.For 'twas on that old cross Jesus suifered and died To pardion and sanctify me.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: To the old rugged cross I will ever be true,Its shame and reproach gladly bear.Then he'll call me some day To my home far away There his glory for ever I'll share.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: On Jordan's bank the Baptist's cry announces that the lord is nigh,come then and hearken for he brings glad tidings from the King of kings.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Then cleansed be every Christian breast, and furnished for so great a guest!Yea,let us each our hearts prepare, For Christ to come and enter there.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: For thou art our salvation Lord,without thygraceoursouls m fade,and wither like a flower decayed

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Stretch forth thy hand, to heal ou sore,and make us rise, to fall no moy and fill the world with love divira

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: All praise, eternal Son, to thee whose advent sets thy peopletwhom,with the Father,we ado and Holy Ghost, for evermore, C.Coffin(1676-1749)t.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Once in royal David's city,Stood a lowly cattle shed,Where a mother laid her baby In a manger for his bed:Mary was that .nother mild,Jesus Christ her little child.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: He came down to earth from heaven,who is God and Lord of all,and his shelter was a stable and his cradle was a stall;with the poor, the mean,andio lived on earth our Saviourhol

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: And through all his wondrous childhood He would honour and cey,Love,and watch the I.ly maiden In whose gentle arms...lay;Christian children ali must be Mild, obedient, good as he.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: For he is our childhood's pattern,Day by day like us he grew;He was little, weak and helpless,Tears and smiles like us he knew;And he feeleth for our sadness,And he shareth in our gladness.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: And our eyes at last shall see him Through his own redeeming love,For that child so dear and gentle Is our Lord in heaven above;And he leads his children on To the place where ho is gone.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Not in that poor lowly stable,with the oxen standing by,we shall see him; but in heaven,set at God's right hand on high;when like stars his children crowned all in white shall wait around.Cecll Francis Alexander(1818-95)

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Once more; my soul,Thy saviour through thy word Is offered full and free.And now,O Lord,I must, I must decide:Shall I accept of thee? I will, I will, I will, I will,I will, God helping me, I will,O Lord, be thine.Thy precious blood Was shed to purchase me,I will be wholly thine.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: By grace I will,Thy mercy now receive.Thy love my heart hath won.In thee,O Christ,I will, I will believe,And trust in thee alone.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Thou knowest Lord,How very weak I am,And now I fear to stray For strength to serve,I look to thee alone;Thy strength you most supply.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Onward Christian soldiers, Marching as to war, With the Cross of Jesus Going on before. Christ the royal Master Leads against the foe; Forward into battle, See his banners go! Onward, Christian Soldiers, Marching as to war, With the cross of Jesus Golng on before.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: At the sign of triumph Satan's legions flee; On then, Christian soldiers, On to victory. Hell's foundations quiver At the shout of praise; Brothers, lift your voices, Loud your anthem raise.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Like a mighty army Moves the Church of God. Brothers we are treading Where the Saints have trod, We are not divided, All one body we, One in hope and doctrine, One in charity. Kingdoms rise and wane, But the Church of Jesus Constant will remain; Gates of hell can never 'Gainst that Church prevail;We have Christ's own promise,

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Onward, then, ye people, Join our happy throng, Blend with ours your voices In the triumph song, Glory, laud, and honour, Unto Christ the king: This through countless ages Men and engels sing.

hymns.title: O BLESSED ARE THOSE WHO

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: By the labour of your hands you shall eat; You will be happy and prosper, Your wife like a fruitful vine, In the heart of your house; Your children like shoots of the Olive Around your table.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Indeed, thus shall be blessed,The man who fears the Lord;May the Lordbless you fromtZion,All the days of yourlife;May you see your children's children In a happy Jerusalem.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Praise the father, the Son,and the Holy Spirit,Both now and for ever;World without end. Amen.On Israel, peace.

hymns.refrain: And walk in his ways.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: O come divine Messiah,The world in silence waits the day When hope shall sing its triumph,And sadness flee away. Dear Saviour, haste,Come,come to earth;Dispel the night and show thy face,And bid us hail the dawn of grace.O come, divine Messiah!The world in silence waits the day When hope shall sing its triumph,And sadness flee away.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: O thou, whom nations sighed for,Whom priests and prophets long foretold Will break the captive fetters;Redeem the long-lost fold.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Shall come in peace and meekness,And lowly will thy cradle be;All clothed in human weakness, Shall we mhy Godhead see.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: O Sacred head sore wounded,Defiled and put to scorn,O kingly head surrounded With mocking crown of thorn,What sorrow mars thy grandeur?Can death thy bloom deflower?O countenance whose splendour The hosts of heaven adore.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Thy beauty, long-desired,Hath vanished from our sight;Thy power is all expired,And quenched the light of light.Ah me! For whom thou diest,Hide not so far thy grace:Show me, O love most highest,The brightness of thyface.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: I pray thee, Jesu, own me,Me,shepherd good, for thine;Who to thy fold hast won me,And fed wwith truth divine.Me guilty, me refuse not;Incline thy face to me,This comfort that I lose not On earth to comfort thee.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: In thy most bitter passion My heart to share doth cry,With thee for mny salvation Upon the cross to die.Ah,keep my heart thus moved To stand thy cross beneath,To mourn thee,well-beloved,Yet thank thee for thy death.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: My days are few, o fail not,With thine immortal power,To hold me that I quail not In death's most fearful hour:That I may fight befriended,And see in my last strife To me thine arms extended Upon the crossof life.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Oh! Sing praises; Oh! Sing praises;Oh! Sing praises to God most high. Oh! Sing, praises; Ohl Sing praises; Sing praises; sing praises; Sing pralses to God most high.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: For his goodness and compassion Is bestowed upon his children.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: For his good, he made us To adore him forever.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: For his love, he loved us;

hymns.title: OUR FATHER

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Our Father, who art in heaven, Hallowed be your name. Your Kingdom come; Your will be done on earth; As it is done, As it's done in heaven.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Give us this day, Our daily bread; And forgive us, Father, forgive us our trespasses.

hymns.refrain: Hallowed be your name.

hymns.title: 532 PASS ME NOT, O GENTLE SAVIOUR

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Pass me not, O gentle Saviour, Hear my humble cry; While on others thou art calling, Do not pass me by. Savlour, Savlour, hear my humble cry; And while others thou art calling Do not pass me by.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Let me at a throne of mercy Find a sweet relief; Kneeling there in deep contrition, Help my unbelief.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Trusting only in thy merit, Would I seek thy face; Heal my wounded, broken spirit, Save me by thy grace.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Thou the spring of all my comfort, More than life to me; Whom have I on earth besides thee? Whom in heaven but thee?

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Peace, perfect peace, In this dark world of sin? The blood of Jesus whispers Peace within.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Peace, perfect peace, By thronging duties pressed? To do the will of Jesus, this is rest.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Peace, perfect peace, With sorrows surging round? On Jesus' bosom nought but calm is found.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Peace, perfect peace, With loved ones far away? In Jesus' keeping we are safe, and they.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Peace, perfect peace, Our future all unknown? Jesus we know, and he is on the throne.

hymns.title: PRAISE GOD FROM WHOM
hymns.attribution: Till sun shall rise and set no more.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Praise God from whom all blessings flow: here below; Praise him above, ye heavenly host; Praise Father, Son, and Holy Ghost.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: From all that dwell below the skies Let the Creator's praise arise!Let the Redeemer's name be sung Through ev'ry land by ev'ryone.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Eternal are thy mercies, Lord,And truth eternal is thy word;Thy praise shall sound from shore to shore

hymns.title: PRAISE, MY SOUL, THE KING OF HEAVEN

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Praise, my soul, the king of heaven! To his feet thy tribute bring. Ransomed, healed, restored,forgiven, Who like me his praise should sing? Praise him! Praise him! Praise him! Praise him! Praise the everlasting king!

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Praise him for his grace and favour Praise him! Praise him!

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Father-like he tends and spares us in his hands he gently bears us,Praise him! Praise him!Praise him! Praise him!Widely as his mercy flows!

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Angels, help us to adore him;ye behold him face to face;sun and moon bow down before him, Praise him! Praise him!

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Praise the Lord! Ye heavens,adore him; praise him, angels, in the height sun and moon, rejoice before him praise him, all ye stars of light.Praise the Lord! For he hat spoken;worlds his mighty voice obeyed laws, which never shall be broki"for their guidance he hath made

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Praise the Lord! For he is glorious;Never shall his promise fail:God hath made his saints victorious; sin and death shall not prevail. Praise the God of our salvation; hosts on high, his power proclaim;heaven and earth and all creation, laud and magnify his name!

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Worship, honour, glory, blessing, Lord, we offer to thy name; Young and old, thy praise expressing, join their Saviour to proclaim. As the saints in heaven adore thee, We would bow before thy throne; as thine angels serve before thee, so on earth thy will be done. Verses 1-2 from the Foundling Hospital Collection (1796)

hymns.title: PRAISE TO THE LORD, THE ALMIGHTY

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Praise to the Lord, the Almighty, the King of creation! O my soul, praise him, for he is your health and salvation All you who hear, now to his altar draw near, join in profound adoration.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Praise to the Lord, let us offer our gifts at his altar;and transgressions now cause us to falter. Christ, the High Priest, bids us all join in his feast. Victims with him on the altar.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Praise to the Lord, oh, let all that is in us adore him! All that has life and breath, come now in praises before him. Let the Amen sound from his people again, now as we worship before him. Joachim Neander (1650-80)

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Precious promise God hath given To the weary passer-by, On the way from earth to heaven, "I wilI guide thee with mine eyes" “I will guide thee, I will guide thee, I will guide thee with mine eyes" On the way from earth to heaven, I will guide thee with mine eyes"

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: When temptations almost win thee, And thy trusted watchers fly, Let this promise ring within thee: "I will guide thee with mine eyes."

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: When thy secret hopes have perished In the grace of years gone by.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: When the shades of life are falling,And the hour has come to die,Hear thy trusty Leader calling:"I will guide thee with mine eyes"

verses.label: VERSE 8

verses.label: VERSE 9

verses.label: VERSE 13

verses.label: VERSE 14
verses.text: We sing to you, o M ia which God gives his people We give you praise, o living Bread which comes down to us from heaven.

verses.label: VERSE 15
verses.text: We sing to you, the image of the Father eternal.We give you praise, o king of justice, Lord, and the king of peace.

verses.label: VERSE 16
verses.text: We sing to you, the first born of all God's creation.We give you praise, salvation of your saints sleeping in the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 17

hymns.title: PRAISE TO THE HOLIEST IN THE HEIGHT

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Praise to the Holiest in the height,and in the depth be praise,in all his words most wonderful,most sure in all his ways.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: O loving wisdom of our God!when all was sin and shame,a second Adam to the fight,and to the rescue came.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: O wisest lovel That flesh and blood which did in Adam fail,should strive afresh against the foe,should strive and should prevail;

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: And that a higher gift thangrace should flesh and blood refine,God's presence and his very self,and essence all divine.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: O generous love! that he who smote in man for man the foe,the double agony in man for an should undergo.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: And in the garden secretly and on the cross on high,should teach his brethren,and inspire to suffer and to die.

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: Praise to the Holiest in the height,and in the depth be praise,in all his words most wonderful,most sure in all his ways.

verses.label: VERSE 3

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: He sits at God's right hand Till all his foes submit,And bow to his command,And fall beneath his feet:

verses.text: Rock of ages, cleft for me, Let me hide myself in thee, Let the water and the blood, From thy riven side which flowed, Be of sin the double cure: Cleanse me from its guilt and power.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: You have special prayers For God's chosen ones; Hold me within your care As you cherished my master

hymns.refrain: Take me and gulde me To the school of your son.

hymns.title: RHYTHM OF HONOUR WE GIVE

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Lord, we exult your name;We believe you are present In the Eucharist; Bless us, and sanctify us, As we receive your body and blood.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Lord, we are not worthy,To receive you In the holy sacrament; Forgive us, Lord, And make us worthy; (Just) Say a word, And we shall be healed.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Loving Jesus, I love you;I love you with all of my heart;Keep us close to your loving heart, And may nothing Everseparate us from you.

verses.label: VERSE 4

hymns.refrain: A well deserved honour. The Father, the Son and Holy Ghost The Trinity in one God, Receive our praises; Recelve our prayers; As we give you This rhythm of honour.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Saviour, like a shepherd lead us,Much we need thy tender care.In thy pleasant pastures, feed us,For our use thy folds prepare.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: We are thine, do thou befriend us,Be the guardian of our way.Keep thy flock from sin, defend us, Seek us when we go astray. Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus,Hear, O hear us when we pray.D.S·2

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Thou hast promised to receive us,Poor and sinful though we be.Thou hast mercy to relieve us,Grace to cleanse and power to free. Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus,Early let us turn to thee. D.S.3

verses.label: VERSE 4

verses.text: Thy hand, O God, has guided Thy flock from age to age; The wondrous tale is written, Full clear, on ev'ry page; Our fathers owned thy goodness, And we their deeds record; And both of this bear witness: One Church, one Faith, one Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: And we, shall we be faithless? Shall hearts fail, hands hang down? Shall we evade the conflict, And cast away our crown? Not so: in God's deep counsels Some better thing is stored; We will maintain, unflinching, One Church, one Faith, one Lord.

verses.text: All that I need, all that I pray, Everything I will ever have. Take my life and take my all, Everything I will ever have.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: All that I dream, all that I crave, Everything I will ever be. Take my life and take my all, Everything I will ever be.

hymns.refrain: Take and sanctify these gifts For your honour Lord.

hymns.title: UPON MY LIPS LORD

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: In you, o Lord, I take my refuge: Let your goodness shelter me; For you are my rock and my fortress, Do not leave me, Lord, my God.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: O Lord, you are my hope and my salvation, Help me in my need: My lips shall sing forever; Glory, praise to you, o Lord.

hymns.refrain: Upon my lips Lord, put words of glory and praise. For your splendour I shout with joy; Let all the earth resound with praise to you, When I sing, Lord, to you!

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: We bring our gifts, Lord,bread and wine We bring our gifts, Lord,bread and wine We bring ourselves, Lord,heart and mind O Lord, Kumbaya.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Make us one, Lord, as you prayed. Make us one, Lord, as you prayed; Grant us peace Lord,hear our prayer, O Lord, Kumbaya.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Let us love Lord, as you loved,Let us love Lord, as you loved,In this banquet Lord,we find strength.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: We gather together to ask the Lord's blessing, He chastens and hastens his will to make known; The wicked oppressing Now cease from distressing, Sing praises to his name; he forgets not his own.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Beside us to guide us, our God with us joining,Ordaining, maintaining his kingdom divine; So from the beginning the fight we were winning:Thou, Lord, wast at our side;all glory be thine!

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: We all do extol thee,thou leader triumphant.And pray that thou still our defender wilt be. Let thy congregation escape tribulation: Thy name be ever praised!O Lord, make us free!

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: We offer praises, thankful praises,To our Lord and king, Who gives us all our many bounties, Makes our hearts to sing.His hand best to us every blessing Every joy we know. Of earthly good, he is the author;Praise him all below. (O praise him) Thankful praises to our God and King, Who gives us all our many bounties, Makes our hearts to sing.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: The fields that were in golden ripens. In the autumn. The fruit that in a thousand orchards,Weigh the branches down. All this and more than we can number, Father,thou dost send.(O praise him)

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: With all, O Lord,that thou dost give us, May we honour thee.And for the comforts that surround us, Ever thankful be. To thee and thee alone we offer Grateful songs of praise,And ask thee to attend and bless us Through the coming day.

hymns.title: WE PLOUGH THE FIELDS AND SCATTER

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: We plough the fieIds and scatter the good seed on the land,but it is fed and watered by God's almighty hand;he sends the snow in winter,the warmth to swell the grain,the breezes and the sunshine, and soft refreshing rain. All good gifts around us Are sent from heav'n above Then thank the Lord, O thank the Lord for all hls love.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: He only is the maker Of all things near and far; He paints the wayside flower, He lights the ev'ning star, The winds and waves obey him, By him the birds are fed; Much more to us his children, He gives our daily bread.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: We thank thee then, O Father, For all things bright and good: The seed-time and the harvest, our life, our health, our food. No gifts have we to offer For all thy love imparts, But that which thou desirest, Our humble, thankful hearts. M.Claudius (1740-1815).

hymns.title: WE SHALL GO UP WITH

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: I rejoiced when I heard them say:"Let us go to God's house;"And now our feet are standing Within your gates, o Jerusalem.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Jerusalem is built as a city,Strongly compact,It is there that the tribes go up;The tribes of the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: For Israel's law it is,There to praise the Lord's name;There were set the thrones of judgement Of the house of David.

hymns.refrain: We shall go into the house of the Lord. Antiphon:II We shall go up with joy to the house of our God.

hymns.title: WE THREE KINGS OF ORIENT ARE

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: We three Kings of Orient are;Bearing gifts we traverse afar,Field and fountain,moor and Mountain, following yonder star. O Star of wonder, star of night,Star with royal beauty bright,Westward leading,still proceeding Guide us to thy perfect light.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Born a King on Bethlehem plain Gold I bring,to crown him again King for ever,ceasing never,Over us all to reign.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Frankincense to offer have l,Incense owns a Deity nigh.Prayer and praising,all men raising,Worship him, God most high.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Myrrh is mine, its bitter perfume Breathes a life of gathering gloom;Sorrowing,sighing,bleeding, dying,Sealed in the stone-cold tomb.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Glorious now behold him arise,King and God and sacrifice;Alleluia, alleluia.Earth to heaven replies.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: When I was hungry,you gave me to eat.When I was thirsty you gave me to drink.Now enter into the home of my father.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: When I was homeless you opened your door,When I was naked you gave me your coat,Now enter into the home of my father.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: When I was weary you helped me find rest,When I was anxious you calmed all my fears.Now enter into the home of my father.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: When I was restless,you listened and cared,When I was lonely you gave me your love,Now enter into the home of my father.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: When in a prison you came to my cell,When on a sick bed,you cared for my needs,Now enter into the home of my father.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: In a strange country you made me at home,Seeking employment you found me a job.Now enter into the home of my father.

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: Hurt in the battle,you bound up my wounds,Searching for kindness you held out your hand.Now enter into the home of my father.

verses.label: VERSE 8
verses.text: When I was laughed at,you stood at my side,When I was happy you shared in my joy.Now enter into the home of my father.

hymns.title: WHATSOEVER YOU DO

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: When I was hungry, you gave me to eat. When I was thirsty, you gave me to drink. Now enter into the home of my father.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: When I was homeless, you opened your door. When I was naked, you gave me your coat. Now enter into the home of my father.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: When I was weary, you helped me find rest. When I was anxious, you calmed all my fears. Now enter into the home of my father.

hymns.refrain: Whatsoever you do To the least of my brothers, That you do unto me.

hymns.title: WHEN I SEE THE BLOOD
hymns.attribution: Oh, he will pass,will pass over you.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Christ our redeemer died on the cross. Died for the sinner,paid all his dues. All who receive him need never fear. Yes, he will pass, will pass over you. When I see the blood When I see the blood When I see the blood I will pass, over you (over you).

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Chiefest of sinners,Jesus will save. As he has promised,so he will do. Oh, sinner hear him,trust in his word. Then he will pass,will pass over you.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Judgement is coming,all will be there Who have rejected,who have refused. Oh, sinner hasten, let Jesus in.Then God will pass,will pass over you.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Oh, what compassion,Oh,boundless love, Jesus has power, Jesus is true. All who believe are safe from the storm.

hymns.title: WHEN I SURVEY THE WONDROUS CROSS

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: When I survey the wondrous crossOn which the Prince of Glory died,And pour contempt on all my pride.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Forbid it, Lord, that I should boast,Save in the death of Christ, my God:All the vain things that charm me most,

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: See from his head, his hands, his feet,Sorrow and love flow mingled down:Did e'er such love and sorrow meet,

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Were the whole realm of nature mine,That were an offering far too small; Love so amazing, so divine, Demands my soul, my life, my all.

hymns.title: WHEN MORNING GILDS THE SKIES
hymns.attribution: And may it grow through all the ages of eternity.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: When morning gilds the skies,My heart awaking cries, May Jesus Christ be praised: Alike at work and prayer To Jesus I repair; May Jesus Christ be praised!

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: To God, the word on high The hosts of angels cry:May Jesus Christ be praised!Let mortals, too, upraise Their voice in hymns of praise:May Jesus Christ be praised!

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Let earth's wide circle round In joyful notes resound:May Jesus Christ be praised!Let air, and sea, and sky,From depth to height, reply:May Jesus Christ be praised!

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Does sadness fill my mind?A solace here I find,May Jesus Christ be praised:Or fades my earthly bliss?My comfort still is this,May Jesus Christ be praised!

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: The night becomes as day,When from the heart we say,May Jesus Christ be praised:The powers of darkness fear,When this sweet chant they hear,May Jesus Christ be praised!

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Be this, while life is mine,My canticle divine,May Jesus Christ be praised:Be this the eternal song Through ages all along,May Jesus Christ be praised. German,19th Century,Tr.E. Caswall (1814-78) 607608 WHEN THE ROLL IS CALLED UP YONDER

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: When the trumpet of the Lord shall sound and time shall be no more,And the morning breaks eternal bright and fair,When the saved of earth shall gather over on the other shore,And the roll is called up yonder,I'll be there. When the roll is called up yonder,When the roll is called uip yonder,When the roll is called up yonder,When the roll is called up yonder I'll be there.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: O that bright and cloudless morning when the dead in Christ shall rise,And the glory of his resurrection share, When his chosen ones shall gather to their home beyond the skies,And the roll is called up yonder I'll be there.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Let us labour for the master from the dawn till setting sun. Let us talk of all his wondrous love and care. Then when all of life is over and our work on earth is done,and the roIl is called up yonder I'll be there. WHERE LOVE CHARITY ABIDE Where love and charity ablde,There God Is found.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: The love of Christ has gathered us together,And in this love we find the sourd of all our gladness.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: All those who fear the power of the living God,Now with a heart sincere and faithful praise his holy name.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Since we are one in body,you now live with us,Oh, grant that in our lives,we may be one in serving you.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Here in our midst, let every person find the Lord.He calms the quarrelling nations,bringing peace and joy to all.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: United here with all the children of the Lord,We seek to see the glorious light of Christ the risen Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: So may our joy be full, untouched by sadness,

hymns.title: WHEN THE ROLL IS CALLED UP YONDER

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: When the trumpet of the Lord shall sound and time shall be no more, And the morning breaks eternal bright and fair, When the saved of earth shall gather over on the other shore, And the roll is called up yonder, I'll be there.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: On that bright and cloudless morning when the dead in Christ shall rise, And the glory of his resurrection share, When his chosen ones shall gather to their home beyond the skies, And the roll is called up yonder, I'll be there.

hymns.refrain: When the roll is called up yonder, When the roll is called up yonder, When the roll is called up yonder, When the roll is called up yonder I'll be there.

hymns.title: WHERE LOVE AND CHARITY ABIDE

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: The love of Christ has gathered us together, And in this love we find the joy of all our gladness.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: All those who fear the power of the living God, Now with a heart sincere and faithful praise his holy name.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Since we are one in body, you now live with us, Oh, grant that in our lives we may be one in serving you.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Here in our midst, let every soul find the Lord. He calms the quarrelling nations, And peace and joy will reign.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: United here with all the children of the Lord.

hymns.refrain: Where love and charity abide, There God is found.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: While shepherds watched their Flocks by night,All seated on the ground,

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: “Fear not,” said he, for mighty dread Had seized their troubled mind,"Glad tidings of great joy I bring To you and all mankind.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: "To you in David's town this day Is born of David's line A Saviour, who is Christ the Lord;And this shall be the sign:

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: "The heavenly Babe you there shall find To human view displayed,All meanly wrapped in swathing bands, And in a manger laid".

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Thus spake the Seraph; and forthwith Appeared a shining throng Of Angels praising God, who thus Addressed their joyful song:

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: "All glory be to God on high, And on the earth be peace, Goodwill henceforth from heaven to mmen Begin and never cease".

hymns.title: WITH AN EVERLASTING LOVE WITH
hymns.attribution: And haughty he knows from afar.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: I give thanks to you with all my heart You have heard the words of my mouth.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: In the sight of the angels I bless you In your Temple my heart will adore.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: I give thanks for your love and faithfulness Which excel all that hearts can conceive.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: On the day I called you answered me You increased the strength of my soul.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: All the kings of the earth will give thanks to you When they hear the words of your mouth.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: They will sing and rejoice in your ways Oh Lord And proclaim that your glory is great.

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: God is high yet He looks on the lowly

hymns.refrain: I will sing for ever of your love.

hymns.title: WONDERFUL WORDS OF LIFE

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Sing them over again to me,Wonderful words of life. Let me more of their beauty see, Wonderful words of life. Words of life and beauty, Teach me faith and duty.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Christ the blessed one gives to all, Wonderful words of life. Sinner rise to the loving call, Wonderful words of life. All so freely given, Wooing us to heaven.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Sweetly echo the gospel call, Wonderful words of life. Offer pardon and peace to all,Wonderful words of life. Jesus only saviour,

hymns.refrain: Beautiful words, wonderful words, Wonderful words of life. D.$.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: WVe join the bridegroom and the bride, In offering now, this bread and wine; By these two gifts, two hearts unite, That in one Lord, one love, may shine.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: As man and wife, they pledge their lives,To self-donation by God's grace; A love shall the world embrace.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: O Christ, behold your bride, the Church, Accept this precious gift we give,To love all men as you love us,And for the father's praise to live.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Were you there When they crucified my Lord? Were you there When they crucified my Lord? Oh sometimes it causes me To tremble, tremble, tremble,Were you there When they crucified my Lord?

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Were you there When they nailed him to a tree?...

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Were you there When they pierced him in the side?...

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Were you there When the sun refused to shine?...

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Were you there When they laid him in the tomb?..

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Were you there When he rose from out the tomb?

hymns.title: WORD OF GOD ACROSS THE AGES

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Word of God across the ages,Come thy message to our life;Source of hope forever present,In our toil and fears and strife;Constant witness to God's mercy,Still our grace whate'er befall;Guide unfailing, strength eternal,Offered freely to us all.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Story of man's wondrous journey, From the shàdows of the night;Garnered truth of sage and prophet, Guiding forward into light; Words and deeds of Christ our Master, Pointing to the life and way; Still appealing, still inspiring, 'Mid the struggles of today.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: In the tongues of all the people,May the message bless and heal,As devout and patient scholars,More and more its depths reveal,Bless, O God, to wise and simple,All thy truth of ageless worth,Till all lands receive the witness,And thy knowledge fills the earth.

hymns.title: WE ARE BLESSED

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: The Mass is ended. Alleluia!Let us go into the world, (alleluia)And proclaim the gospel of the Lord, (alleluia)To the whole nations. (alleluia)

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: We are the salt of the earth;We are the light of the world;Letus spread the taste of God's love,(And) Shine our lives so bright. (alleluia)

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: God loves his children;He gives us according to our needs;Let us serve him,All the days of our lives;Keeping away from sin. (alleluia)

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Read the bible everyday;Believe the teachings of God;Teach your brethren what you believe;Practice the virtues you preaci. (alleluia)

hymns.refrain: We are blessed; (alleluia)We are blessed; (alleluia)We are blessed;To be God's children. .

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Father, we have come; Jesus, we have come; Holy Ghost,we have come;To worship and adore you.Take over our whole lives;(Please Lord) Accept our offering.Let your power, anointing and blessing Descend on your people. Glory and honour be unto you;(Oh Lord) We are your people,The work of your hand;Show, us your mercy and love;Jesus, the merciful;Jesus, the king,We bless your name, oh Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Strengthen, Lord, our faith,Our hope and our love;May we do, with loving heart,Whatever you ask us to do,oh Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Heal us, Lord, when we are wounded;Touch us when we are in pain;Forgive us, Lord, when we sin Against you, we pray, oh Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: May the words of our mouths,And the thoughts of our minds,Be acceptable in your sight.Hear us, we pray, oh Loro.

hymns.title: YES, I SHALL ARISE YES,I
hymns.attribution: The blessing of God will fill all my days.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: To you, o Lord, I lift up my soul;In you,o My God,I place all my trust.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Look down on me,have mercy o Lord;Forgive me my sins,behold all my grief.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: My heart and soul shall yearn for your face;Be gracious to me and answer my plea.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Do not withhold your goodness from me;O Lord, may your love be deep in my soul.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: To you I pray, have pity on me;My God I have sinned against your great love.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Mercy I cry, O Lord,wash me clean;And whiter than snow my spirit shall be.

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: Give me again the joy of your help;Now open my lips your praise I will sing. g. You are my joy, my refuge and strength; Let all upright hearts give praise to the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 10
verses.text: My soul will sing, my heart will rejoice;

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Rise and shine forth, for your light has come, And upon you breaks the glory of the Lord; For the darkness covers the earth, And the thick clouds, the people.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: But upon you the Lord shall dawn, And in you the splendor shall be revealed; Your light shall guide the gentiles on their path, And Kings shall walk in your brightness.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Wonder and thanksgiving shall fill your heart, As the wealth of nations enriches you; You shall be called the city of the Lord, Dear to the Holy one of Israel.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: You were desolate and alone, A place unvisited by men, Shall be the pride of ages untold, And everlasting joy to the nations.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: No more shall the sun be your light by day, Nor the moon's beam enlighten you by night, The Lord shall be your everlasting light, And your God shall be your glory.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: No more for you the setting of suns, No more the waning of moons; The Lord shall be your everlasting light, And the days of your mourning shall come to an end. Fr. Lucien Deiss,C.S.Sp. (Based on Luke 1.28-35)

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Adeste Fideles Laeti triumphantes, Venite, venite in Bethlehem. Natum videte, Regem Angelorum; Venite adoremus, venite adoremus, venite adoremus Dominum!

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Deum de Deo,Lumen de lumine,Gestant puellae viscera.Deum verum,Genitum non factum; venite, &c.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: En grege relicto,Humiles ad cunas,Vocati pastores approperant.Et nos ovanti Gradu festinemus;venite, &c.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Stella duce, Magi,Christum adorantes,Aurum, thus, et myrrham dant munera.Jesu infanti Corda praebeamus;venite, &c.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Aeterni Parentis Splendorem aeternum,Velatum sub carne videbimus.Deum infantem, pannis involutum;venite, &c.

verses.label: VERSE 8
verses.text: Pro nobis egenum Et foeno cubantem,Piis foveamus amplexibus.Sic nos anamtem Quis non redamaret?venite, &c.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Adóro te devóte, látens Déitas,Qua sub his figúris, vere látitas:Tibi se cor meum totum súbjicit,Quia, te contémplans, totum déficit.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Visus, tactus, gustus, in te fállitur,Sed audítu solo tuto créditur:Credo quidquid díxit Dei Fílius;Nil hoc verbo veritátis vérius.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: In cruce latébat sola Déitas,At hic látet si ul et humánitas:Ambo támen crédens átque cónfitens,Peto quod petívit latro pcenitens.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Plagas, sicut Thomas, non intúeor,Deum támen meum te confíteor.Fac me tibi sémper mágis crédere,In te spem habére, te dilígere.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: O memoriále mortis Dómini,Panis vivus, vitam prastans hómini,Praesta mea menti de te vívere,Et te ili semper dulce sápere.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Pie pellicáne, Jesu Dómine,Me immúndum munda tuo sánguine,Cujus una stilla salvum fácere,Totum mundum quit ab ómni scélere.

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: Jesu, quem velátum nunc aspício, Oro fíat illud, quod tam sítio: Ut, te reveláta cernens fácie, Visu sim beátus tuæ glóriæ.

verses.text: Surgere qui curat, populo: tu quae genuisti, Natura mirante, tuum sanctum Genitorem Virgo prius ac posterius, Gabrielis ab ore Sumens illud Ave, peccatorum miserere. (Hermann The Lame, D. 1054 (In Advent) V. Ángelus Dómini nuntiávit María R. Et concépit de Spíritu Sancto. Oremus Grátiam tuam quáesumus, Dómine, méntibus nostris infúnde;ut qui, ángelo nuntiánte, Christi Fili tui Incarnatiónem cognóvimus,per passiónem ejus et crucem, ad resurrectiónis glóriam perducámur.Per eúmdem Christum Dóminum nostrum. R.Amen. (From Christmas Day to the Purification) V. Post Partum Virgo invioláta permansísti. R. Dei Génitrix, intercéde pro nobis. Orémus Deus, qui salútis ætérna beáta Maríæ virginitáte fecúnda humáno géneri práemia præstitísti: tríbue,quáesumus, ut ipsam pro nobis intercédere sentiámus, per quam merúimus, Auctórem vitæsuscípere Dóminum nostrum Jesum Christum Filium tuum.

verses.text: Ad te Rex summe, omnium Redemptor, Oculos nostros sublevamus flentes: Exaudi, Christe, supplicantum preces. Attende Domine...(etc.)

verses.text: Innocens captus,nec repugnans duuctus;Testibus falsis pro impiis damnatus Quos redemisti, tu conserva, Christe.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Ave maris stella, Dei Mater alma, Atque semper Virgo, Felix caeli porta.

verses.label: VERSE 2

verses.label: VERSE 3

verses.label: VERSE 4

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Virgo singularis, linter omnes mites, Nos culpis solutos, Mites fac et castos.

verses.label: VERSE 6

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: Sit laus Deo Patri, Summo Christo decus, Spiritui Sancto,

verses.label: TEXT

verses.label: TEXT
verses.text: Vere passum immolatum In Cruce pro homine, Cujus latus perforatum

verses.text: Ecce Sacerdos Magnus Ecce Sacerdos Magnus Qui in diebus suis, qui in diebus suis Placuit Deo Non est inventus, similis illi Qui conser-varet legem excelsis

verses.label: TEXT
verses.text: Hora coenae dicere invitatis, ut venirent: Quia parata sunt omnia. Venite comedite panem meum et bibite vinum quod miscui vobis. * Quia parata sunt omnia

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Enatus est Emanuel,Dominus, Quem praedixit Gabriel, Domin Dominus, Salvator noster est;Salvator noster est.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Hic jacet in praesepio, Dominus, Puer admirabilis, Dominus.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Haec lux est orta hodie,Dominus, Ex Maria Virgine, Domminus.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Lauda, Sion, Salvatorem, Lauda ducem et pastorem In hymnis et canticis. Quantum poses, tantum aude: Quia major omni laude Nec laudare sufficis.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Laudis thema specialis,Panis vivus et vitalis Hodie proponitur; Quem in sacrae mensa coenae Turbae fratrum duodenae Datum non ambigitur.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Sit laus plena, sit sonora,Sit iucunda, sit decora Mentis iubilatio.Dies enim solemnis agitur,In qua mensae prima recolitur Huius institutio.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: In hac mensa novi Regis Novum Pascha novae legis Phase vetus terminat.Vetustatem novitas,Umbram fugat veritas,Noctem lux eliminat.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Quod in coena Christus gessit,Faciendum hoc expressit In sui memoriam Docti sacris institutis,Panem, vinum in salutis Consecramus hostiam.

verses.label: TEXT
verses.text: Nos autem gloriari oportet In Cruce Domini nostri Jesu Christi, In quo est salus, vita, Et resurrectio nostra: Per quem salvati, Et liberati sumus.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Arbor foeta alma luce Hoc sacrandum protulit,Fert hoc prona praesens turba Salvatori saeculi.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Consecrare tu dignare,Rex perennis patriae,Hoc olívum, sígnum vívum,lura contra daemonum.

verses.label: VERSE 3

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Lota mente sacro fonte Aufugantur crimina,Uncta fronte sacrosancta Influunt charismata.

verses.label: VERSE 5

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: O SANCTISSIMA, o piissima,Dulcis Virgo Maria!Mater amata, intemerata,Ora, ora pro nobis.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Tu solatium et refugium,Virgo MMater Maria.Quidquid optamus, per te speramus;Ora, ora pro nobis.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Ecce debiles, perquam flebiles;Salva nos, o Maria!Tolle languores, sana dolores;Ora, ora pro nobis.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Virgo, respice, Mater, aspice;Audi nos, o Maria!Tu medicinam portas divinam;Ora, ora pro nobis.

verses.label: VERSE 5

verses.label: VERSE 1

verses.label: VERSE 2

verses.label: VERSE 3

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Verbum caro, panem verum Verbo carnem éfficit:Fitque sanguis Christi merum,Et si sensus déficit,Ad firmándum cor sincérum Sola fides súfficit.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: TAntum ergo Sacraméntum Venerémur cérnui:Et antíquum documéntum Novo cedat rítui:Præstet fides suppleméntum Sénsuum deféctui.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Genitóri, Genitóque Laus et jubilátio, Salus, honor, virtus quoque Sit et benedíctio: Procedénti ab utróque Compar sit laudátio. Amen.

verses.label: VERSE 1

verses.label: TEXT
verses.text: Te gloriósus Apostolórum chorus; Te Prophetárum laudábilisnúmerus; Te Mártyrum candidátus laudat Exércituus. To per orbem terrárum sancta confitétur Ecclésia: Patrem imménsæ majestátis; Venerándum tuum verum et únicum Fílium; Sanctum quoque Paráclitum Spíritum. Tu Rex glóriæe, Christe. Tu Patris sempitérnus es Fílius. Tu ad liberándum susceptúrus hóminem, non horruísti Vírginis úterum. Tu, devícto mortis acúleo, aperuísti credéntibus regna cælórum Tu ad déxteram Dei sedes, in glória Patris. Judex créderis esse ventúrus. Te ergo quýsumus,tuis fámulis súbveni, quos pretióso sánguine redemísti.Aetérna fac cum sanctis tuis in glória numerári. Salvum fac pópulum tuum, Dómine,et bénedic hæreditáti tuæ. Et rege eos, et extólle illos usque in ætérnum. Per síngulos dies benedícimus te.Et laudámus nomen tuum in saeculum, et in saeculum saecúli. Dignáre, Dómine, die isto sine peccáto nos custodíre.Miserére nostri, Dómine, miserére nostri. Fiat misericórdia tua, Dómine, super nos, quemádmodum sperávimus in te.

verses.label: TEXT
verses.text: Mater plena sanctae laetitiae, O Maria. Salve Mater, &c Salve, decus humani generis. Salve, Virgo dignior ceteris, quae virgines omnes transgrederis et altius sedes in superis. O Maria.Salve Mater, &c Salve, felix Virgo puerpera: Nam qui sedet in Patris dextera, Caelum regens, terram et aethera, Intra tua se clasit viscera. O Maria. Salve Mater, &c. Te creavit Pater ingenitus, adamavit te Unigenitus, Feconda vit te Sanctus Spýritus, Tu es facta tota divinitus, O Maria. Salve Mater, &c. Te creavit Deus mirabilem, te respexit ancillam humilem, te quaesývit sponsam amabilem, Tibi nunquam fecit consimilem, O Maria. Salve Mater, &c. Esto, Mater, nostrum solatium: Nostrum esto, tu Virgo, gaudium, Et nos tandem post hoc exsilium, Laetos juge choris caelestium.

verses.label: TEXT

hymns.title: VICTIMAE PASCHALI LAUDES
hymns.attribution: Attr. to Wipo of Burgundy (10th Century)

verses.label: TEXT
verses.text: Agnus redemit oves: Christus innocens Patri Reconciliavit peccatores. Mors et vita duello Conflixere mirando: Dux vitae mortuus, Regnat vivus. Dic nobis Maria, Quid vidisti in via? Sepulcrum Christi viventis, Et gloriam vidi resurgentis: Angelicos testes, Sudarium, et vestes. Surrexit Christus spes mea: Praecedet suos [vos] in Galilaeam. Scimus Christum surrexisse A mortuis vere: Tu nobis, victor Rex,miserere. Amen. [Alleluia.] Attr. To Wipo of Burgundy (10th Century)
